Orange River View Listing Tourism in Upington Content Welcome to Upington Upington is situated on the banks of the Mighty Orange River , which is one of the largest rivers in South Africa. Upington is rich in culture and history. The town was established in 1870, and since 1880 the town as a result has expanded rapidly and is now the business, agricultural and educational center of the Gordonia district. No place for the meek, it started out as a mission station, established by a Reverend Christiaan Schroder. A church was built in 1875 and is today the Kalahari Oranje Museum , complete with all its period furnishings. Upington was originally called Olyvenhoutsdrif (‘Olive wood drift’) due to the large number of olivewood trees in the area, as a result it was renamed Upington in 1898 after the Cape Colony’s attorney general at the time, Sir Thomas Upington. Like Wild West towns, Upington had its share of skirmishes and its share of fortune-seeking scoundrels. One of these was a man called George St Leger Gordon Lenox, alias ‘Scotty Smith’. An adventurer born in Scotland, he especially bought and sold illegal diamonds, stole horses and masterminded highway robberies. His gravestone is one of Upington’s tourist attractions. Another noteworthy historic attraction is the spectacular Date Palm Avenue. Two rows of more than 200 date palm trees escort visitors over 1 000m to the entrance of Die Eiland Holiday Resort on the banks of the Orange River. Upington Date Palm Avenue Upington Donkey Statue Upington Sakkie se Arkie Upington Mighty Orange River The economy depends heavily on tourism making Upington the path to the Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park, Richtersveld, the flowers of Namaqualand and the most noteworthy Augrabies National Park. Agriculture forms a very important part of the local economy and large volumes of produce are exported to Europe as a result many companies have also established their head offices in Upington. Upington is best known for its export-quality grapes, raisins and wines, which are cultivated on the rich flood plains of the Orange River. Upington’s most famous wines are produced by an organization generally known as Orange River Cellars. The company has six warehouses in the area (all of them on the banks of the Orange River) at Upington, Kanoneiland , Grootdrink , Kakamas , Keimoes and Groblershoop . The wines from ORC are exported, inter alia, to Europe and the USA. There is a wide range of businesses in Upington , where one is able to purchase most, if not all, of ones requirements. Upington Airport Upington Desert Palace Casino Upington Grietjie a retired steam locomotive at the Upington railway station Upington Orange River Cellars All of the main roads and streets are tarred and furthermore Upington is linked to all major South African cities by air, rail and road. To achieve a perfect hook shot: Straighten the wrist of your bowling hand. Your bowling hand, not surprisingly, is the one that’s holding the ball. Be careful not to bend or flex your wrist. Hold your hand straight while you swing the ball out and back.Begin to rotate the wrist, hand, and fingers on your bowling arm toward the opposite side of your body as the ball comes forward. If you’re left-handed, rotate your wrist toward the right. If you’re right-handed, rotate your wrist toward the left. Let go of the ball near your ankle and finish with your hand in the handshake position after you release the ball. You know your hand is in the handshake position when your thumb is pointing up and your palm is facing the inside of the lane. To throw the perfect straight shot: Keep your bowling hand directly underneath the ball and your wrist straight. The main difference between a straight shot and a hook shot is that you keep your hand straight all the way through the backswing and the release of the ball. Swing your bowling arm out and back. As the ball comes forward, release it onto the lane when it reaches your ankle, keeping your hand straight and palm up the entire time. This offer is exclusively for New-to-Bank customers (including Youth NTB) who increase their fresh funds by a minimum of EGP 20,000 and book it into an EGP Certificate of Deposit. When will the cashback be credited to my account? The cashback payouts will occur in two phases based on when the fresh funds are evaluated: First Phase: Credited during October 2026 (reflecting growth from end-of-September vs. end-of-July). Second Phase: Credited during January 2027 (reflecting growth from end-of-December vs. end-of-September). How are "fresh funds" calculated for the draws? Fresh funds are measured by the net increase in your Local Currency Assets Under Management (LCY AUM) across two distinct tracking periods: First Draw: The increase in LCY AUM at the end of September 2026 compared to the end of July 2026. Second Draw: The increase in LCY AUM at the end of December 2026 compared to the end of September 2026. Who is eligible to participate in this campaign? The campaign targets all existing Crédit Agricole Egypt customers, New-to-Bank customers, New-to-Bank customers, And specifically features tailored offers for Youth customers. text: How to Plan the Perfect Hens Party in Australia | Ftawa How to Plan the Perfect Hens Party in Australia Ftawa Home (current) About Us Terms and Conditions Privacy Policy How to Plan the Perfect Hens Party in Australia 2026-09-20 Setting the Stage Choosing a Memorable Theme Planning a memorable hens party begins with setting an unforgettable theme. Themes serve as the backbone of the experience, dictating the activities, venue, and decorations. For those eager to infuse a creative flair into their gathering, exploring paint and sip Sydney is a wonderful starting point. Imagine an evening where friends come together over a glass of wine, letting their creativity flow while engaging in conversation. Picking the Perfect Date Timing is crucial when organising a hens party. It's essential to consider the schedules of key guests, especially if they're coming from out of town. A weekend might be ideal, offering everyone the opportunity to unwind without the pressures of work the following day. To make the date even more special, consider aligning it with local events that match your theme. For example, tying the event with a walk along Bondi Beach's scenic coastal paths can add a touch of Sydney's vibrant essence to the celebration. Crafting Your Guest List The guest list is the lifeblood of any successful event. Start by discussing with the bride-to-be, ensuring her closest friends and family are included. Consider the venue's capacity, and aim for a balanced mix of personalities that complement each other, ensuring a lively and engaging atmosphere. Moreover, offer experience gifts as part of the invite. These could include vouchers for activities in the area, like exploring more experiences Melbourne , which could serve as a delightful precursor or follow-up to the main event. Venue and Activities Unique Venue Options Selecting the right venue sets the tone for an unforgettable experience. Exploring the trendy dance studios in Newtown can add a fun twist to your event, especially if your group is open to trying something new like dance classes . These spaces offer a unique atmosphere, perfect for parties that want to incorporate movement and music, making it a memorable setting. Newtown also has a variety of other quirky venues, like intimate art galleries and versatile function spaces, allowing you to tailor the environment to your group's style. Engaging Activity Ideas To keep your guests entertained, consider activities that are both engaging and inclusive. Dance workshops are a fantastic choice, particularly for groups seeking interactive and energetic experiences. Organizing a session in one of Newtown's studios encourages participants to step out of their comfort zone and bond over a shared interest. Alternatively, set up stations for art and craft projects to cater to creative types, or plan a wine tasting session to explore local flavours. These activities provide opportunities for connection and make for memorable events that guests will recall fondly. Incorporating Local Flavours Highlighting regional specialties not only supports local businesses but adds an authentic touch to your gathering. Offering refreshments that feature locally sourced ingredients can elevate your event's culinary aspect. Start by collaborating with nearby artisans and suppliers to include a selection of couple gifts that guests can take home. This approach enriches the experience and leaves a lasting impression. Incorporating such local elements creates a cohesive and unique outing, ensuring your event stands out amid the plethora of date ideas Melbourne . Catering and Drinks Curating a Delicious Menu Creating a standout menu for your gathering is truly an art. Given Sydney's cultural tapestry, consider weaving in tastes that reflect this vibrant city. Start with a selection of gourmet canapés, perhaps featuring fresh seafood which is a classic nod to the local coastline. Think scallops with a zesty chilli-lime drizzle, paired with mini beef sliders as a robust option. Be mindful of dietary preferences, offering a balance of vegetarian and gluten-free choices to ensure everyone feels catered to. Once you have covered these bases, don't forget sweet treats that nod to local flavours like wattleseed brownies or lemon myrtle cheesecakes. Selecting Signature Cocktails A carefully selected cocktail can be a conversation starter, as memorable as Sydney's own Bondi Beach. Consider crafting a cocktail menu that tells a story. Perhaps a 'Bondi Breeze', a refreshing mix of gin, mint, and elderflower tonic, could serve as a fitting tipple to capture the beach vibe. For those incorporating hens party ideas , a signature cocktail can set the tone and elevate the party atmosphere. Make sure to offer non-alcoholic mocktail options too, ensuring inclusivity while maintaining a lively spirit. Ən tez-tez edilən plastik əməliyyatlar aşağıdakılardır: döş plastikası (döş vəzinin böyüdülməsi, döş vəzinin kiçildilməsi, döşün formasının dəyişdirilməsi), liposaksiya (artıq piy yığınlarının götürülməsi), otoplastika (qulaq formasının dəyişdirilməsi), ətə batmış dırnağın lazer cərrahiyyəsi, xalın götürülməsi, ziyilin götürülməsi, pirsinq. Ən son müalicə və diaqnostika avadanlığı Mərkəzimizin həkimlərinə müxtəlif tibbi problemləri ən yüksək səviyyədə həll etməyə imkan yaradır. Mərkəzimizdə həm Azərbaycanda, həm də Rusiyada tanınmış plastik, rekonstruktiv və estetik cərrahiyyə üzrə yüksək ixtisaslı mütəxəssislər tərəfindən konsultasiyalar, plastik əməliyyatlar və müalicə aparılır. Foto: əvvəl və sonra Lazer cərrahiyyəsi Plastik cərrahiyyə Dermatokosmetologiya Lazerdən istifadə ilə plastik əməliyyatlar ən effektiv və təhlükəsizdir və bir sıra üstünlüklərə malikdir. Lazer şüasının toxumalara spesifik təsiri əməliyyatları, demək olar ki, qansız, minimal toxumaların zədələnməsi və infeksiya riski ilə aparmaq imkanını verir, sağalma prosesi isə çapıqlar yaranmadan qısa müddət ərzində keçir, bu da maksimal kosmetik effekt verir. Daha ətraflı Plastik cərrahların yüksək ixtisaslı olması və böyük təcrübəyə malik olması, qabaqcıl texnologiyadan istifadə, müasir tibb avadanlığı və əməliyyatdan sonrakı qulluq bütün növ plastik əməliyyatları uğurla aparmaq imkanını verir və mümkün risk və ağırlaşmaları minimuma çatdırmaq imkanını verir. Daha ətraflı Terapevtik kosmetologiyanın müasir üsulların böyük çeşidi cərrahiyyə müdaxiləsindən istifadə etmədən xarici görüşünüzü effektiv surətdə cavanlaşdırmaq imkanını verir. Klinikamızın mütəxəssisləri aparat kosmetologiyası üzrə proseduralarının müxtəlif kombinasiyasından istifadə edirlər və dərinizin xüsusiyyətlərindən asılı olaraq Sizin üçün fərdi krem və maska reseptlərini hazırlayacaq. title: Explore Our Construction Zone
text: Skip to content Search Toggle Home Privacy Policy Terms And Conditions Contact Us Menu Search for: Submit Enhancing New Developments with Outdoor Living Spaces: Why Patios and Decks Are in Demand Post author By vistoclima Post date September 15, 2025 Categories In Construction Featured If you’re knee-deep in planning new developments, you’ve probably noticed how buyers are craving more than just four walls and a roof these days. They’re all about that seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living . Patios and decks aren’t just nice-to-haves anymore—they’re must-haves that can make your projects stand out in a crowded market. Let’s chat about why these features are skyrocketing in popularity and how you can leverage them to boost your builds. And hey, if you’re looking for expert help, we’ll touch on that too. The Rise of Outdoor Living Trends Picture this: It’s a sunny afternoon, and your potential buyers are envisioning barbecues, cozy evenings under the stars, or just a quiet spot to unwind. That’s the magic of outdoor spaces, and it’s no surprise they’re in high demand. Post-pandemic, folks have rediscovered the joy of fresh air right at home, and that’s driving a boom in requests for patios and decks. From my chats with industry folks, it’s clear that millennials and Gen Z buyers—your future homeowners—are prioritizing lifestyle over square footage. They’re willing to pay a premium for developments that feel like an extension of their living room. Stats show that homes with well-designed outdoor areas sell faster and for more money. So, as a construction company owner, why not tap into this trend to give your projects that competitive edge? Key Benefits for Your New Developments Adding patios and decks isn’t just about aesthetics; it’s a smart business move. Here’s why they’re worth incorporating into your next project: Boosts Property Value : A solid patio or deck can increase a home’s resale value by 8-12%. Buyers see it as an investment in their quality of life, and that translates to higher offers for you. Appeals to Modern Buyers : Families want versatile spaces for entertaining, remote work setups outdoors, or even home gyms. It’s all about creating that “wow” factor that makes your development memorable. Enhances Sustainability : Go green with eco-friendly materials like composite decking or permeable pavers for patios. This not only attracts environmentally conscious buyers but can also qualify your projects for green building incentives. Low Maintenance, High Reward : Modern designs use durable materials that require minimal upkeep, meaning happier homeowners and fewer callbacks for your team. Think about it—when was the last time a buyer complained about too much outdoor space? These features turn standard builds into dream homes. Practical Ways to Integrate Patios and Decks Ready to get started? Integrating these elements doesn’t have to complicate your workflow. Here are some conversational tips to make it seamless: Start with Site Planning : Assess the lot early on. A south-facing deck maximizes sunlight, while a patio tucked against the house provides natural shade and privacy. Mix Materials for Style : Combine wood, stone, or even recycled composites to match the home’s vibe. For urban developments, multi-level decks can maximize small yards. Add Smart Features : Incorporate built-in lighting, fire pits, or outdoor kitchens. These extras can be upsell opportunities during the sales process. Consider Local Regulations : Chat with your team about zoning and permits upfront to avoid headaches. In some areas, elevated decks might need extra engineering, but it’s worth it for the end result. By weaving these in from the design phase, you’re not just building houses—you’re crafting lifestyles that sell themselves. Why Partner with Outdoor Design Experts? As a busy construction owner, you might not have the bandwidth to dive deep into every outdoor detail. That’s where specialists come in handy. For instance, teaming up with Integrated Outdoor Designs can take your projects to the next level. They specialize in custom patios and decks that perfectly complement new developments, handling everything from concept to installation. It’s like having an extra ace up your sleeve—efficient, high-quality work that aligns with your timelines and budgets. We’ve seen partnerships like this turn average subdivisions into sought-after communities. If you’re curious, swing by their site to see some inspiring case studies. Wrapping It Up: Time to Elevate Your Builds So, what do you say? In a market where buyers are hungry for outdoor escapes, patios and decks are your secret weapon for enhancing new developments. They’re practical, profitable, and downright fun to build. If you’re gearing up for your next project, consider how these spaces can set you apart. Cookies settings Aceptar Rechazar Privacy & Cookie policy Privacy & Cookies policy Cookies list Cookie name Active Política de cookies Consell Esportiu del Baix Llobregat Què són les galetes? Les cookies són petits arxius que algunes plataformes, com les pàgines web, poden instal·lar al seu ordinador, telèfon intel·ligent, tauleta o televisió connectada. Les seves funcions poden ser molt variades: emmagatzemar les seves preferències de navegació, recopilar informació estadística, permetre certes funcionalitats tècniques, etcètera. De vegades, les galetes s'utilitzen per emmagatzemar informació bàsica sobre els hàbits de navegació d e l'usuari o del seu equip, fins al punt, segons els casos, de poder reconèixer-ho. Per a què les utilitzem? Aquest lloc web, a l'igual que la majoria de llocs web a Internet, utilitza cookies per millorar l'experiència de l'usuari. A continuació, trobareu informació sobre què són les galetes, quin tipus de cookies utilitza aquest portal, com pot desactivar les cookies en el seu navegador i com desactivar específicament la instal·lació de les galetes de tercers. Per què són importants? Les cookies són útils per a diversos motius. Des d'un punt de vista tècnic, permeten que les pàgines web funcionin de forma més àgil i adaptada a les seves preferències, com ara emmagatzemar el seu idioma o la moneda del seu país. A més, ajuden els responsables dels llocs web a millorar els serveis que ofereixen, gràcies a la informació estadística que recullen a través d'elles. Tipologia, Finalitat i Funcionament de les Cookies Les cookies, en funció de la seva permanència, poden dividir-se en cookies de sessió o permanents. Les primeres expiren quan l'usuari tanca el navegador. Les segones expiren en funció quan es compleixi l'objectiu per al qual serveixen (per exemple, perquè l'usuari es mantingui identificat a les pàgines de www.cebllob.cat ) o bé quan s'esborren manualment. Addicionalment, en funció del seu objectiu, les cookies pots classificar-se de la següent manera: Cookies de Rendiment : Aquest tipus de cookie recorda les teves preferències per a les eines que es troben a les pàgines, de manera que no has de tornar a configurar cada vegada que la visites. A tall d'exemple, en aquesta tipologia s'inclouen: ✓ Ajustaments de volum de reproductors de vídeo o so. ✓ Les velocitats de transmissió de vídeo compatibles amb el seu navegador. Cookies de Geolocalització : Aquestes cookies són utilitzades per esbrinar en quin país et trobes quan es navega per la web. Aquesta cookie és totalment anònima, i només s'utilitza per ajudar a orientar el contingut a la teva ubicació. Cookies de Registre : Les cookies de registre es generen un cop que l'usuari s'ha registrat o posteriorment ha obert la sessió, i s'utilitzen per identificar-lo en les pàgines amb els següents objectius: ✓ Mantenir l'usuari identificat de manera que, si tanca una pàgina, el navegador o l'ordinador i en un altre moment o un altre dia torna a entrar en aquesta pàgina, seguirà identificat, facilitant així la seva navegació sense haver de tornar a identificar-se. Aquesta funcionalitat es pot suprimir si l'usuari prem la funcionalitat "tancar sessió", de manera que aquesta cookie s'elimina i la propera vegada que entri a la pàgina l'usuari haurà d'iniciar sessió per estar identificat. ✓ Comprovar si l'usuari està autoritzat per accedir a certes pàgines, per exemple, per participar en un concurs. ✓ Addicionalment, algunes pàgines poden utilitzar connectors amb xarxes socials com ara Facebook o Twitter. Quan l'usuari es registra en una pàgina amb credencials d'una xarxa social, autoritza a la xarxa social a guardar una cookie persistent que recorda la seva identitat i li garanteix accés a les pàgines fins que expira. title: 404 - PAGE NOT FOUND
text: ERROR 404 - PAGE NOT FOUND Why am I seeing this page? 404 means the file is not found. If you have already uploaded the file then the name may be misspelled or it is in a different folder. Other Possible Causes You may get a 404 error for images because you have Hot Link Protection turned on and the domain is not on the list of authorized domains. If you go to your temporary url (http://ip/~username/) and get this error, there maybe a problem with the rule set stored in an .htaccess file. You can try renaming that file to .htaccess-backup and refreshing the site to see if that resolves the issue. It is also possible that you have inadvertently deleted your document root or the your account may need to be recreated. Either way, please contact your web host immediately. Are you using WordPress? See the Section on 404 errors after clicking a link in WordPress. How to find the correct spelling and folder Missing or Broken Files When you get a 404 error be sure to check the URL that you are attempting to use in your browser.This tells the server what resource it should attempt to request. http://example.com/example/Example/help.html In this example the file must be in public_html/example/Example/ Notice that the CaSe is important in this example. On platforms that enforce case-sensitivity e xample and E xample are not the same locations. For addon domains, the file must be in public_html/addondomain.com/example/Example/ and the names are case-sensitive. Broken Image When you have a missing image on your site you may see a box on your page with with a red X where the image is missing. Right click on the X and choose Properties. The properties will tell you the path and file name that cannot be found. This varies by browser, if you do not see a box on your page with a red X try right clicking on the page, then select View Page Info, and goto the Media Tab. http://example.com/cgi-sys/images/banner.PNG In this example the image file must be in public_html/cgi-sys/images/ Notice that the CaSe is important in this example. On platforms that enforce case-sensitivity PNG and png are not the same locations. 404 Errors After Clicking WordPress Links When working with WordPress, 404 Page Not Found errors can often occur when a new theme has been activated or when the rewrite rules in the .htaccess file have been altered. When you encounter a 404 error in WordPress, you have two options for correcting it. Option 1: Correct the Permalinks Log in to WordPress. From the left-hand navigation menu in WordPress, click Settings > Permalinks (Note the current setting. If you are using a custom structure, copy or save the custom structure somewhere.) Select Default . Click Save Settings . Change the settings back to the previous configuration (before you selected Default). Put the custom structure back if you had one. Click Save Settings . This will reset the permalinks and fix the issue in many cases. If this doesn't work, you may need to edit your .htaccess file directly. Option 2: Modify the .htaccess File Add the following snippet of code to the top of your .htaccess file: # BEGIN WordPress <IfModule mod_rewrite.c> RewriteEngine On RewriteBase / RewriteRule ^index.php$ - [L] RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d RewriteRule . /index.php [L] </IfModule> # End WordPress If your blog is showing the wrong domain name in links, redirecting to another site, or is missing images and style, these are all usually related to the same problem: you have the wrong domain name configured in your WordPress blog. How to modify your .htaccess file The .htaccess file contains directives (instructions) that tell the server how to behave in certain scenarios and directly affect how your website functions. Redirects and rewriting URLs are two very common directives found in a .htaccess file, and many scripts such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla and Magento add directives to the .htaccess so those scripts can function. It is possible that you may need to edit the .htaccess file at some point, for various reasons.This section covers how to edit the file in cPanel, but not what may need to be changed.(You may need to consult other articles and resources for that information.) There are Many Ways to Edit a .htaccess File Edit the file on your computer and upload it to the server via FTP Use an FTP program's Edit Mode Use SSH and a text editor Use the File Manager in cPanel The easiest way to edit a .htaccess file for most people is through the File Manager in cPanel. How to Edit .htaccess files in cPanel's File Manager Before you do anything, it is suggested that you backup your website so that you can revert back to a previous version if something goes wrong. Open the File Manager Log into cPanel. In the Files section, click on the File Manager icon. Check the box for Document Root for and select the domain name you wish to access from the drop-down menu. More Pneumatic Tapping Machine Air-driven tapping machine. Compressed air then drives the spindle, which is safe, fast and efficient. Small air pressure can produce large torque output. Compared with other type tapping machines, the weight is much lighter, and it’s convenient to move from place A to place B. The operation is simple, if inexperienced, just follow the steps in the operation manual to use. More Electric Tapping Machine Power-driven tapping machine. Different spindle design from pneumatic tapping machine. Maho design the simplifies operation. Advance and retreat mode is changed to a single button operation, green key advances, red key retreats. It became easily operate and improves the tapping efficiency. The volume of electric tapping machine in use is much lower than pneumatic type, and the rotational speed can also have more changes. The operation is simple, if inexperienced, just follow the steps in the operation manual to use. More Hydraulic Tapping Machine Hydraulic hybrid drive tapping machine. The design doesn’t require complex hydraulic pressure and speed adjustment operation control. The design of the spindle advance and retreat is same as electric machine. Maho still design the simplified operation technology, but has high-efficiency tapping ability. Due to the combination of the hydraulic system, it can be used in larger tapping range is required. The operation is simple, if inexperienced, just follow the steps in the operation manual to use More Tapping Machine Accessories The optional accessories include 90° Various Degree Tapping Device, Auto Reverse Device, Cast Iron Work Cart, Automatic Tap Lubricator System, and Magnetic Base…etc. Improve the efficiency and convenience of the work. More Quick Change Tapping Chuck Suitable for lathes and milling machines, and can be used with safety clutch or without safety clutch collets for tapping. The body of chuck has telescopic and floating functions, which can help correct the tapping position. There is also optional extended chuck. The user can choose its function and tapping size according to the work needs and work machine. More Quick Change Tapping Collet An accessory used with tapping spindle and tapping machine, suitable for taps with round and four corners, stirring knives and other tools. It can be subdivided into torsion collets, rigid non-torque collets, and fixed collets. There are various specifications and sizes to choose from. It is a locking device that clamps a tool or workpiece, and its function is to lock the connection between the tool and the spindle. Usually used on drilling and milling machines and machining centers. title: 用 Lbzip2 解壓縮 – Gea-Suan Lin's BLOG
text: Skip to content Gea-Suan Lin's BLOG 幹壞事是進步最大的原動力 用 Lbzip2 解壓縮 手上抓了幾個 .bz2 的檔案要 bzcat 出來 pipe 丟給 Perl script 跑，用系統預設的 bzip2 發現速度卡在解壓縮，而不是 Perl script... 用 parallel 與 bzip2 當關鍵字到 apt-cache 裡面找，有找到兩個套件： Lbzip2 與 Pbzip2 ，都裝起來後測解壓縮的功能，發現 Pbzip2 解壓縮時沒有辦法利用到多核心的優勢，而 Lbzip2 則是很順利的超過 100%，輸出結果讓 Perl script 也吃滿 CPU resource... 如果是壓縮時需要壓縮率，還是用 xz 就好... Chan Ping Chiu Co-Artistic Director - Vee Leong Past Productions Cattle Depot Theatre Contemporary Writing for Theatre From Stage to Reality: Theatre Exploration Project Table To-gather Transportation Guide On & On Theatre workshop 前進進戲劇工作坊 前進進戲劇工作坊，現為香港藝術發展局資助的專業戲劇團體。業界人士都會簡稱我們為「前進進」。1998年成立之初，劇團以青年劇場為本，當時一位友人的幼兒工作坊名叫「慢慢走」，我們因而受到啟發，探索之路有如孩童慢走至成長邁步，便把劇團命名為「前進進」。 1998年，前進進進駐北角油街藝術村，是本地最早建立自主表演空間的藝術組織之一。2001年，前進進遷入土瓜灣牛棚藝術村，修建首個由藝團獨立營運的公開表演場地──牛棚劇場。 成立初期，前進進以戲劇教育、實驗創作和劇場營運三線並進，不囿於傳統戲劇範疇，追求跨界合作、多元創意，強調藝術活動對社會、文化和歷史的承擔。合作者包括教育工作者、視藝工作者、音樂人、行為藝術家、文化人、設計師等等。 1998-2005年為前進進的創始階段，我們推出的活動計劃包括：「i-D兒女系列」、「小小劇場運動」、「新銳導演系列」、「導演創作室」、陳炳釗個人創作系列，等等。活動形式包括工作坊、藝術沙龍、社區巡迴、展覽、劇場及非劇場演出。 2006年，前進進首度推出「牛棚劇季」，以四季為座標製作定期劇目，以牛棚劇場為基地，以實驗製作為主軸，文化交流計劃為副，成功地把牛棚劇場打造成一個具有強烈創作氛圍的文化場所。2006-2011年為前進進的成熟發展期。除了演出數量飛躍增長外，前進進獨立編輯的網上雜誌《牛棚劇訊》則標誌著這一階段奔放流動的文化氣息。 前進進在2012年推出「新文本運動」，高舉「關懷時代，形式創新」的創作信念，結合多年來的探索，借鏡歐洲思潮，嘗試把新文本(New Writing for Contemporary Theatre)的美學理念和藝術視野，推介至香港劇場，並進行本土轉化。持續至今的新文本運動結合了劇本創作、劇場演出、普及推廣、研究、翻譯及出版，在香港劇壇營造了一股熾熱的創作氣氛。 2018年，我們以密集的活動和演出，迎來二十周年紀念的到臨。承接「新文本運動」的成果，繼續把新文本的內涵移植到我們的土壤裡，並推出1一系列卓越的本土創作。同時，我們亦積極研釀更多當代劇場的可能性。2022 年，推出「 真實劇場探索計劃 」，以一系列的創作尋探劇場與真實的關係。2023年，開展「 三年共桌 」共修計劃，聚合多位新銳創作人，在三年裏通過持續的觀摩交流、沙龍活動、學習班、探索及演出計劃，期望在集體開墾的土壤上滋養多元豐富的對話與創作。 圖：《月明星稀》(2024) Contact Us 九龍馬頭角道63號牛棚藝術村7號單位 Unit 7, Cattle Depot Artist Village, Ma Tau Kok Road, Kowloon ​電話 Tel：2503 1630 電郵 Email：programme@onandon.org.hk Newsletter Block This newsletter signup form needs a storage option. PRE-WEDDING 婚紗攝影 我們紀錄的不只是那最美的一刻 還有當時的笑容、當時的回憶及情感 透過手中的照片 找到那最純粹的愛 瞭解更多... LIFE PHOTO 各式寫真 生命的每個過程、每個階段 都值得被記錄下來 用影像，去回味每個珍貴的時刻 讓愛能夠延續下去 瞭解更多... PET 寵物寫真 『因為愛，所以與眾不同』 每一位毛小孩都是獨一無二的存在 就像人一樣，有不同的個性與特色 了解與相處 找出他最美好而特別的一面 瞭解更多... 2023042107475392 2023042107480186 2023042107480825 2023042107481418 202304210748202 婚禮紀錄 觀看更多 自助婚紗 觀看更多 寵物寫真 觀看更多 各式寫真 觀看更多 About Us 「我是個笑點、哭點都很低的攝影師！」 也正因為如此，任何細微的眼神、不經意動作所敘說的故事，我都會發現而記錄下來 我希望你能告訴我你心目中的婚禮是什麼樣子，聊聊你們的生活 一起思考著如何讓婚禮更臻完美，一起完成一場夢想 最後，用我的鏡頭捕捉當天每一個細節、每一份動人的情緒 再把這份回憶送達你的手上，保存一輩子 TEAM 團隊成員 團隊總監 大嘴 攝影師 小楓 攝影師 小秋 攝影師 小悅 攝影師 小樂 新人好評 PTT、婚禮論壇熱門推薦攝影師 熱情專業 親友讚賞大推的婚攝-大嘴 情！宴客前會主動約我們見面聊聊我們想要拍攝的重點，大嘴的事前表單問題很仔細，連有沒有特別需要避開或者不喜歡什麼特別要拍什麼都可以寫上去，也會確認有沒有需要他幫忙引導儀式進行，雖然我們有請會館協助弄文定儀式，大嘴還是不厭其煩的和我們再次說明文定儀式會有的流程及意義～希望我們先聽過再上工（? 比較不會因為第一次弄而一臉茫然XD也從奉茶到掛金飾各種動作都實際演繹一遍給我們看過～...Read More 大推的婚紗照-大嘴 大嘴會適時的說出我覺得很好笑的話來讓新人放鬆心情，並且會提醒新人要怎麼笑會更好看等等，也記得當初群組裡新人說喜歡的風格(我自已經忘記了...)最重要的是大嘴習慣拍到一個段落之後給新人確認一下照片，當下真的有被毛片嚇到，也太漂亮了吧，然後就會形成一個POSITIVE FEEDBACK，越拍越開心~~不論新郎新娘都能被拍得很好看(未婚夫的獨照好看到我一直懷疑他有偷塞錢給大嘴)...Read More 用生命拍照的婚攝-大嘴 整天下來，大嘴的主控力、親和力、攝影能力都超佳，完全超乎了我對婚攝的想像 (有很多婚攝都很無聊，但大嘴超活潑)，我覺得，身為一個小有名氣的攝影師，還能對每一次的工作，這麼的有熱情，這麼的投入，真的是令人很佩服，拍照的光線、角度也都抓的很棒...Read More 把婚禮現場拍的像婚紗照一樣美麗!!! 記得收到那天，迫不急待插USB、打開電腦細細瀏覽，發現大嘴很會捕捉表情細節、對環境光線管理能力特別厲害，不管是定點拍還是抓拍，每個人的臉好像上了粉、白嫩透亮，笑容洋溢著。家人和親友工作人員「一心一意專注為你」的樣子也被記錄下來。謝謝大嘴團隊完整了我2/6 訂婚喜宴的幸福樣貌...Read More 婚攝大嘴～親切又細心！(圖多文長 我每次敲大嘴問問題時，他如果正在忙，會先跟我說他晚點回，不會讓訊息被不讀不回，而且他都會傾聽新娘的意見，然後提供專業的角度及看法；當老師聽出我這傢伙絲毫沒有聽進去，耳根子超硬的時候，他會用別的切入點，肯定我並給予配套措施，最後讓新娘也可以放心的正面回答...Read More 自然風格婚紗照-攝影大嘴 喜歡美式清新風格與自然互動的我們，看到學姐們的推薦文章中，大嘴一張張有愛的婚紗照作品，便毫不猶豫的選擇大嘴，為我們留下愛的紀錄。多虧有大嘴的引導，不擅長拍照的我們，也能自在的呈現我們的相處方式。拍攝氣氛非常好，我們玩得很開心，也拍出好多瘋狂大笑的照片，而這就是我們平常相處最自然的樣態，也是我們想記錄在婚紗照中的模樣。...Read More WEDDING 婚禮攝影作品 《婚攝》舜武 + 煜璇｜台北晶華 《婚攝》培榮 + 庭薇｜台北晶華 《婚攝》哲誠 + 佩玲｜茹曦酒店 READ MORE PRE-WEDDING 婚紗攝影作品 《自助婚紗》瑩 《自助婚紗》尚謀+芮禎 《自助婚紗》 乃毅+又祺 READ MORE LIFE PHOTO 各式寫真作品 親子寫真-IVY 孕婦寫真-思涵 孕婦寫真-玉滿 READ MORE PET 寵物寫真作品 柴犬-梨梨 矇眼貂-噗啾 雪納瑞-Houya READ MORE SERVICE 【 服務特色 】 【1. 自然透亮的色調，雋永不退流行】 複雜且濃郁的電影底片色調，可能當下看了很喜歡 但隨著時間的推移、流行的不同 當過了幾年再拿出來看，你的喜好可能就不會一樣 我們堅持在保留原始的色調基礎上 做更精緻的調色處理，更細緻的燈光功夫 這些動人的照片 無論你在多少年後拿出來看 永遠能夠清晰的看出每一個細節 【2. 簡單明瞭，且透明的計價方式】 我們價格都是公開透明，全部公開在網站上 你永遠不用擔心問到的價錢比別人貴 也不用花時間填個單才能夠知道拍攝要多少錢 另外我們計價方式也很簡單 是單純以拍攝時間計價 無論你有一二三四個儀式 或是當天長輩突然加個奉茶之類的 都不影響價格唷 【3. 固定的課程訓練，擁有穩定的人才】 大嘴有開設婚禮攝影的課程 教導相關的專業知識，培訓團隊人才 助理攝影師皆值得信賴 不用擔心遇到不熟悉濫竽充數的PT攝影師 【4. 雙機拍攝，捕捉更多畫面】 每次拍攝除攝影師之外 更會攜帶一名團隊培訓的助理攝影師一同拍攝 讓每個美好的瞬間，可以有更多不同角度的照片 【5. 類婚紗、全家福，通通免加價】 只要當天有任何的空檔時間 你想要拍類婚紗、全家福 甚至你有小孩想拍親子寫真 通通不用加價唷！ 【６. 了解您的需求，打造專屬的婚禮】 在婚禮前夕，我們會約時間與您溝通拍攝的細節 我們了解每對新人重視的東西都不一樣 應該客製化傾聽新人的需求 而不是用SOP來拍攝每一對新人 【７. 捕捉每一刻動人的瞬間】 婚禮攝影的本質 在於紀錄當天每一個精采的瞬間，每一個動人的情緒 我們除了類婚紗真的很美之外 你可以看到我們的作品 每一張人物的表情都非常生動 而每一張照片串成一個故事之後 就算你沒有參與當天的過程 也能透過照片，感受到當下的任何感受 【8. 多重準備，任何狀況都可以完成工作】 我們使用的是NIKON專業全片幅機種 每次拍攝至少攜帶三台以上的專業相機 避免相機損壞無法工作 檔案也會多重備份，至少存儲在4個硬碟上 另有1份冷儲存，避免勒索軟體 大嘴工作室 我們提供的服務包含婚禮紀錄、自助婚紗、寵物寫真、孕婦寫真等服務，我們記錄每一個感動的瞬間， 擅長情感的捕捉，為PTT熱門推薦的職業婚禮攝影師，價格及契約書皆透明公開，安心有保障 統一編號：72706456 © 2023 婚攝大嘴工作室 – 婚禮紀錄|自助婚紗|台北婚攝推薦

title: Dubrovnik makes history as first WP4 champions are crowned
text: Skip to main content LIVE COMPETITIONS View All Show Less Home United by Water GALLERY BY SONY WATCH DEVELOPMENT MASTERS FOUNDATION AQIU GMS Home SPORTS SWIMMING WATER POLO DIVING ARTISTIC SWIMMING OPEN WATER SWIMMING HIGH DIVING LATEST NEWS VIDEOS PHOTOS CALENDAR RESULTS ATHLETES SEARCH ATHLETES ATHLETE SERVICES SHOP MORE ABOUT US CAREERS STRUCTURE RULES PARTNERS MEMBERS MEDIA label.toggleMobileNavigation SPORTS SPORTS SWIMMING WATER POLO DIVING ARTISTIC SWIMMING OPEN WATER SWIMMING HIGH DIVING LATEST LATEST NEWS VIDEOS PHOTOS CALENDAR RESULTS ATHLETES ATHLETES SEARCH ATHLETES ATHLETE SERVICES SHOP MORE MORE ABOUT US CAREERS STRUCTURE RULES PARTNERS MEMBERS MEDIA GALLERY BY SONY WATCH DEVELOPMENT MASTERS FOUNDATION AQIU GMS Water Polo September 9, 2026, 11:47 #Water Polo | First WP4 Champions crowned in Dubrovnik Dubrovnik makes history as first WP4 champions are crowned Written by: World Aquatics Communications Department Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics A new chapter in World Aquatics and Water Polo history was written in Dubrovnik this week as the inaugural World Aquatics Water Polo 4x4 (WP4) Open Championships delivered seven days of fast-paced action, dramatic finishes and the format’s first champions. The tournament, staged from 31 August to 6 September 2026, represented the first global championship for WP4. The format has been designed to offer a faster and more accessible version of water polo, built around speed and decisive moments, with fewer players, and a smaller and more transportable playing area. The fast and attacking nature of WP4 was on full show throughout the week, with 1,865 goals scored across the 84 men's and women's matches - an average of more than 22 goals per game . Dubrovnik proved to be a fantastic setting for the debut event. With Croatia's water polo tradition and spectacular Old Harbour providing the backdrop, the event combined a distinctive location with a format that has quickly established its own identity. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics USA and Spain make history In the women's event, the United States progressed to the final without dropping a single set and continued this dominant form by defeating Spain 3-0 in the gold-medal match. Taking the first set 4-1, USA then overcame a spirited fightback by Spain to win a close second set thanks to two late goals by Jewel Roemer. They then sealed their perfect campaign by claiming the third set amid jubilant scenes. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics Elsewhere, Russia secured the bronze medal in the women’s competition with a convincing 3-0 victory over Australia. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics The USA’s Ryann Neushul was named Women's Most Valuable Player with 36 goals across seven matches, highlighting her role as one of her team’s most consistent and dangerous attackers. Spain's Mariona Terre received the Best Goalkeeper award, rewarded for her decisive shot-stopping and her ability to keep Spain in tight matches during their campaign. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics The men's championship produced a dramatic conclusion with Spain overcoming Russia to become the first men's WP4 world champions. Four tightly contested sets sent the first ever men's WP4 final to a penalty shootout. With momentum on their side following a late leveller in the fourth set, Spain emerged victorious in the shootout 3-1, to claim a historic gold medal with a 3-2 win. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics Hosts Croatia also had reason to celebrate on the final day, defeating Serbia 3-0 in front of a passionate local crowd at the Old Harbour to claim the bronze medal. Image Source: Aniko Kovacs / World Aquatics With an impressive field of standout performances throughout the week in the men’s competition, the goalscoring exploits and attacking threat of Croatia's Roko Peliacaric was rewarded, as he was named Men's Most Valuable Player (MVP). Didac Garcia of Spain won the Best Goalkeeper award, thanks notably to his performance in the final, making nine saves as his team secured the gold medal. Looking forward to the future of WP4 World Aquatics President Husain Al Musallam hailed the success of the inaugural edition. “The inaugural World Aquatics WP4 Open Championships have been an important milestone for our sport. Dubrovnik has provided a magnificent stage for the first edition, and we have seen exactly what this new format can offer – speed, intensity, creativity, and tremendous excitement for spectators,” By President Husain Al Musallam President Al Musallam said. “Congratulations to Spain and the United States on becoming our first champions, and we extend our thanks to the coaches, support staff, officials, organisers and the city of Dubrovnik who have contributed to this historic event. The enthusiasm we have seen throughout the week gives us great confidence for the future of WP4 and its potential to bring the sport to new spectators around the world.” Image Source: Aniko Kova

title: 404 - PAGE NOT FOUND
text: ERROR 404 - PAGE NOT FOUND Why am I seeing this page? 404 means the file is not found. If you have already uploaded the file then the name may be misspelled or it is in a different folder. Other Possible Causes You may get a 404 error for images because you have Hot Link Protection turned on and the domain is not on the list of authorized domains. If you go to your temporary url (http://ip/~username/) and get this error, there maybe a problem with the rule set stored in an .htaccess file. You can try renaming that file to .htaccess-backup and refreshing the site to see if that resolves the issue. It is also possible that you have inadvertently deleted your document root or the your account may need to be recreated. Either way, please contact your web host immediately. Are you using WordPress? See the Section on 404 errors after clicking a link in WordPress. How to find the correct spelling and folder Missing or Broken Files When you get a 404 error be sure to check the URL that you are attempting to use in your browser.This tells the server what resource it should attempt to request. http://example.com/example/Example/help.html In this example the file must be in public_html/example/Example/ Notice that the CaSe is important in this example. On platforms that enforce case-sensitivity e xample and E xample are not the same locations. For addon domains, the file must be in public_html/addondomain.com/example/Example/ and the names are case-sensitive. Broken Image When you have a missing image on your site you may see a box on your page with with a red X where the image is missing. Right click on the X and choose Properties. The properties will tell you the path and file name that cannot be found. This varies by browser, if you do not see a box on your page with a red X try right clicking on the page, then select View Page Info, and goto the Media Tab. http://example.com/cgi-sys/images/banner.PNG In this example the image file must be in public_html/cgi-sys/images/ Notice that the CaSe is important in this example. On platforms that enforce case-sensitivity PNG and png are not the same locations. 404 Errors After Clicking WordPress Links When working with WordPress, 404 Page Not Found errors can often occur when a new theme has been activated or when the rewrite rules in the .htaccess file have been altered. When you encounter a 404 error in WordPress, you have two options for correcting it. Option 1: Correct the Permalinks Log in to WordPress. From the left-hand navigation menu in WordPress, click Settings > Permalinks (Note the current setting. If you are using a custom structure, copy or save the custom structure somewhere.) Select Default . Click Save Settings . Change the settings back to the previous configuration (before you selected Default). Put the custom structure back if you had one. Click Save Settings . This will reset the permalinks and fix the issue in many cases. If this doesn't work, you may need to edit your .htaccess file directly. Option 2: Modify the .htaccess File Add the following snippet of code to the top of your .htaccess file: # BEGIN WordPress <IfModule mod_rewrite.c> RewriteEngine On RewriteBase / RewriteRule ^index.php$ - [L] RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d RewriteRule . /index.php [L] </IfModule> # End WordPress If your blog is showing the wrong domain name in links, redirecting to another site, or is missing images and style, these are all usually related to the same problem: you have the wrong domain name configured in your WordPress blog. How to modify your .htaccess file The .htaccess file contains directives (instructions) that tell the server how to behave in certain scenarios and directly affect how your website functions. Redirects and rewriting URLs are two very common directives found in a .htaccess file, and many scripts such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla and Magento add directives to the .htaccess so those scripts can function. It is possible that you may need to edit the .htaccess file at some point, for various reasons.This section covers how to edit the file in cPanel, but not what may need to be changed.(You may need to consult other articles and resources for that information.) There are Many Ways to Edit a .htaccess File Edit the file on your computer and upload it to the server via FTP Use an FTP program's Edit Mode Use SSH and a text editor Use the File Manager in cPanel The easiest way to edit a .htaccess file for most people is through the File Manager in cPanel. How to Edit .htaccess files in cPanel's File Manager Before you do anything, it is suggested that you backup your website so that you can revert back to a previous version if something goes wrong. Open the File Manager Log into cPanel. In the Files section, click on the File Manager icon. Check the box for Document Root for and select the domain name you wish to access from the drop-down menu. Make sure Show Hidden Files (dotfiles) " is checked. Click Go . The

title: The Curious Traveler's Diary – Trip Travel
text: Skip to content The Curious Traveler's Diary Trip Travel Canada Australia Greece America Puerto Vallarta Sweden Portugal Singapore Poland Canada Canada Immigration Guide for Chinese Migrants Overview Canada is one of the most popular destinations for Chinese migrants due to its high quality of life, stable economy, and immigrant-friendly policies. This guide provides key information on visa options, cost of living, employment, real estate, and other essential aspects to facilitate your migration journey. 1. Visa and Immigration Requirements Common Visa Categories for Chinese Migrants Express Entry Program : Points-based immigration system for skilled workers. Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) : Each province selects skilled workers based on local labor market needs. Family Sponsorship : For spouses, parents, and dependents of Canadian citizens or permanent residents. Study Permit : For international students pursuing education in Canada. Work Permits : LMIA-Based Work Permit : Requires a job offer from a Canadian employer. Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) : Allows international graduates to gain work experience in Canada. Start-up Visa : For entrepreneurs who receive support from designated organizations. Self-Employed Visa : For individuals with relevant experience in cultural, artistic, or athletic activities. Permanent Residency and Citizenship Permanent Residency (PR) can be obtained through Express Entry, PNP, or other economic immigration programs. PR holders can apply for Canadian citizenship after 3 years of residency within a 5-year period. Dual citizenship is allowed for Chinese migrants who qualify. 2. Cost of Living in Canada Canada’s cost of living varies by province, with major cities like Toronto and Vancouver being more expensive, while smaller cities offer more affordable living options. Average Monthly Expenses (2024 Estimates) Category Cost (CAD) Rent (1-bedroom in city center) $1,500 – $3,000 Utilities $100 – $250 Food $400 – $800 Transportation $100 – $200 Health Insurance Free for PR holders, $50 – $200 for others 3. Employment Opportunities Top Industries for Chinese Migrants Technology & IT (Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal) Healthcare & Nursing (Nationwide demand) Engineering & Construction Finance & Banking (Toronto, Calgary) Education & Research Hospitality & Tourism Work Authorization & Labor Market Most work permits require a job offer and employer sponsorship. Express Entry candidates with job offers receive additional points. The minimum wage varies by province but is generally between $14 – $16 CAD per hour . 4. Housing & Real Estate in Canada Housing prices in Canada vary significantly by region. Toronto and Vancouver are among the most expensive cities, while Calgary, Edmonton, and Halifax offer more affordable housing options. Types of Housing Available Condos : Common in urban areas, offering modern amenities. Detached Houses : Larger homes with private land, more expensive. Townhouses : A balance between condos and detached homes, often in suburban areas. Apartments : Available for both rental and ownership. Average Home Prices by Region (2024 Estimates) City Median Home Price (CAD) Toronto $900,000 – $1,500,000 Vancouver $1,000,000 – $2,000,000 Calgary $500,000 – $800,000 Montreal $400,000 – $700,000 Halifax $350,000 – $600,000 For more details, explore Canada real estate options that fit your budget and lifestyle. 5. Cultural Integration & Community Support Chinese-Canadian Communities : Large Chinese populations in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Cultural Adjustment : Differences in work culture, language, and lifestyle. Support Networks : WeChat groups, Chinese associations, and local expat communities provide assistance. 6. Education System Public Schools : Free for residents, but quality varies by province. Private Schools : More expensive but offer specialized curriculums. Higher Education : Canada is home to top universities such as the University of Toronto, McGill University, and the University of British Columbia. 7. Healthcare & Insurance Universal Healthcare System : Available to PR holders and citizens. Provincial Healthcare Plans : Each province has its own healthcare coverage. Private Health Insurance : Required for many temporary visa holders. 8. Safety & Legal Considerations Crime Rates : Generally low, but varies by neighborhood. Legal Documentation : Always maintain valid visa and residency documents. Emergency Numbers : 911 for police, fire, and medical assistance. Conclusion Canada offers excellent opportunities for Chinese migrants in terms of employment, education, and quality of life. Proper planning in terms of visa selection, job search, and real estate investment is essential for a smooth transition. Exploring Canada real estate options early can help in securing a comfortable home. For more details, consult official Canadian immigration resources and legal experts. We devote significant resources to ensure that our website and room booking pages are easier to use and more accessible for individuals with disabilities, based on the strong belief that everyone has the right to live with dignity, equality, comfort, and independence. Along with our partners, we continuously strive to improve the accessibility of our website and the pages for booking rooms and/or purchasing additional products and services related to the stay. We firmly believe it is our collective moral obligation to allow seamless, accessible, and unhindered use, even for those of us with disabilities. In our ongoing efforts to improve and consistently address accessibility issues, we regularly scan all web pages using accessibility scanners provided by third-party commercial partners to identify and fix any potential accessibility barriers on our site. Despite our efforts to make all our web pages and content fully accessible, some content may not yet have been fully adapted to the strictest accessibility standards. This may be due to not having yet found or implemented the most appropriate technological solution. title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... Anubis could not load its JavaScript. The server may be overloaded. Please reload the page to try again. You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. Protected by BotStopper From Techaro . Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

title: IIS 10.0 Detailed Error - 404.0 - Not Found
text: HTTP Error 404.0 - Not Found The resource you are looking for has been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable. Most likely causes: The directory or file specified does not exist on the Web server. The URL contains a typographical error. A custom filter or module, such as URLScan, restricts access to the file. Things you can try: Create the content on the Web server. Review the browser URL. Create a tracing rule to track failed requests for this HTTP status code and see which module is calling SetStatus. title: How to Balance Work and Study for Aged Care Professionals in Australia | EDA
text: How to Balance Work and Study for Aged Care Professionals in Australia | EDA How to Balance Work and Study for Aged Care Professionals in Australia EDA Home (current) About Us Terms and Conditions Privacy Policy How to Balance Work and Study for Aged Care Professionals in Australia 2026-09-20 Identify Priorities Exploring aged care courses online is an essential step for those considering a career in healthcare, especially within Brisbane's burgeoning community services sector. As healthcare professionals, it's important to reflect on your current responsibilities and discern how they might align with your aspirations. Assessing work and study demands can illuminate the balance you need for both professional growth and personal fulfilment. Assess Work and Study Demands Begin with a thorough examination of your daily commitments. If you're in Brisbane, you'll find insightful resources at healthcare workshops at Queensland University of Technology. These sessions can provide clarity about integrating new knowledge with your current skill set. The proximity to aged care facilities near South Bank allows easy access to real-world scenarios and flexible courses, ensuring you can manage study alongside existing roles effectively. Define Personal Goals Reflect on where you'd like to see yourself in the next few years. Whether it's advancing technology solutions for aged care or securing a pivotal role within the Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital, understanding your aspirations aids in selecting the right aged care courses to elevate your career. Consider what new skills and certifications are necessary for achieving these goals. Establish Clear Objectives Transform your ambitions into actionable steps. With a clear understanding of your objectives, you can select courses that not only fit within your professional calendar but also enrich your expertise. Whether you're aiming to enhance your consultancy offerings or venture into direct patient care, clarity will help in choosing courses that bolster both your career and intellectual curiosity. Develop a Schedule Allocate Time Blocks One critical aspect of successfully managing career development in healthcare, especially when aiming to gain certifications like the cert 3 in individual support or a diploma of community services , is effective scheduling. As someone immersed in the complexities of both IT consultations and healthcare, I find meticulous time management indispensable. Begin by designating specific time blocks for study, work, and professional development. For instance, mornings could focus on client work, while afternoons are reserved for exploring healthcare solutions. This practice supports staying on track and avoids conflicts between professional responsibilities and educational pursuits. Balance Work and Classes Balancing work and classes is an art form, especially in a dynamic city like Brisbane, home to prominent healthcare hubs such as the Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital. It's essential to harmonise your work commitments and educational journeys, especially when involved with aged care facilities near South Bank. Consider enrolling in evening classes or online courses that allow flexibility. Prioritise assignments and projects according to deadlines and importance, ensuring critical tasks align with work schedules to maintain a stable equilibrium. Include Rest and Leisure Incorporating rest and leisure into your schedule is not merely beneficial; it’s essential in the journey towards obtaining healthcare certifications. After immersing yourself in workshops at Queensland University of Technology or tackling intense learning modules, allocate time to unwind. Engage in activities like walking along the Brisbane River or spending quality time with loved ones. Integrating rest into your schedule ensures you remain rejuvenated and focused on your career aspirations in healthcare. Leverage Technology Use Productivity Apps In our bustling Brisbane environment, efficiently juggling various commitments is essential, and productivity apps can be game-changers. As someone who spends a fair share of their time across different platforms like tech forums and webinars, I've seen how apps such as Trello and Asana streamline task management. By keeping your projects organised, these tools help ensure that you don’t miss out on essential activities, be it managing your consultancy projects or keeping abreast of healthcare certifications such as cert 3 childcare . These apps offer features that allow tracking deadlines, setting reminders, and collaborating with peers who might be scattered across the globe. Embrace Online Learning With the digital age reshaping education, childcare courses online have become more accessible than ever. This shift is particularly beneficial if you're leaning into community services while managing tech consultancy work. Přinášíme informace o dopravních omezeních. Po dobu konání Pálavského vinobraní ve dnech 11. až 13. září 2026 bude centrum města (a blízké okolí), včetně ulic přilehlých k lokalitě amfiteátr zcela uzavřeny. Před konáním vinobraní byly po městě rozmístěny dopravní značky, které vás budou informovat o aktuálních změnách v dopravě. Žádáme o respektování dopravního značení. PARKOVÁNÍ: Od čtvrtka 10. září platí zákaz stání v prostoru před Dietrichsteinskou hrobkou, na Náměstí, Kostelním náměstí, při vjezdu do zámku, na parkovišti u cukrárny v ulici Alfonse Muchy, v ulici Svobody, částečně v ulici AlfonseMuchy. Pro obyvatele Kostelního náměstí, Náměstí, Svobody a Alfonse Muchy je od středy 9. září 20.00 hodin do neděle 13. září vyhrazeno parkoviště na ul. Komenského pro občany s platným parkovacím oprávněním vydaným společností TEDOS. Obyvatelům ulic Kapucínská a Vrchlického je povolen vjezd do jejich ulic. V případě, že občané ulic Kapucínská a Vrchlického budou chtít vjet až za budovu Centra volného času, je potřeba se od pátku 14.00 hodin prokázat také s platnou vstupenkou na Pálavské vinobraní. UZAVÍRKY, OMEZENÍ DOPRAVY: Části města budou plně uzavřeny od pátku 11. září od 11.00 hodin do neděle 13. září. Omezení se bude týkat ulic – Vinohrady, Lidická, Na Jámě, Střelnická, Kozí hrádek, Česká. Částečně pak budou uzavřeny ulice Pavlovská (od křižovatky se Školní po Náměstí), ulice Svobody, Brněnská (od Náměstí po křižovatku Na Jámě), Alfonse Muchy (od Náměstí po křižovatku Vídeňská, dále od Náměstí po provozovnu Nitka). Z důvodu příprav bude od čtvrtka 10. září do pátku 11. září do 15.00 hodin uzavřen celý areál amfiteátru, následně bude otevřen pro veřejnost s platnou vstupenkou Pálavského vinobraní. Od středy 9. září do úterý 15. září z důvodu příprav a konání akce není možné využívat sportovní aktivity na zpevněné ploše v areálu amfiteátru. Další dočasné změny ve stávající dopravě se budou týkat ulice Mlýnská, která bude průjezdná pouze v jednom směru, a to od ulice Česká. Dočasný zákaz vjezdu bude platit pro všechna vozidla vyjma tamních obyvatel a automobilů se speciálním volným vjezdem. Vjezd vozidel k České poště je možný do pátku 11. září do 11 hodin. VSTUP DO UZAVŘENÝCH ZÓN: Obča

title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... Anubis could not load its JavaScript. The server may be overloaded. Please reload the page to try again. You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. From bustling tech startups to innovative small businesses, the quest for funding that aligns with sustainable values is evident. For instance, green business loans offer pathways for entrepreneurs to invest in their company's ecological future without leaning on traditional funding sources. Options such as business loan unsecured facilities are possible, providing flexibility crucial for tech-driven entities focused on rapid growth and innovative solutions. Whether it's transitioning to eco-friendly technology or expanding your company's sustainable operations, choosing the right loan type is pivotal. Key benefits include access to government incentives for green projects and the opportunity to collaborate with institutions championing sustainability strategies. Ultimately, seeking eco-friendly financing is not merely an operational decision but a strategic move towards long-term business resilience through sustainable growth. Evaluating Lender Credibility Identifying Trustworthy Lenders Navigating the maze of business lending in Australia, particularly in the tech scene, calls for a keen eye on evaluating lenders. As a professional who concerns oneself with the nuances of sustainable practices, like those found at the organic markets at Davies Park, the ability to discern their credibility can make or break your plans. A trustworthy lender should demonstrate both transparency in its lending criteria and a track record of reliability. Assessing Green Credentials In a city like Brisbane, where eco-conscious initiatives flourish, it’s paramount that lenders align with environmental values. Assessing a lender's green credentials involves examining their sustainability strategies and how they incorporate environmental considerations into lending processes. Look for any certifications or affiliations with green financing bodies as indicators of their commitment. This ensures that the financial backing procured not only supports your business's growth but also harmonizes with your dedication to sustainable innovation. Avoiding Hidden Pitfalls Hidden traps can turn seemingly favourable business loans into financial burdens. When engaging with lenders offering attractive terms, be vigilant about the fine print. Unexpected fees, locked-in interest rates, or restrictive covenants are pitfalls that can hinder your commercial expansion. Engage in discussions with the lender, asking explicit questions about any costs or clauses that could potentially affect your business. This careful scrutiny protects your venture and aligns with the proactive mindset of a sustainable business innovator. Strategic Application Process Crafting Your Green Pitch Securing funding to expand your tech startup in Australia while maintaining a sustainable focus requires a well-crafted pitch. When seeking a business loan Australia , connecting with lenders who appreciate your eco-conscious initiatives can be pivotal. Highlight the sustainability strategies your business employs, such as using environmentally friendly technologies or sourcing materials locally, which resonates with lenders committed to green finance. Focusing on these aspects strengthens your case, enhancing your potential to secure a favourable loan. TRI-CORE rendering engine Avant Browser has three Rendering Engines built-in: Trident, Gecko and Webkit, the engines behind Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox and Google Chrome respectively. Users can choose whatever their favorite engine as the default, and switch to others when the default cannot render a web page properly. And users can also define different rendering engine for each website in Avant Browser Options, so the rendering engine will be switched automatically when navigate to these websites. Multi-Processing/Anti-Freezing Multi-Processing design offers you a crash-free internet browsing experience and high reliability. When one tab fails, it won't freeze the browser or pull other pages down. The increasing usage of Ajax Technology in websites causes frequent freezing or crashes for most browsers. Avant Browser has developed a new technology to solve this problem, makes your surfing more fluent. Split view adds another dimension to Avant Browser’s customizable interface layout. Watching to online videos while reading the web news is a prime example of how Avant Browser’s split view interface can be used. Video Sniffer Avant Browser can detect the videos in the web page you are browsing, and let you download them with just one click. Detached Always on Top Browser Window Detached browser window can be set on top of all other Windows applications, you can drag the tab button out of the tab bar to detach a browser window. This allows you to watch YouTube or chat with friends while you are working on other applications, like Word, AutoCAD etc. AD/Popup Blocker AD/Popup Blocker can efficiently clean up the web pages by blocking Popup pages and filter Ad Content. You can block any annoy content by adding to the filter with the "Add to AD Black list" command in the Right-click Menu. Web Form Auto-Filler / Startup Login One of the most useful features of Avant browser today is the AutoFill feature with which users can login a website by a single click, just like opening a bookmark. Avant Browser 2012 has taken this feature a step further by providing users the option to automatically login to any sites when Avant Browser startup. All web pages saved under [AutoFill->Startup] folder will be logged in automatically when Avant Browser startup. Download Accelerator With Avant Browser's built-in multi-threaded downloader, it's much faster to download files from webpage or your email box, and much easier to manage download files. No Memory Leak As Ajax techniques become more popular, memory leak problem extensively exists in most browsers. Avant Browser new technology will release all occupied memory after a tab is closed. title: IIS 10.0 Detailed Error - 404.0 - Not Found
text: HTTP Error 404.0 - Not Found The resource you are looking for has been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable. Most likely causes: The directory or file specified does not exist on the Web server. The URL contains a typographical error. A custom filter or module, such as URLScan, restricts access to the file. Things you can try: Create the content on the Web server. Review the browser URL. Create a tracing rule to track failed requests for this HTTP status code and see which module is calling SetStatus. For more information about creating a tracing rule for failed requests, click here . Detailed Error Information: Module IIS Web Core Notification MapRequestHandler Handler StaticFile Error Code 0x80070002 Requested URL http://www.bjoshop.com:80/pur/xmyvktywzeisbtzbgmizvbwdz Physical Path C:\inetpub\websites\bjoshop.com\wwwroot\pur\xmyvktywzeisbtzbgmizvbwdz Logon Method Anonymous Logon User Anonymous More Information: This error means that the file or directory does not exist on the server. title: Couchsurfing
text: Login Travel. Connect . Live. Travel. Connect . Live. Millions of travelers. Endless connections. Millions of travelers. Endless connections. One App. Search for "Barcelona, Spain" Anywhere but here Hosts Nearby Current Location Travelers Nearby Events this Weekend Download the Mobile App Scan the QR code to download the app and get started App Store Google Play One Platform, The Whole Journey Everything on Couchsurfing is made by locals and travelers like you Hosts Stay with Locals, For Free Somewhere in 200,000+ cities, someone's ready to show you around. Real homes. Real hosts. Real travel. Locations Every City, Through Local Eyes Location pages with live weather, nearby hosts, travelers, and what's happening this week. Events Never Miss an Event in Town Community Find Friends Before You Land Popular Locations City pages packed with hosts, events and travelers on the ground Search Locations France Paris 493k Hosts 430 Events Colombia Bogotá 153k Hosts 120 Events United Arab Emirates Dubai 126k Hosts 35 Events Search Locations Happening Soon See what’s happening in the city before you arrive Search Events Hosts with Open Doors Verified members, real references. See who’s welcoming travelers like you Search Hosts Noah Toronto, Canada Very Likely to Recommend Bobby is warm, welcoming, and lives in a beautiful neighbourhood. Staying there felt like an experience in itself. He showed me all of New York. Hina Osaka, Japan Very Likely to Recommend Jullie made my first CS experience incredible. So warm, welcoming, and helpful in a crisis. Forever grateful for this kind soul. 💗 Louise Paris, France Very Likely to Recommend Amy is such a warm smiley person with great recommendations! Funny and interesting conversations. I got a truly authentic NYC experience! Search Hosts Your Feed is Personal Trip plans, city tips, and questions answered by people who are actually there. Join the conversation before you even pack. Peek at the Community Couchsurfing Popular posts The Truth About Solo Travel: It Gets Lonely Solo travel isn't about avoiding loneliness. It's about learning how to sit with it. In the quiet moments between hikes, conversations, and long drives, you start to understand what truly fulfills you... 566 152 50s Travellers Popular posts EUREKA! I discovered a new feature in the current version... Thanks to Carita, if you use your nickname in the post instead of your first name, you’ll receive an email saying “You were mentioned!” Perhaps you already knew this, but I didn’t, so I’m sharing it with you... 120 163 Couchsurfing Popular posts Studying Turkish A1 at Luis Ángel Arango I've been going to the Luis Ángel Arango Library regularly to practice and learn Turkish. My goal is to reach A1 level in a couple of months, and I think doing it with someone else could be a good idea. If anyone wants to join, you're welcome to message me! 334 81 Couchsurfing Popular posts Community Shout-out: Advice for Hosts Hosting is one of our favorite ways to experience Couchsurfing because there's something really special about welcoming a traveler into your space. Sharing your city, stories, meals, and moments you wouldn't have otherwise. You go from strangers to friends quicker than you can even imagine. There's a community of 14k members ready to answer questions, offer advice, and help you get started... 166 35 You Can Find Us In © 2026 Couchsurfing International Inc. Kennel Normanner indsamler og lagrer alle oplysninger, som du indtaster på vores hjemmesider, eller som du opgiver, når du benytter vores tjenester. Herudover indsamler vi oplysninger, som automatisk sendes til os fra dit udstyr. De oplysninger som vi indsamler kan omfatte, men er ikke begrænset til: Oplysninger, som du opgiver, når du bliver oprettet som kunde/bruger eller benytter de tjenester, vi stiller til rådighed Oplysninger, der opgives i forbindelse med korrespondance via vores websted eller korrespondance, der sendes til os Yderligere oplysninger, som du måtte opgive via sociale medier eller andre tredjepartstjenester. Udover de oplysninger, som du selv giver os, indsamler vi automatisk de oplysninger, der sendes til os fra din computer, mobilenhed eller andet udstyr. Disse oplysninger omfatter, men er ikke begrænset til: Oplysninger om din interaktion med vores websteder og tjenester, herunder, men ikke begrænset til, enheds-id, enhedstype, oplysninger om geoplacering, computer-og forbindelsesoplysninger, statistik om sidevisninger, trafik til og fra vores hjemmeside, henvisnings-URL-adresse, IP-adresse og standardweblogoplysninger, og Oplysninger indsamlet via cookies og lignende teknologier. Hvad bruger vi dine persondata til? Vi anvender de oplysninger vi har om dig til en række formål, herunder til at: Behandle dine forespørgsler og ordrer Levere produkter, tjenester, service og kundesupport til dig Forbedre vores produkter, tjenester, service og hjemmesider Muliggøre din brug af vores tjenester og hjemmesider Tilpasse vores hjemmesider og tjenester til dig Få en bedre forståelse af, hvordan vores hjemmesider bruges, så vi kan forbedre dem Sende dig forretningsmæssige oplysninger, herunder ordrebekræftelser, fakturaer mv Sende dig nyhedsbreve og markedsføring pr. e-info, hvis du har afgivet samtykket Foretage markedsundersøgelser om vores kunder, deres interesser, om tendenser og kundeadfærd Administrere, diagnosticere og udbedre problemer på vores hjemmesider Forhindre eller fastslå ulovlig aktivitet ellerbeskytte eller håndhæve rettigheder, og Undgå eller imødegå sikkerhedsbrud. Vi behandler og opbevarer kun data om dig, der er nødvendige, relevante og tilstrækkelige til at opfylde de formål, som er nævnt ovenfor. Vi lagrer ikke persondata længere end tilladt ved lov og sletter persondata, når de ikke længere er nødvendige til ovennævnte formål. Fitness Galeri Event dan Promo Lean Science Klub Ade Rai Lahir dengan nama I Gusti Agung Rai Kusuma Yudha pada tanggal 6 Mei 1970 di Jakarta, Ade Rai tumbuh sebagai seorang anak yang kurus dengan minat yang besar pada berbagai aktivitas olahraga. Pada usia 10 tahun, Ade kecil hanya memiliki berat badan 25 kg. Bahkan hingga mencapai tinggi badannya seperti hari ini (183 cm) di usia remaja, Ade Rai memiliki sosok yang kurus dengan berat badan hanya 55 kg. Aktivitas olahraga yang digeluti Ade Rai sejak kecil adalah karate, judo, hingga ke bulutangkis. Satu generasi dengan peraih medali perak Olympiade Barcelona 1992 Ardy B Wiranata, Ade Rai merasa bulutangkis bukan bidangnya, meskipun sempat meraih prestasi di tingkat DKI. Adalah aktivitas panco yang menariknya ke kegiatan angkat beban. Awalnya memang agar ingin terlihat lebih atletis dan menjadi kuat dalam aktivitas panco tersebut. Namun perkembangan ototnya yang pesat membuatnya sadar bahwa dirinya mungkin punya bakat di cabang olahraga binaraga. Sambil kuliah, Ade Rai mulai menekuni olahraga binaraga ini dengan lebih serius. Kejuaraan Pertama Tahun 1994, Ade Rai meraih Juara Nasional-nya yang pertama, di kelas berat. Gelar juara di kelas ini secara konsisten dipertahankan hingga tahun 2007. Tahun 1995, lulusan FISIP Universitas Indonesia jurusan Hubungan Internasional ini meraih prestasi Internasional pertamanya yakni Mr.Asia. Tahun 1996, Ade Rai sebagai seorang atlit drug-free seumur hidupnya tertarik mengikuti kejuaraan dunia drug-free paling bergengsi waktu itu, Musclemania World. Dengan persiapan yang baik, Ade Rai berhasil keluar sebagai juara Musclemania World ini di kelasnya (Berat Ringan) dan sebagai juara umum (Overall). Dengan modal kemenangan ini dan gelar juara nasional, Ade Rai dipercaya untuk mengikuti kompetisi multi-event Asia Tenggara (SEA Games) tahun 1997, di mana pada ajang tersebut ia meraih juara pertama dan menyumbangkan medali emas untuk Indonesia. Tahun 1998, Ade Rai kembali mewakili Indonesia ke ajang Mr.Asia Pro/Am Classic dan meraih gelar juara di sana. Tahun 2000 adalah tahun terakhir Ade Rai bertanding di ajangbinaraga Internasional. Dua gelar Juara Dunia-Superbody Professional dan Musclemania Professional, diraih pada tahun yang sama. Gaya Hidup Binaraga Fisiknya yang tetap terbentuk berkat gaya hidup binaraga yang senantiasa dijalankan mendapat sorotan dan apresiasi pubik binaraga internasional. Setiap tahunnya, Ade Rai selalu diundang untuk menjadi bintang tamu (guest-poser) dalam berbagai kejuaraan binaraga natural dunia di Asia (Malaysia, Hong Kong), Eropa (Italia), Australia, maupun Amerika. Sejak itu, Ade Rai lebih memfokuskan diri dan aktivitasnya dalam mengembangkan gaya hidup fitnes dan olahraga binaraga di Indonesia. Putra ke-2 dari ayah (Alm.) I Gusti Agung Rai Widjaja dan ibu Selena Susanti ini merintis pusat kebugaran Klub Ade Rai yang hingga hari ini telah menjadi jaringan pusat kebugaran waralaba dengan 12 cabang di seluruh Indonesia. Waralaba/Franchise Laundry Kiloan Pertama di Indonesia! Simply Fresh Laundry adalah franchise/waralaba laundry kiloan pertama, terbesar dan tersebar di seluruh Indonesia. Telah buka 403 Outlet di 101 kota di Indonesia dari Aceh-Papua, di 2 Negara Ingin berbisnis laundry tapi bingung mulai dari mana? Punya modal untuk bisnis laundry tapi ragu dan khawatir dalam berinvestasi? Tepiskan hal diatas dari sekarang! Kami hadir sebagai solusi bagi Anda calon pebisnis laundry WhatsApp Instagram Brand Terkenal Simply Fresh Laundry sebagai franchise laundry kiloan terpopuler di Indonesia, hasil survey Nasional TOM 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018. Alat & Bahan Baku PILIHAN Mitra mendapatkan alat, bahan baku & perlengkapan Pilihan, dengan parfum laundry bersertifikat HALAL. Dapat Pelatihan & Dukungan Mitra mendapatkan pelatihan laundry lengkap & spesifik hingga siap buka (Grand Opening), serta dukungan selama masa kerjasama 5 tahun. Promosi Bersama Nasional Mitra mendapatkan dukungan promosi bersama nasional, mendapat media & sarana promosi, desain layout & setting layout. Simply Fresh Laundry adalah Waralaba Laundry kiloan Pertama dan Terbesar di Indonesia. Diawali di Yogyakarta tahun 2006 dari Gang kecil dengan hanya bermodalkan 1 mesin cuci, kini telah membuka 403 outlet di 101 kota di Indonesia dari Aceh sampai Papua. Atas prestasinya tersebut tak kurang 41 penghargaan diraihnya, diantaranya meraih Asia Pacific Entrepreneur Award 2010, Rekor MURI sebagai Waralaba Laundry Kiloan Pertama di Indonesia, Best Of The Best Award – ASEAN Winner 2026, dan IFBC (Info Franchise & Business Concept) Local Brand Award 2026. Kisah inspiratifnya di tayangkan diberbagai media cetak dan televisi, seperti RCTI, Metro TV, TV One, Kompas, dan lain-lain. Simply Fresh sebagai salah satu pelopor laundry kiloan semakin dekat untuk memberikan layanan terbaik kepada pelanggan. Atas upayanya tersebut, Simply Fresh Laundry menjadi franchise laundry kiloan terpopuler di Indonesia (hasil survey Nasional TOM 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017). Brand Simply Fresh semakin dikenal masyarakat luas, sehingga tingkat keberhasilan setiap outlet semakin tinggi, inilah keuntungan bergabung bersama Simply Fresh, membuat strategi promosi & informasi menjadi sangat efektif. Ditambah sistem pendampingan berkesinambungan dan STRATEGI RAHASIA BISNIS yang mendukung kesukesan, serta tim riset dan konsultan yang terus membuat Simply Fresh selalu bertumbuh. Mari bergabung dan SUKSES bersama kami! Kami sangat memahami akan pentingnya proses pencucian menggunakan konsep thaharah untuk menghasilkan pakaian yang bersih lagi suci sehingga dapat terbebas dari najis. Dimana kesucian sangat penting ketika menggunakan pakaian saat beribadah.
