Book Now The Hotel In the historical centre of Venice, near to the train station of Santa Lucia , to the Cruise Terminal/Maritime Station and the parking areas at Piazzale Roma , the hotel is practical, convenient and easy to reach, in a privileged position to visit all the main tourist attractions. The pastel colours, Venetian plaster-work and wall-lamps in Murano glass, the Hotel Carlton on the Grand Canal will enchant you with its refined elegance. All the 145 rooms are furnished in the Venetian style of the 1700s, equipped with every modern comfort. Free Wi-fi in all rooms and public areas. near the railway station Our hotel is conveniently located directly across from the train station, perfect for easy arrivals. 1 Restaurant & 2 café Our restaurant and cafés are ready to satisfy all your dining and beverage needs throughout your stay. Terrace with view of the Grand Canal Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of Venice's iconic Grand Canal from our exclusive rooftop terrace. meeting room Our fully equipped meeting room provides the perfect professional space for your business events in Venice. Excellent location (opposite Santa Lucia railway station). Extremely professional, welcoming and very kind staff. We appreciated the rooms and the comfort of the beds. The international buffet breakfast was also excellent. To top it off, they also gave us the option of storing our luggage. We had a wonderful stay... I highly recommend it. Alic Promontorio Absolutely gorgeous hotel right in front of canal across the train station and close to plenty of restaurants and cafe. Easily accessible to boats and gondola. Very safe location. Friendly staff in hotel. My daughter was surprised when they bring the bags to room and said that’s a royal treatment. Mahesh S (maheba) My stay in this large room was fantastic; the great view was definitely a highlight. The antique, classic setting gave it a charming vibe, and the location on the canal was simply perfect. However, be warned: it can get noisy early in the mornings due to the daily setup. Despite the early wake-up calls, I wouldn't trade the experience for anything. Overall, it was a memorable stay! Papazoolu Beautiful old hotel located on the Grand Canal. The staff was exceptional. Very pleasant and helpful. The rooms are very small but comfortable. The bed was perfect. The shower is tiny but doable. Very quiet at night. Excellent breakfast. Larry H. Our rooms Choose the room that best suits your needs The Hotel Carlton on the Grand Canal has 145 rooms, all furnished in the Venetian style of the 1700s, a touch of antiquity, typical of the most prestigious mansions of Venice, combined with the innovation of the most up-to-date comforts. We are most attentive to the needs of those who have walking difficulties: the hotel has 3 lifts and also 3 rooms on the ground floor each equipped with a spacious bathroom designed for the handicapped with a walk-in shower. Children are welcome and families can choose various, comfortable accommodation. Book Now Classic Rooms Cozy and welcoming, with 18th-century furnishings that create an authentic Venetian atmosphere. Ideal for those seeking charm and essential comfort. Available with double or twin beds, featuring Wi-Fi, air conditioning, private bathroom with exclusive courtesy set. The mind game How would the world, YOUR activity or YOU as a human being look like if no knowledge and experience were lost, but were passed on and understood intact to all subsequent generations who could build on it. The motto game E every idiot can learn from his own mistakes, but a true leader also learns from the mistakes of others. Purpose The purpose of Shindenkan's "Game Educations" is the mind game + Motto game put together, which would like to create a significantly better synergy effect for those who truly fulfilled the mind and motto game. We didn't go that straight way, but maybe you can? We did not have the same opportunities, knowledge and prerequisites to make the most optimal decisions. We would like to give you that, so that you don't make the same mistakes as us and your successes are consistent because you understand and recognize your mistakes and can therefore purposefully correct them - and teach others. We have collected it all on a modern golden platter, where we both use the modern communication tools and opportunities through games, from our greater and unique specialist knowledge within selected areas. Our knowledge and experience is from both international cultural historical world cultural heritage, to the Far East, Japanese, Chinese to European, Scandinavian and Danish. There are, of course, specialists in the world who, in each area, have theoretical or practical knowledge, who in some areas are at a higher level of competence than us. But we also know that we have a multi-track unique knowledge at the highest national and international level of knowledge, which has not been disseminated together before. We therefore hope to be able to make a difference for those who have the attitude and desire to do so, so that they are inspired and better informed than we were, and therefore have a chance not to make the same costly mistakes as we did. We have chosen 4 areas of Game Education which can be studied separately or together - press the bar to go to the game Daimyo County Prince – As the general and military theorist Clausewitz said; "War is a continuation of politics with the involvement of other means", but the diplomat and statesman Machiavelli also said; "Nothing great is ever achieved without dangers and everyone can see what you appear to be, few experience who

text: Skip to content Sunday, September 20, 2026 Business & Economic Food & Travel Health Home Technology & SaaS Search for: Archives Home What to Know About Year End Tax Planning for Businesses General Article What to Know About Year End Tax Planning for Businesses Laura September 5, 2026 0 Year-end tax planning is a critical activity for any business looking to optimise its financial position and minimise tax obligations. Far from being a last-minute scramble, effective year end tax planning is a strategic exercise that can significantly impact a business’s profitability and cash flow. It involves reviewing financial performance, anticipating future events, and implementing legitimate strategies to manage taxable income before the fiscal year concludes. This proactive approach allows businesses to make informed decisions that align with their long-term financial goals, rather than reacting to tax burdens after they arise. Key Takeaways Year end tax planning is a crucial, proactive strategy for optimising a business’s financial health. It helps businesses reduce their tax burden, improve cash flow, and ensure compliance. Planning should ideally begin well before the fiscal year end, often in the third quarter. Every business, regardless of size or structure, can benefit from tailored tax strategies. Key strategies include asset purchases, inventory management, superannuation contributions, and managing bad debts. Accurate record-keeping and clear understanding of a business’s legal structure are fundamental. Engaging qualified tax professionals provides expertise and ensures strategies are compliant and effective. Forecasting future income and expenses is vital for making sound year-end decisions. What is Year End Tax Planning and Why Does it Matter? Year end tax planning for businesses is the process of reviewing a company’s financial activities and making strategic decisions to legally reduce its taxable income and obligations before the end of the financial year. It’s a proactive measure designed to ensure financial efficiency and compliance. Reduces Taxable Income: By utilising legitimate deductions, credits, and deferrals, businesses can lower the amount of income subject to tax. Improves Cash Flow: Lower tax payments mean more capital retained within the business for reinvestment, growth, or operational expenses. Ensures Compliance: Proper planning helps businesses adhere to tax laws and avoid penalties for non-compliance. Facilitates Budgeting and Forecasting: A clear understanding of tax implications allows for more accurate financial projections and resource allocation for the upcoming year. Optimises Asset Management: Decisions regarding asset purchases, sales, and depreciation can be strategically timed to yield tax benefits. When to Act: The Critical Timeline for Business Tax Strategy While the name suggests year-end, effective year end tax planning is not a task for the last week of the financial year. It’s an ongoing process that intensifies in the months leading up to the fiscal close. Mid-Year Review (Quarter 2/3): This is an ideal time to assess the current year’s performance, project year-end profitability, and identify potential tax liabilities. It allows ample time to implement strategies. Early Year-End Planning (Quarter 4): As the financial year draws to a close, businesses should perform a detailed review of income, expenses, and potential adjustments. This period is crucial for finalising strategic decisions. Throughout the Year: Certain tax strategies, such as setting up superannuation contributions or managing capital gains, require foresight and actions taken throughout the entire year, not just at the end. Before Specific Deadlines: Businesses must be aware of specific deadlines for superannuation contributions, asset purchases, or other relevant actions that impact the current tax year. Who Benefits and Who Should Be Involved? Every business, regardless of its size, structure, or industry, can gain from effective year end tax planning . From sole traders to large corporations, the principles of managing taxable income apply universally. Small Businesses and Sole Traders: Often have simpler structures but can benefit significantly from careful income and expense management, and utilising available deductions. Medium-Sized Enterprises: Can implement more complex strategies, including managing inventory, optimising payroll, and strategically purchasing assets. Large Corporations: Engage in sophisticated planning involving multiple entities, international considerations, and extensive forecasting. Business Owners/Managers: Have ultimate responsibility and need to be actively involved in understanding the implications of tax decisions. Accountants/Tax Advisors: Provide the expertise and guidance needed to identify applicable strategies, ensure compliance, and execute the plan effectively. Addressing a press conference in Lucknow on Friday, AISPLB general secretary Maulana Yasoob Abbas said the issue was humanitarian in nature and required urgent intervention by the government. Abbas said that the All India Shia Personal Law Board had submitted a memorandum to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, requesting the Center to engage diplomatically with the governments of the countries concerned and ensure the safety and legal rights of the detained Indian citizens. “We have appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi to treat this as a serious humanitarian issue. These Indian citizens deserve protection, justice and every possible diplomatic effort for their safe release and return to India,” said Maulana Yasoob Abbas, while sharing the names of 11 Indians detained in several Persian Gulf countries at the press conference. The memorandum stated that several Indian Shia Muslims had reportedly been detained in countries, including Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the UAE, allegedly because of their religious beliefs. According to the Board, many of them had travelled abroad only in search of employment and a better future. “The Ministry of External Affairs and Indian embassies must immediately engage with the authorities of the concerned countries to ensure the detainees receive fair treatment, legal assistance and are repatriated without unnecessary delay,” Abbas said. title: Int'l Quran Seminar to Be Held in Malaysia
text: English . Français . Türkçe . العربیة . فارسی Türkçe العربیة Español اردو Indonesia 中文 Русский বাংলা Kiswahili Hausa پښتو हिन्दी Azəri Italiano Deutsch filipino Bahasa Melayu português тоҷикӣ International Quran News Agency Sunday 20 September 2026 , GMT-07:18:51 15.33° Contact Us | About Us Desktop Version باز و بسته کردن منو Home All Stories Quranic Activities Political Religious Activities World Social Culture & Knowledge Interviews & Articles Photo-Video IQNA Culture & Knowledge Culture 15:28 - April 11, 2012 The link was copied News ID: 2302835 Int'l Quran Seminar to Be Held in Malaysia International Seminar of al-Quran in Contemporary Society is going to be held on December 1st and 2nd at Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin (UniSZA), Terengganu, Malaysia. Faculty of Islamic Contemporary Studies, Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin with cooperation of World of Islamic Sciences and Education University (WISE) and Jordan and The State Government of Terengganu are going to hold the seminar. The Seminar aims to discuss the contemporary issues from the perspective of the al-Quran as a proof of its paramount functions and its relevance as an authoritative and authentic reference for all aspects of human life, in line with the niche of the Faculty of Islamic Contemporary Studies, highlight the uniqueness of al-Quran as a pillar of transformation in contemporary society and reminisce the glory of al-Quran studies at all levels including those in Terengganu. Scholars and researchers are invited to contribute their findings in the International Seminar of al-Quran in Contemporary Society for the following sub-themes: Al-Quran; Beliefs and Thoughts, Al-Quran; Fiqh and Law, Al-Quran; Science and Technology, Al-Quran and Welfare, Al-Quran and Economics, Al-Quran, Civilization and Cultures, Al-Quran and Medical, Al-Quran and Education, The Interpretation and Translation of Al-Quran and The Enhancement of Al-Quran in Terengganu. Seminar of al-Quran (SQ) is a biannual event organized by the Faculty of Islamic Contemporary Studies (FKI). The International Seminar of al-Quran in Contemporary Society (SQ2012) is the third in the series organized by FKI. The SQ 2012 is a continuity of the International Seminar of Qiraat and Qurra’ (SQ2010) and the Seminar of al-Quran and the Formation of Excellent Ummah (SQ2008) with the themes “The Knowledge of Qirrat and Qurra’ Generating Islamic Wisdom” and “al-Quran Creates Excellent Ummah” respectively. This comprehensive guide explains how forex brokers work, how to choose a safe broker, the role of regulation in South Africa, and some of the best brokers available to South African traders . What Is a Forex Broker? A forex broker is a financial services company that provides traders access to the foreign exchange market , where global currencies are traded. Instead of trading directly with other market participants, retail traders use brokers as intermediaries. These brokers provide trading platforms that connect traders to liquidity providers such as banks, hedge funds, and financial institutions. Forex brokers typically offer: Currency trading (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/ZAR) Trading platforms such as MetaTrader Leverage to increase market exposure Analytical tools and charting software Educational resources and market insights Brokers earn revenue through spreads, commissions, or overnight swap fees . Why Forex Trading Is Popular in South Africa South Africa has one of the most developed financial markets in Africa. The country’s strong banking infrastructure and regulatory framework make it easier for individuals to access international financial markets. Several factors contribute to the growing popularity of forex trading in South Africa: 1. Forex Regulation in South Africa Forex trading in South Africa is regulated by the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) . The FSCA is responsible for overseeing financial markets and ensuring that brokers operate fairly and transparently. The regulator’s responsibilities include: Licensing forex brokers Monitoring financial compliance Protecting consumers from fraud Enforcing industry standards Choosing a broker regulated by the FSCA provides traders with additional protection and ensures that the company operates legally within South Africa. Types of Forex Brokers Forex brokers operate using different models. Understanding these models can help traders choose a broker that fits their trading style. ECN Brokers (Electronic Communication Network) ECN brokers connect traders directly with liquidity providers such as banks and institutional traders. STP Brokers (Straight Through Processing) STP brokers send traders’ orders directly to liquidity providers without dealing desk intervention. Posted in: אוסטרליה , אורי | Post a Comment בסך הכל ביקשנו לקנות יין by admin November 11, 2017 6:43 am הוזמנו לחברים אוסטרלים. ההתרגשות בעיצומה ואנחנו בעיקר מאוד מאוד שמחים על ההזדמנות להכיר קצת יותר מקרוב את האנשים שאנחנו חיים איתם. מדובר בזוג מאוד מאוד נחמד שהבנים שלנו, גם אורי וגם עידו, משחקים עם הבנים שלהם כדורסל. לפני מספר שבועות הם כבר הזמינו אותנו לברביקיו ולצפיה משותפת בגמר ה-FUTTY אבל זה נפל על יום כיפור את החלטנו לוותר. טוב, חייבים להתארגן ודאוג להביא יין נורמאלי. קפצנו לסנטר רוואד (centre road) לוולי (woolworth) לחנות יין ולאחר התלבטות קצרה לקחנו משהו תוצרת גרמנית. כמות היין פה בחנויות היא לא נורמאלית בכל קנה מידה. אין סוף של סוגי יין ןשונים, רובם מתוצרת מקומית, באיכות נהדרת ובמחירים מגוחכים. היתה גן דיילת מכירות שנסתה לקדם את המכירה של סוגי יין שונים, מה שהצליח לה הפעם. לבקשת, הצטלמנו כדי שהיא תוכל להראות למנהל שלה שהיא עושה את העבודה כמו שצריך.. title: Art Therapy – Michal Bogin Feinberg | Art for the Soul
text: 🇮🇱 🇬🇧 Michal Bogin – Art Therapy Focusing • Supervision • Lectures and Workshops with "Focus into the Soul" Cards Home Art Therapy Products – Book & Cards "Do Not Disturb, I'm Drawing" – The Book "Focus into the Soul" Cards Art Therapy Q&A Focus Learning to See Drawings When the Drawing Speaks From Within Doodles, Drawing & Self-Confidence Art Therapy for Adults Adult Therapy Demo Children's Therapy Understand Your Child Through Drawing Interpreting Drawings Figure Drawing Development Focused Depth Meeting Lectures & Workshops Workshops Workshops for Therapists Lectures Publications & Reviews About Me Contact Art for the Soul – Art Therapy, Michal Bogin Feinberg “ Art therapy allows me to step out of the usual expression of words and takes me to an unfamiliar area and an intuitive language where I can express myself in a new, unfamiliar, and wonderful spectrum. ” “ Michal, I wanted to thank you for our meeting, I still have the drawings I made in my head. The ability of color and form to express what I'm going through simply enchanted me. I feel that the meeting helped me better understand the place where I want to be now, and the place where I want to be going forward. ” “ Dear Michal, we don't have enough words to express our appreciation for your professionalism in the amazing work you do with our son!!! We received our son as a gift anew!!! ” “ Thank you for the generous simplicity that holds an entire world within it. It was fascinating, educational, and enjoyable. ” When the Drawing Speaks – What Is Art Therapy? Art therapy uses visual artistic tools to communicate emotionally, in ways that words sometimes cannot. Art therapy is an emotional therapy involving growth, development, and awareness, through art materials, the power of creation, and the professional, supportive guidance of the therapist. Through therapy, it helps resolve conflicts, improve self-image, and give meaning to life. Art therapy emphasizes the process, so no special skills or abilities are required to participate. There are things we sense deep inside, but they don't yet have words. In therapy, they begin to take shape, color, and even words. What Happens When Focusing Is Combined with Art? In our sessions, I combine art with Focusing — listening to what arises in the body and to the inner felt sense. This combination allows deep, hidden content to surface and reveal itself in a creative and sometimes even surprising way. Through the process of listening and the images that emerge from the artwork, clarity and inner movement begin to form. A sense of inner center gradually replaces stuckness, confusion, or indecision. Slowly, an inner knowing becomes clearer — what is asking for a step forward, and what possibilities for growth and development are opening up. I work with children and adults. Children with social difficulties, anxieties, and low self-image, and adults seeking to understand themselves through creation. Who is the therapy for? The therapy is tailored to each person according to their needs. Long-term therapy (children, teens, and adults) – an in-depth process as needed. Read more about art therapy for children | Read more about therapy for adults People dealing with fears, indecision, feeling stuck, depression, traumas, or emotional challenges looking for a creative and personal way to cope. Questions and answers about the therapy Focused consultation – a one-time 1.5-hour session + follow-up meeting. A deep meeting designed for those at a crossroads, deliberating, or with a topic seeking clarity. The session combines conversation, Focusing, creative work with materials, and "Focus into the Soul" cards. The meeting can stand on its own, and sometimes also serves as the beginning of a process. Also available online Considering studying art therapy? For those considering studying art therapy who want to experience it firsthand, explore whether the field is right for them, become familiar with the language of therapy, and develop tools to prepare for the admissions process. Studying art therapy? For art therapy students who want to process what they are learning and deepen their understanding through personal experience. I taught art therapy at Lesley College and Beit Berl, and I support therapists as a senior supervisor accredited by YAHAT, the Israeli Association of Creative and Expressive Therapies. Get in touch to explore whether a session is right for you What makes the therapy unique? In art therapy, the drawing is an additional language — an intuitive language through which you can express things that aren't always easy to say out loud. The combination with Focusing allows listening to the body and sensations, and together with drawing and the accompanying conversation, a new path to self-understanding opens. The therapy is personally tailored — for each person according to their needs and pace. For more questions and answers Michal Bogin Feinberg is an experienced art therapist. Athens, Greece "Some things cannot be insured against loss. They can only be entrusted to the right hands." Who we are A century of earned trust. Founded in Athens in 1923, Orphee Beinoglou has spent more than a century building a reputation defined by trust, consistency, and operational excellence. Today, we are Greece’s largest and most specialized provider of moving, relocation, fine art, and exhibition logistics services — trusted by museums, embassies, multinational corporations, and private clients across more than 80 countries. Operating as a multi-specialist logistics platform, we combine expertise in international moving and relocation, fine art logistics, exhibition logistics, and complex project transportation, delivering seamless door-to-door solutions for private clients, corporations, museums, galleries, and exhibitors worldwide. Supported by our parent company, OB Streem — a leading logistics and freight forwarding group in South East Europe — together with a trusted international partner network, we provide integrated logistics and relocation solutions across Greece, Europe, and worldwide, ensuring the safe, secure, and efficient movement of household goods, artworks, exhibition materials, and specialized cargo. 100+ Years operating South East Europe Regional Leader Why the most demanding clients choose us. Premium logistics is about what happens when something goes wrong—and the certainty that it won't. It is built on experience, driven by preparation, and delivered through accountability at every stage of the journey. Multi-specialist under one roof Household goods, fine art, exhibitions, and special transport — managed by dedicated teams within a single accountable operation. Operational depth in the South East Europe Owned offices across Greece, Bulgaria, Romania, North Macedonia, Kosovo, and Serbia — with direct teams who know the regulatory landscape. Globally recognized standards Supported by international memberships, certifications, and quality standards across moving, relocation, fine art, and specialized logistics. Climate-controlled storage & transport Dedicated facilities for artworks, antiques, instruments, and sensitive cargo — with temperature, humidity, and light controls that meet museum-grade requirements. A dedicated specialist, always Every client is assigned a named coordinator — someone who knows your shipment, your timeline, and your requirements. Not a call centre. Not a ticket system. A person. Full customs & documentation support ATA Carnets, temporary imports, permanent clearances, export permits for artworks — managed in-house by our customs specialists. Certified member of leading international organisations Moving & Relocation Your trusted international relocation partner — since 1923. Every relocation is more than a destination change. It is a personal transition involving homes, careers, families, and new beginnings. For over 100 years, we have supported individuals and organizations worldwide with seamless relocation services built on trust and experience. title: Cushing's Disease in Dogs | A Plain-English Guide for Dog Owners
text: Cushing’s Disease in Dogs Home Symptoms Causes Diagnosis Treatment More Diet & Nutrition Life Expectancy Natural Support Stages & Progression Cushing's vs Addison's Resources About Contact Canine Hyperadrenocorticism Cushing's Disease in Dogs A calm, plain-English guide to canine Cushing's disease — what it is, the signs to watch for, how it is diagnosed, and the treatment and care options that can help your dog live comfortably. Explore the Guide Everything you need to understand your dog’s diagnosis, in one place. Symptoms The early signs owners notice first. Causes The three underlying types explained. Diagnosis The tests vets use to confirm it. Treatment Modern medication and other options. Diet & Nutrition Everyday feeding and weight support. Life Expectancy Prognosis and quality of life. If your veterinarian has just mentioned Cushing’s disease, it is normal to feel worried. The good news is that this is one of the more common hormonal conditions in older dogs, it is well understood, and in most cases it can be managed so your dog stays comfortable. This guide walks you through the essentials in everyday language. For information only. This guide is educational and is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis or treatment. Never start, stop or change a medication or dose on your own. If you think your dog may have Cushing’s disease, please consult a licensed veterinarian. What Is Cushing's Disease? Cushing’s disease — known in medicine as hyperadrenocorticism — is an increased level of glucocorticoid hormones (chiefly cortisol ) in your dog’s body. It is usually caused by an over-production of cortisol by the adrenal glands, two small glands that sit near the kidneys. That over-production is, in turn, most often driven by a hormone called ACTH , which is released by the pituitary gland at the base of the brain to instruct the adrenal glands to make cortisol. Cortisol is not a “bad” hormone. In the right amounts it helps regulate metabolism, blood sugar, the immune system and the body’s response to stress. Problems begin when there is simply too much of it, day after day, month after month. The condition is described in more detail by the Merck Veterinary Manual , a respected reference used by veterinary professionals. Most dogs with well-managed Cushing’s disease continue to enjoy a comfortable, happy life at home. Which Dogs Are Susceptible? Cushing’s disease is most commonly seen in middle-aged to older dogs , although a dog as young as two years can occasionally develop it. Some smaller breeds — such as poodles, dachshunds and various terriers — are reported more often, but the condition can affect any breed and any dog. Because many of its signs overlap with normal ageing, Cushing’s disease is easy to miss at first. Is It Serious? Left untreated, Cushing’s disease can cause real discomfort and, over time, raise the risk of other problems such as high blood pressure, urinary infections, blood clots and diabetes. Maintaining a healthy balance of cortisol matters, which is why timely diagnosis and monitoring are so valuable. With appropriate care, however, many dogs do very well. How to Use This Guide Each section below focuses on one part of the journey. You can read them in order or jump straight to what you need: Symptoms — the early signs that often prompt a vet visit. Causes — the three underlying types and why they matter. Diagnosis — the tests your vet may use to confirm it. Treatment — modern medications and other options. Diet & nutrition and life expectancy — day-to-day living and what to expect. A Note on Hope A Cushing’s diagnosis is not the end of the road. Because the disease is so well studied, veterinarians have reliable tools to control it and to keep your dog feeling like themselves. The most important step you can take today is to work closely with your own veterinarian, ask questions, and keep an eye on the signs described throughout this guide. For a second trustworthy overview, the American Veterinary Medical Association maintains pet-owner resources on canine health. Cu toate acestea, există, de asemenea, carduri cu capacități de 512 GB și 1 TB. Cu cât capacitatea este mai mare, cu atât mai multe date pot fi stocate pe cardul de memorie. Cu toate acestea, atunci când faceți alegerea, trebuie să luați în considerare și dimensiunea maximă suportată de aparatul dumneavoastră. Formatul cardului de memorie determină capacitatea maximă a acestuia: SD / microSD: > 2 GB (nu mai este utilizat sau vândut) SDHC / microSDHC: > 32 GB SDXC / microSDXC: > 2 TB Clasa de viteză Clasa de viteză este indicată, de obicei, printr-un număr scris într-un cerc pe cardul de memorie. Pe piață există un număr mic de carduri de clasa 4 și clasa 6, cu viteze minime de scriere de 4 și, respectiv, 6 MB/s. Însă, marea majoritate a cardurilor sunt marcate cu clasa 10, ceea ce corespunde unei viteze minime de scriere de 10 MB/s. În cazul cardurilor de memorie, veți vedea, de asemenea, un marcaj suplimentar UHS U1, iar un card etichetat ca atare poate atinge viteze de până la 100 MB/s. Cardurile UHS U3 sunt apoi echipate cu un al doilea rând de contacte, astfel încât acestea pot scrie cu până la 300 MB/s în dispozitivele compatibile. Astfel de carduri rapide sunt necesare în special pentru înregistrările video 4K, care pot atinge viteze de sute de MB/s. text: Home Sport Live Casino Casino Live Virtual Lottery Fans' Championship Today’s Shot Wheel Of Fortune Promotions Help Chat Agencies partnerships Social Media FAQ Terms and Conditions Privacy Policy About us Game rules Responsible gaming Sport Live Casino Casino Live Virtual Lottery Frequently asked questions My Account Casino Responsible Gaming Deposits Withdrawal Bets General questions related to your account How do I open an account at Stanleybet? The first step for register an account on Stanleybet is to access the "Register" button at the top right of the home page. As soon as you access it, please fill in your details in the required fields and press the "Continue" button in each of the three steps of the registration process. How do I activate my Stanleybet account? Immediately after completing the registration process, we will send you an email with additional instructions to activate your account. The activation process of the Stanleybet account consists of: Validate your email address by accessing the validation link; Sending the electronic copy of the identity document: www.stanleybet.ro/my-documents If you did not receive the validation email, please enter and check all the sections of your email address (example: Inbox, Spam, Junk). Remember that for additional assistance, you can contact us via email at [email protected] How do I close my Stanleybet account? You can close your Stanleybet account anytime by sending an email request to [email protected] . We inform you that your personal information will not be deleted in the event of temporary suspension or account closure. These will remain stored until the deadline set by the legislation in force, if necessary for audit by the competent Romanian authorities. What does "Identity Verification" or KYC mean? Stanleybet is committed in protecting the security of each Stanleybet account, which is why we ask you for a copy of the identity card attesting the authenticity of your account at the time of registration. We inform you that you have 30 days from the time you made the first deposit to send us the copy of your identity card. Otherwise, in accordance with legal provisions, your Stanleybet account will be suspended until the verification of the identity account has been completed. Why do I have to provide my personal information for registration? The identification of a player is required both to make a payment and to comply with the legislation in force. It is essential that the name, surname and date of birth be correct because they will confirm the minimum age you need to register as a player. We will keep in touch with you by email and we will inform you about the special promotions that we will offer you. How do I protect my data? Stanleybet ensures the confidentiality of the data and transactions of all its clients. In this regard, we make sure we use the latest security technologies to provide maximum protection for your data. Our coded and security systems are subject to extremely rigorous procedures, precisely to minimize the impact of security incidents. What happens if I forgot my password? To request a new password, please visit the „Forgot Password” section at the top right of the home page. Then enter your username and click the „Send password” button. In order to recover your password, it is necessary to know the e-mail address with which you registered your Stanleybet.ro account. So, you'll get a password reset link on your email address. Once you have accessed this link, you can log in to your Stanleybet.ro account using your username and password. You can also request to reset your password via email at [email protected] . Please note that for this variation it is essential to send the request from the address that you have registered in Stanleybet.ro account. Our support colleagues will send you a temporary password that you will need to change when you first log in. What happens if I forgot my username? You will find the username in the confirmation mail of your Stanleybet.ro account registration. If you have deleted this email, please send us a request from the email address you used during the registration process to make your user name known to you. Can I log in if I am abroad? According to the regulations in force, you can use the Stanleybet.ro account only if you are on the territory of Romania. How can I change my username? The username is unique and cannot be changed. Each username can only be registered once. How do I change my email address used to register my account? We inform you that the email address is unique and the account can be used by one person. Therefore, in order to be able to change your email address, it is necessary to send us an email, entitled "Change email address", from the address you want in the game account, on [email protected] to includes: Personal data: name, surname, username, date of birth; The email address with which you want the account to be replaced; Color picture of the ID card. Italian School For over 30 years, Il Sasso Italian Language has been running courses in Montepulciano, in the heart of Tuscany. The school offers Italian courses for speakers of other languages studying in small groups and individually. There are six different levels, corresponding to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Il Sasso also runs art history, wine, literature and current affairs courses, as well as courses to prepare students for the CELI and CILS exams. The school is recognised by the Italian Education Ministry. It is a medium sized school with a reputation for excellence, and is open all year round. Students of all ages come to study here from all over the world. The peace and quiet are ideal for a study holiday of Italian language far from bustling town centres. Many catamarans available for catamaran hire Whitsundays feature solar panels and fuel-efficient engines, perfect for environmentally-conscious adventurers like those navigating the Swan River. Energy-Efficient Sailing Practices Implementing energy-efficient sailing techniques not only benefits the environment but enhances your overall experience. Trim your sails efficiently to reduce the workload on your engine, and schedule your journey with wind patterns in mind. Utilising these methods can enhance your boat's performance while ensuring a lighter ecological footprint. Waste Management Onboard Proper waste management is fundamental while exploring the Whitsundays. Plan for a comprehensive waste disposal strategy before setting sail. Use biodegradable materials and avoid single-use plastics. Collect all recyclables, disposables, and organic waste separately to make disposal more efficient upon reaching designated facilities. This mirrors effective waste management strategies seen at Fremantle Harbour, setting a positive example for a sustainable sailing experience. When plotting a course through the Whitsundays, it's essential to consider both the popular and the hidden gems that this region offers. For those indulging in self sailing Whitsundays , mastering these routes is as vital as consulting charts to anticipate currents and shallow areas. Understanding Weather Patterns An adept understanding of local weather patterns can significantly impact the success of your journey. Being well-versed with the intricacies of the seasonal winds and tidal movements is akin to preparing for a regatta in Fremantle Harbour. Monitoring forecasts and using real-time data for wind changes ensures a smooth sail. The Whitsundays' weather can be unpredictable, making vigilance a necessity for safe passage. Wildlife Interaction Guidelines The Whitsundays is a haven for diverse marine life, requiring sailors to abide by wildlife interaction guidelines. Respecting wildlife not only ensures compliance with maritime regulations but also preserves the natural beauty for future seafarers. Observing the behaviour of local species and maintaining a safe distance fosters a co-existence ethos akin to the philosophies championed by the Australian Maritime Museum. By doing so, you'll ensure that your maritime adventure respects the vibrant ecosystems and enhances your overall sailing experience. Safety Measures Essential Safety Gear Equipping your vessel with the right safety gear is crucial for navigating the waters of the Whitsundays. Your kit should include life jackets for all passengers, a reliable marine radio, and flares. A comprehensive first-aid kit will also be indispensable, especially when sailing around the remote islands where medical facilities might be scarce. Additionally, ensure that fire extinguishers are onboard and regularly checked. title: IIS 10.0 Detailed Error - 404.0 - Not Found
text: HTTP Error 404.0 - Not Found The resource you are looking for has been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable. Most likely causes: The directory or file specified does not exist on the Web server. The URL contains a typographical error. A custom filter or module, such as URLScan, restricts access to the file. Things you can try: Create the content on the Web server. Review the browser URL. Create a tracing rule to track failed requests for this HTTP status code and see which module is calling SetStatus. For more information about creating a tracing rule for failed requests, click here . Am învățat la FDSC o mulțime de lucruri despre programare și managementul programelor de finanțare. Utile și le-am pus în practică. Ciprian Ciucu × FDSC a ținut în viață o parte importantă a sectorului prin munca sa văzută și nevăzută, știută și neștiută de toți cei care au beneficiat de pe urma activităților de advocacy, reprezentare la nivel național și european. Corina Cociorvă × Putem agrea de la bun început că nu suntem perfecți și nici nu credem asta despre noi. Dar încercăm constant să ne depășim standardele și să ușurăm munca societății civile. Ușa noastră a fost și va rămâne deschisă pentru orice membru al societății civile și va fi întâmpinat cu înțelegere, răbdare și bunăvoință. În ultimii 30 de ani, ne-am dedicat creșterii spiritului civic, promovării valorilor democratice și rezolvării unor probleme sociale majore. De 30 de ani milităm pentru un mediu în care vocile comunităților și ale organizațiilor sunt auzite, iar schimbările pozitive devin realitate. Paula-Lorena Sabou × FDSC este, în același timp, un punct de stabilitate pentru sector, dar și un challenger, oferindu-i periodic o oglindă în care să se vadă și să se (re)cunoască (prin cercetarea despre sector), ridicând standardele de funcționare și implementare a proiectelor, militând pentru un cadru legislativ favorabil sectorului și depunând eforturi pentru a crește încrederea publicului larg în acesta. Angajat FDSC × Societatea civilă este mai structurată și mai stabilă datorită granturilor oferite de FDSC. Există un anumit grad de colaborare între ONG-uri, mulțumită FDSC. Instrumentul de 3.5% este liantul dintre publicul larg și societatea civilă, un instrument la care FDSC a contribuit semnificativ, având un impact considerabil. Angajat FDSC × FDSC este o organizație care știe cum să capaciteze ONG-urile ce aduc cu adevărat o schimbare în comunitate. Reprezintă interesele organizațiilor neguvernamentale și înțelege realitatea lor, așa cum este ea. E ca un fond de investiții pentru ONG-uri, doar că investiția se face prin multă implicare. 🙂 Vera Ularu × “Pentru mine, FDSC este acel far călăuzitor în societatea civilă din România, un loc în care am învățat enorm și la care mă raportez deseori, mai ales din poziția de președinte al unei org

title: Top Nightclubs for Electronic Music Worldwide
text: Skip to content A Global Guide to the Hottest Nightclubs and Electronic Music Hubs A Global Guide to the Hottest Nightclubs and Electronic Music Hubs >> A Global Guide to the Hottest Nightclubs and Electronic Music Hubs Electronic music nightclubs have become the epicenters of nightlife culture, drawing in enthusiasts from around the globe. These vibrant spaces offer more than just a place to dance; they are sanctuaries where cutting-edge music, technology, and creativity converge. As electronic music continues to dominate the global music scene, these nightclubs play a pivotal role in shaping trends and fostering new talents. The allure of electronic music nightclubs lies in their ability to provide an immersive experience. From mesmerizing light shows to state-of-the-art sound systems, these venues create an atmosphere that captivates the senses. Patrons are transported into a world where beats take precedence over words, and the energy of the crowd becomes a collective force that propels the night forward. What Makes a Nightclub Stand Out? Several factors contribute to the distinctiveness of a nightclub. Factor Explanation Impact on Experience Sound System Quality High-end audio systems with well-designed acoustics enhance music clarity and depth An immersive experience where music is felt, not just heard Ambiance & Design Creative lighting, architecture, and themed decor shape the club’s identity Visually engaging environment, memorable atmosphere DJs & Performers Skilled and renowned DJs curate music and engage with the crowd Elevated energy, stronger crowd connection, unforgettable nights Top Nightclubs Around the World The globe is dotted with iconic nightclubs that have achieved legendary status among electronic music aficionados. Some of these clubs are renowned for their history, others for their cutting-edge innovation, and still others for their ability to consistently host world-class talent. Berghain, Berlin: Often considered the mecca of techno, Berghain is revered for its marathon parties and strict door policy. The club’s industrial setting and unparalleled sound system make it a must-visit for techno lovers. Fabric, London: Known for its eclectic line-ups and a commitment to underground music, Fabric is a staple in the electronic music scene. Its three rooms each offer a different vibe, ensuring a diverse experience for club-goers. Zouk, Singapore: A pioneer in the Asian clubbing scene, Zouk attracts international DJs and has been instrumental in introducing electronic music to the region. Its multi-room concept provides a variety of musical experiences under one roof. Hï Ibiza, Ibiza: Situated on the party island of Ibiza, Hï Ibiza is a modern club known for its luxurious design and star-studded DJ line-ups. It encapsulates the spirit of Ibiza with its vibrant atmosphere and top-notch productions. Output, New York: Although it closed its doors in 2019, Output remains legendary for its commitment to quality sound and underground music. It set a high standard for future clubs in the city. The Role of DJs and Electronic Music Genres DJs are the heart and soul of electronic music nightclubs, acting as both performers and curators of the musical journey. A skilled DJ can read the room, sense the energy of the crowd, and adjust their set to maintain an electrifying atmosphere. They blend tracks seamlessly, creating a continuous flow of music that keeps the dance floor alive. Electronic music encompasses a wide range of genres, each offering a distinct sound and vibe. From the hypnotic rhythms of techno and the pulsating beats of house to the complex layers of trance and the experimental sounds of dubstep, there is a genre for every mood and moment. This diversity allows nightclubs to cater to different audiences, offering specialized nights that highlight specific styles. The evolution of electronic music has also led to the emergence of subgenres and hybrid styles, further enriching the sonic landscape of nightclubs. This constant innovation keeps the scene dynamic and ensures that club-goers are always treated to fresh and exciting sounds. How to Plan Your Nightclub Experience Planning a night out at a nightclub requires more than just picking a venue. To make the most of the experience, it’s essential to consider several factors that can enhance the overall enjoyment of the night. Research the Venue: Understanding the vibe and focus of a club can help set expectations. Look into the types of events they host and the DJs they feature to ensure alignment with your musical preferences. title: Sequoia in Romania
text: Home | Map | Wallpapers | Sponsor | Contact ro | en Sequoia (Natural Monument) The gigantic sequoia trees are among the world’s largest creations. The name “Sequoia” was given in honor of the Sequoyah, the Cherokee Indian chief (1776-1842) who taught his people how to read and write using a unique alphabet he invented himself. One of the first books published in the Cherokee language was the Holy Bible in 1825. There are three types of Sequoia trees: Californian Redwood (Sequoia Sempervirens), also known as Redwood, used as an ornamental tree, Giant Sequoia (Sequoiadendron giganteum), considered the largest tree by total volume, being protected by law and Dawn Redwood (Metasequoia) known as a fossil until 1941 when discovered in China. General Sherman, Sequoia National Park These natural giants are found in high numbers in California. A species of the gymnosperm family, the Sequoia Gigantea is a tree that can live for thousands of years. Amazingly, they can grow to be 145m tall with a body circumference of up to 38m. In fact, the Sequoia Gigantea is so huge that the stump surface of a tree with only a diameter of 16m could easily park up to 12 limos. Or, it could be a dance-floor with 60 dancers and house a full orchestra as well. The official size record is held by a giant sequoia called the “General Sherman“, which can be found in the Sequoia National Park in California. It is 83.8m tall (275 ft) and 31.3m (102 ft) at the base. With a possible subterranean fungi network, it is the biggest living organism on Earth. Its thickness is ten times more than that of a blue whale. At its estimated 1486 cube meters, it contains enough wood to build 40 houses with five rooms each. Its bark is said to be over 1.3 meters in width. Initially, people thought that the General Sherman could be over 6000 years old; later, biologists revealed that it is up to 2150 years old and still growing vigorously--it will continue growing for thousands of years. The tallest tree in the world is a coast redwood (Sequoia sempervirens), named Hyperion after a person in Greek mythology. He is 115.55 m (379.1 feet) tall! This enormous tree was only discovered in September 2006, in a remote part of the Redwood National Park, California by naturalists Chris Atkins and Michael Taylor. So precious are these natural marvels that the places where many of them live (like the Old Metusala Sequoia or the Mendocino Sequoia tree) are kept secret, to hide and protect them from vandals or souvenir hunters searching for trophies. Sequoia cones The sexual reproduction of the Sequoia Gigantea is accomplished through seeds. Until the age of 20, they can reproduce only through offshoots. The young trees begin reproduction only after 20 years. At any time, a mature tree can hold around 11 cones. Because of the impressive height, the seed can be carried by the wind up to 200m away. Wildfire The trees from Sequoiadendron Giganteum have difficulties in reproduction in the natural environment especially by being growth. This is owed to the necessity of a well irrigated mineral soil and to a whole sun exposure. In the last period, the American researchers realized the importance that the forest fires have in the process of reproducing. The fire does not take down these huge trees, but inhibits the development of soil vegetation, being in favor of the baby trees of sequoia in their growing period. As well, the fire generates hot air which forces the opening of the cones and the release of some great quantities of seeds over the optimum soil for the growth of the baby trees. The soil ashes also protect the seeds from the solar radiations. Sequoia in Romania Usually, this gigantic tree species lives in the forests of Sierra Nevada Mountains, California, at an altitude of over 2000 meters. For those who have never had the chance to meet these giants, Sequoia.ro presents the most important examples of the Sequoia trees from Romania : Rogojel village, Cluj The most imposing tree from Apuseni Mountains arrived at the base of Vladeasa Mountain more than a decade ago. The “Arborele de sequoia” forest reservation is situated on “Dealul Domnului” (God’s Hill) between Sacuieu commune and Rogojel village. Hungarians from around Huedin have planted some rare species here, such as “larita”, larch (conifers with deciduous needle-like leaves) and black pine. The two giants look with nostalgia toward the snowy Vladeasa Peak, dreaming of the North-American lands they were brought from. To view the area, click on this link. link . Măderat village, Arad The locals say that baron Dietrich Jozsef, the owner of a winery in this area, brought three sequoia gigantea seedlings from California in 1845 which he planted on Dealul Mare (Big Hill), near Maderat village. No high resolution photos provided in this blog. Digital Photography Digital photography, as opposed to film photography, uses electronic devices to record and capture the image as binary data. This facilitates storage and editing of the images on personal computers, and also the ability to show and delete unsuccessful images immediately on the camera or software itself. Digital cameras now outsell film cameras and include features that are not found in film cameras such as the ability to shoot video and record audio. Some other devices, such as mobile phones, now include digital photography features. The quality of a digital image is the sum of various factors, many of which are similar to film cameras. Pixel count (typically listed in megapixels, millions of pixels) is only one of the major factors, though it is the most heavily marketed. Pixel count metrics were created by the marketing organizations of digital camera manufacturers because consumers can use it to easily compare camera capabilities. It is not, however, the major factor in evaluating a digital camera. The processing system inside the camera that turns the raw data into a color-balanced and pleasing photograph is the most critical, which is why some 4+ megapixel cameras perform better than higher-end cameras. text: Home About us Products Technology Contact us ✕ Ecofol AD develops and produces unique foliar fertilizers. Our product range covers all major crops We create value for the farmers. PLANT NUTRITION We are ECOFOL. We develop and produce UNIQUE foliar fertilizers. We deliver increased and reliable yield to agriculture. We provide an innovative product for the benefit of farmers and agriculture as a whole. We introduce pioneering technologies in foliar feeding, and then bring them to farmers through our tailored service. Our products cover all major applications: cereals, oil & technical crops, vegetables, fruit trees and vineyards. We believe that the future belongs to the responsible and efficient business. And we deliver this future through our products and services. Our inspirational motto is: “There is nothing wiser than the living nature. A particle of this wisdom can be found in every drop of our fertilizers.” Our newest products Helasol B 11% Liquid fertilizer with high boron content. Read more Helasol Zn 6% Highly effective zinc chelate. Read more Helasol Mg+S Easily absorbed magnesium-nitrogen fertilizer. Read more Our Technology: How we create our fertilizers is our Production Technology. How we apply them on the plants is our Application Technology. 1 Production Technology: Bio-Mineral fertilizers Our key product lines consist of Bio-Mineral fertilizers. They combine the advantages of all major types of fertilizers: mineral, organic and bacterial. Exception to this are the following product lines: HELASOL: foliar fertilizers of standard technology – with EDTA and sulphates]. 2 Production Technology: “4 in 1” type of fertilizers Our Fertilizers contain 4 different types of complementary ingredients: Macro elements: Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium Micro elements: Iron, Magnesium, Copper, Molybdenum, Boron, Zinc, etc. Biostimulator: Lactic acid, amino acids and other physiologically active substances Natural Adjuvant: Ester of Lactic acid. 3 Application Technology: Conventional Takes care of the complete, balanced and versatile nutrition of the plants, customized to the different needs and development stages of the various crops. For major cereal and oil crops we offer a solution for treatment from seeds to harvest. 4 Application Technology: Anti-Stress Deals with the provoked nutritional needs or physiological needs caused by some stress event or a combination of different stressful situations: excessive rain, bad soil management, prolonged heat, erroneous soil fertilization, micro elements deficit, hail damage, pesticide damage, soil acidity, drought, soil alkalinity, frost, bad field history. title: News - Consulate General of the Republic of Seychelles in Bulgaria
text: Toggle navigation EN BG Home Consulate News Seychelles Links Gallery Video Contacts Recommended EN BG Seychelles Celebrates 50 Years of Independence at Vrana Palace and with the Premiere of a New Seychellois Song Mon, 29 June 2026 Dozens of representatives of the diplomatic corps, state institutions, and the business community gathered yesterday at Vrana Palace to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the independence of the Republic of Seychelles. The official reception was hosted by Dr. Maxim Behar, Honorary Consul General of the Republic of Seychelles in Bulgaria . Among the distinguished guests were Prince Boris of Tarnovo, representatives of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Tourism, the Dean of the Diplomatic Corps in Bulgaria, H.E. Zakia El Midaoui, as well as dozens of ambassadors and diplomats accredited to Bulgaria. In a congratulatory address from Dr. Velislava Petrova-Chamova, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria , it was emphasized: "Bulgaria highly values the friendly relations and constructive cooperation that have developed between our two countries and reaffirms its commitment to strengthening our ties and expanding cooperation in areas of mutual interest, including tourism, sustainable development, education, and multilateral relations." In her address, the Dean of the Diplomatic Corps in Bulgaria and Ambassador of the Kingdom of Morocco, H.E. Zakia El Midaoui , paid special tribute to Maxim Behar and presented him with a commemorative statuette in recognition of his longstanding service as Honorary Consul General of the Republic of Seychelles. "Dr. Maxim Behar is an example of how an honorary consul can build a genuine bridge between two countries. Thanks to his dedication, Seychelles has become much better known in Bulgaria, and the friendship between our peoples continues to grow," said H.E. El Midaoui . During the event, Behar also received an important certificate recognizing his contribution to honorary consular representation from Borislav Boyanov, Chairman of the Association of Honorary Consuls in Bulgaria and Honorary Consul General of the Republic of Malta . One of the most emotional moments of the evening was the premiere of the original song " We Are Seychelles ," written and performed by Maxim Behar especially for the 50th anniversary of the independence of the Republic of Seychelles. The performance also features Seychellois singer Rita Romain. The music was composed by Lil Sha, with his father Big Sha serving as music consultant. The official music video was produced by M3 Communications Group, Inc. and directed by Kristian Nedelchev, Head of the company's Video Department. "It has been a tremendous honor for me to represent the Republic of Seychelles in Bulgaria for more than two decades. Today we celebrate not only 50 years of independence but also the friendship between our two countries. We Are Seychelles is my personal gift to the people of Seychelles and to everyone who loves these unique islands," said Dr. Maxim Behar. Among the official guests were also Boris Venkov , Desk Officer for Seychelles at the Middle East and Africa Directorate of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Irena Georgieva , former Minister of Tourism; Dr. Solomon Passy , President of the Atlantic Club of Bulgaria and former Minister of Foreign Affairs; Mircho Ivanov , Director of the Protocol Directorate at the Administration of the President; and Dr. Polina Karastoyanova, Executive Director of the National Tourism Board. » All news © 2014 - 2026. title: Comunità Cenacolo – Comunità Cenacolo
text: Comunità Cenacolo Language Italiano English Français Deutsch Español Português Hrvatski Polski Slovenský Vlaamse live streaming more… «When they say: “Elvira has died!”, you must sing, dance, celebrate… because I am alive! Woe to you if you say: “Poor her….” No, not at all “poor her”! I will go on calmly and sing, I’m already singing! Something magnificent will open wide before me… life doesn’t die!». Mother Elvira Mother Elvira's Birth into Heaven FUNERAL WITH REQUIEM MASS We inform you that the funeral with the Requiem Mass will take place on Thursday, August 10, 2023, at 4:30 PM on the hill of Saluzzo, at 35 Via San Lorenzo. It will be possible to pay a final farewell to Mother Elvira's body starting from 10 in the morning on the hill of Saluzzo, under the tent where the service will take place. The program will begin at 2:00 PM with an afternoon of prayer, dances, and testimonials, and will conclude with the celebration of the Eucharist at 4:30 PM. Access to the hill will be granted to buses, minibuses, individuals with disabilities, journalists, priests, and cars (subject to available space). Due to traffic considerations, we kindly suggest using the SHUTTLE SERVICE, which will be available from 10:00 AM to 4:30 PM and will depart from the Saluzzo Cattle Market (16 Don Giacomo Soleri) and the train station. ATTENTION! No meals will be offered or sold. FOR ALL PRIESTS: Please arrive at least one hour before the service and bring with you a purple chasuble and stole. PROCESSION WITH THE BODY OF MOTHER ELVIRA In the morning of Friday, August 11, 2023, the men and women of the Cenacolo Community will process the body of Mother Elvira from the Mother House on the hill of Saluzzo to the Formation House at 115 Via Pagno, the location of the burial. For those who wish to join us in prayer and join the procession, there will be a stop at 9:30 AM in front of the Saluzzo Cathedral (Cattedrale Maria Vergine Assunta, at 1 Piazza G. Garibaldi). From there, the procession will continue with the following route: CORSO ITALIA, CORSO PIEMONTE, PIAZZA CESARE BATTISTI, VIA PAGNO. (Click here to view the route). ATTENTION! Please bring water and food with you A SHUTTLE SERVICE will be available for the return from 115 Via Pagno to the cemetery parking lot in Saluzzo (Provincial Road Pinerolo). Saluzzo, 3 agosto 2023 «When they say: “Elvira has died!”, you must sing, dance, celebrate… because I am alive! Woe to you if you say: “Poor her….” No, not at all “poor her”! I will go on calmly and sing, I’m already singing! Something magnificent will open wide before me… life doesn’t die!». . With these words repeated over the years, Sister Elvira Petrozzi, known as Mother Elvira, prepared her collaborators and the young people of Comunità Cenacolo, for whom she is the founder, for her passage into eternal life. At the age of 86, surrounded by the prayer and affection of the entire “family” of the Comunità Cenacolo, Mother Elvira serenely returned to the Father’s home. Her earthly pilgrimage ended at the House of Formation of the Comunità Cenacolo in Saluzzo where she lived the last years of her illness, cared for with loving attention by the Sisters of the community. This morning, August 3, 2023 at 3:50, surrounded by all the Sisters of the house in prayer, after finishing the singing of the Salve Regina, she opened her large, bright eyes and confidently surrendered herself to the merciful embrace of the Father and the tenderness of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Consumed by a life spent with extraordinary generosity and intensity in loving and serving the poor and the needy - especially the young and those lost in addictions and a meaningless life - and in her final years, bearing the Cross, Mother Elvira continued until the end with faith, determination, courage, and complete surrender to God, bearing witness to her immense love for life. During the days of the Festival of Life held on the hill of Saluzzo from July 13th to 16th, thousands of people, including young individuals, parents, and friends belonging to the "big family" of the Community, came from various parts of the world to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the Cenacolo. They gathered around her in intense prayer and deep affection to thank her and accompany her as she passed into eternal life. After the Festival, a river of people - young individuals from our fraternities and missions scattered around the world, "children" of the Community, friends, and parents - came to the House of Formation to bid her a final farewell, to give her a caress, a prayer, a kiss, and a thank you. The anticipation of her birth into Heaven stretched beyond any human expectation, filled with prayer and affection, bringing emotion and gratitude to the hearts of all who could say goodbye and express their gratitude, especially the men and women welcomed into various fraternities. title: visual diary - PORTRAITS by O L A F
text: PORTRAITS by O L A F about portraits black & white studies contact PORTRAITS by O L A F © 2026 Olaf Siebert +385 (0)91 7397 404 info@olafsiebert.com All rights reserved Share dreams II As said in the previous post, the Q surprised me with the fact that it is great for ICM. However, it is not only ICM, other forms of impressionistic photography seems to fit this camera very well. Below a set of images where everything is out-of-focus, on purpose. I really like them, and I would like to redo this for sure. dreams Q iris dreams I Dreams (or Transcendent as I used to call it). When I quit wedding photography I sold most of my gear and bought myself a Sigma DP Merrill, a great little special camera. In the beginning I used it for ICM (intentional camera movement) until it became my camera for the project ‘ seconds ’ and ICM was put aside as other cameras simply could not provide me the feel/handling I needed for ICM. Until last month, when the Q became by daily camera. Very unexpected to me, but the handling is perfect for ICM. I must admit I am very happy and will pursue this kind of photography the upcoming months as portraits are still low due to covid. Below the first few images from a walk in a snowy forest. Hope you like them. transcendent icm Q dreams portrait of Ivan Not a real portrait session, more a dance session. Nevertheless, Ivan and I had great fun during a very early morning in Zadar. GFX50R GF32-64 Leica Q: the bad stuff Don’t expect many images in this post, not much technical data. This can be found on the internet already. The Q is a six year old camera so there is enough info around. Then, why another review? I don’t know. I am not a reviewer. I photograph. But then, I do like camera’s so may be that’s why I do a review. As the Q is a special camera, I thought a long-term review is in its place. I have it only one month now, not long enough, but hopefully it will stay with me long enough to make it a long-term review. Is it worth to buy a camera which is six (6!) years old? It depends on how you perceive value. To me it is though most probably the latest version has more options, more pixels, more iso, more whatever… To me, for the price I got the Q, it was great value. Especially as I wanted to try the camera first. Anyway, a review. Before buying the Q I read a lot, mostly praise. I guess Leica users are slightly blinded (so are Fuji shooters, those with Canon, Nikon, Hasselblad and probably Phase One) and it is tough to find something bad about the camera’s (in general). That’s why I decided to start with the bad stuff. I assume I’m neutral in a sense that the cool-aid didn’t hit me yet. 1. stupid marketing-talk Everywhere on the internet you can read that the camera has a digital zoom. Wtf? Really? I can crop any camera (digital or not) in post and those putting this as a pre must be nuts. Actually, those accepting it as a pre are nuts, but hey, it’s Leica, praise the L., no bad stuff here please… 2. when cropping, one can see the frame lines in the view finder Duh! Coming from the xpro, I am not used else wise and not only when I am cropping. It is a permanent function. It’s like the first remark, stupid marketing talk. 3. the video button Really? After three (3!) firmware updates this remained unchanged and can only be used for video? Right Leica was to move it from the Q2, but so wrong they did not update the firmware for the Q regarding this. 4. quick autofocus This depends on your definition of quick. I’d guess it’s the same as the xpro2. For me sufficient, but not quick. The internet is full of praise about it’s speed. May be coming from a M, but that’s it. 5. auto-/ manual focus switch The internet loves it, to me, for now it is not usable. Hard to find, hard to switch. It goes, but not fluent. The camera is intended to focus on creating images. To me, this means that one could handle the camera blindly, without even doubting what and how to switch. Sadly, on first sight this switch is not that great. 6. easy menu Very praised on the internet. I expected miracles, but am disappointed. Especially after noticing that when my battery is empty for more than one day, I need to re-enter the date and time. Wtf, really? 7. the jpeg’s I know, coming from Fuji one is spoiled. I had lower expectations, but still, this is disappointing. Leica is said to be a reportage camera. Those doing reportage, don’t have time for edits, so internal adjustments are important. Leica is light years behind here, but really, like light years. If you want to have good adjustable jpeg’s, skip this one. So, here we are. The first part of the review. No images, no praise. Now, as I can live with the above, let’s see how the camera grows on me. Update The camera I bought was second hand. Till now, in my life, I never had problems buying second hand equipment. However, the Leica shows two (minor) defects which is not what I expected as everybody is raving about the quality of the brand. The thing with the battery u

title: Sheikhat, the professional dancers of Morocco
text: HELENE ERIKSEN: TRADITIONAL DANCES Home ANAR DANA Contact About Workshops Newsletter Tango and Argentine Folklore Sheikhat, the professional dancers of Morocco SKU: $0.00 Unavailable per item Sheikhat is the female plural of Sheikh, a "wise, learned man." However, in this case it is not academic knowledge, but the knowledge of relationships between men and women, particularly on the wedding night, which is inferred. The Sheikhat are the professional female singers and dancers of Morocco. They entertain the guests at weddings, circumcisions, and other festive occasions. An especially exciting dance is Danse du Plateu, in which dancers balance trays with tea pots, glasses full of tea, and lighted candles on their heads. title: – Zadar region tourist board
text: Zadar Destinations Destinations Zadar Zadar Zadar is a city of romance and love, as well as a place of passion and spirit! This is a town that does not mind exploring new art forms and ideas to enrich its extraordinary setting and complement its grand physique. Zadar is both a peaceful community and a dynamic modern centre that greets everyone with open arms and leaves a lasting mark on every enamoured visitor! Discover Zadar Nin Riviera Nin Riviera Nin is the oldest royal Croatian town and the place where the Croatian state was born. Today, Nin Riviera is a modern-day tourist destination that offers all types of activities for individuals and families alike: exquisite sandy beaches and intimate lovely coves as well as utterly entertaining resorts of the highest quality. Discover Nin Riviera Biograd Riviera Biograd Riviera Biograd on the Sea, or simply Biograd, is a beautiful seaside resort and an important nautical centre located on a small peninsula at the very heart of the Adriatic Coast. The town is surrounded by exceptional nature and its visitors can explore many national and nature parks and two nature parks in its vicinity, admire its rich and interesting cultural heritage or enjoy excellent beaches and lovely promenades. Discover Biograd Riviera Island of Pag Island of Pag Pag is a fascinating island with unique geographical features, a colourful vibrant community, rich cultural heritage and an exciting tourist offer. It is the home of eponymous cheese, lamb and lace, all universally acknowledged, appreciated and celebrated around the globe! Discover Island of Pag Paklenica Riviera Paklenica Riviera Visit the home of captivating legends and thrilling adventures, sandy and pebble beaches, hundreds of plant and animal species listed by UNESCO and Winnetou movies! Enjoy the mountains and the sea and see why it was virtually designed for adventure tourism. Discover Paklenica Riviera Islands Islands Feel the breeze of the alluring Adriatic Sea, moor your vessel in the welcoming harbours and eco-friendly marinas, discover the beauties of stunning nature parks and swim in turquoise waters of serene coves. Discover Islands Hinterland Hinterland If you want a vacation far from crowds that is closely connected to the authentic experiences of this area, walk its rural paths. Here you can enjoy historical stories, luxury villas, autochthonous gastronomy and favourite drinks that are globally renowned. Discover Hinterland All Destinations Experience Experience Explore Explore GUIDE TO NATURE PARK TELAŠĆICA GUIDE TO NATURE PARK VRANSKO LAKE GUIDE TO PAKLENICA NATIONAL PARK 5 WAYS TO EXPERIENCE ZADAR REGION MOUNTAINS Discover Explore Nature & Adventure Nature & Adventure Most of the epithets used in portraying stunning natural environments usually do not do justice to the nature of the Zadar region and fail in describing it's true astonishing beauty! Cycling Rock Climbing Caving Water Sports on River Water Sports on Sea Hiking Diving History & Culture History & Culture Did you ever feel so overwhelmed by the beauty of heritage during your vacation that you did not know where to start? Well then, welcome to the Zadar region! St. Donatus Sea organ & Sun salutation Forts, monastaries & remains Religious treasures Crafts and Customs UNESCO heritage Museums Sailing & Boating Sailing & Boating If you have a penchant for sailing or you simply enjoy a wanderlust of the open sea, the Zadar region is definitely your cup of tea! 3 Islands to Escape the Crowds Best Places to Discover Sailing Excellent ports and marinas Charter and regatta hub Food & Wine Food & Wine The Zadar region is a place of exceptional gastronomic tradition, developed and perfected through centuries of industrious, painstaking and resourceful approach to food and wine making. Zadar Wine Route Fresh Seafood Salt Olive oil Lamb and Cheese National & Nature Parks National & Nature Parks The three nature parks in this region - Telašćica, Vrana Lake and Velebit are all known for it's variety, preservation and unique beauty of nature. It is extremely important to be functional and easy to manage. e-Commerce Websites Thanks to the software solutions that we design for you, you could easily enter new products and other content changes. Social Media Marketing Interaction with consumers through social media channels is important if company wants to gain trust and to build customers loyalty. Therefore, we will first listen to you, your desires, needs, goals you want to achieve and your eventual suggestions. 2nd Analysis We analyse minutely your business, market and the audience you want to get closer. We are trying to find the best solutions to achieve the goals you want. Based on the steps we know are necessary to take, we create the conditions and budget amount. After your consent with our suggestions, we continue the process. 3rd Planning After analysing research results, we make a detailed project plan that will help us to achieve defined results within an agreed time period. We make a strategy that will enable to reach a great number of your customers and thus to build your business strong. 4th Design We design unique web presentation that describes the best your business. We create not only fantastic designed site, but the site which is easy to manage for every customer and prospect. 5th Content Creation We can edit existing texts or we can create completely new content.
