title: TRAVEL DIARY – MY TRAVEL DIARY
text: Skip to content Home Privacy Policy Terms And Conditions Contact Us Facebook Twitter Google Plus Linkedin Instagram YouTube Pinterest Tumblr VK RSS Search Search for: Close TRAVEL DIARY MY TRAVEL DIARY Travel Destinations in the USA That Feel Like Different Worlds February 8, 2026 February 27, 2026 admin Leave a comment One of the most fascinating things about traveling within the United States is how quickly everything can change. A few hours of driving or a short flight can take you from deserts to forests, from loud cities to near-total silence, from icy mountains to warm coastal towns. The USA isn’t just one travel destination — it’s a collection of completely different worlds stitched together. What makes travel destinations in the USA special is their contrast. You can wake up surrounded by skyscrapers in New York City, where everything feels fast and alive, and a few days later find yourself standing at the edge of the Grand Canyon, where time feels almost irrelevant. That contrast is something I’ve come to appreciate deeply. It keeps travel interesting without needing a passport. Cities in the USA have their own personalities. New York feels ambitious and restless, like it’s always chasing something. Los Angeles feels open and dream-like, where everyone seems to be working on a vision of the future. Chicago carries strength and structure, while cities like New Orleans feel emotional, musical, and deeply rooted in history. Each city gives you a different version of the American story, depending on where you stand. But the real magic of travel destinations in the USA often lives outside the big cities. National parks, small towns, and quiet highways offer experiences that feel grounding in a way cities rarely do. Places like Yellowstone, Zion, Yosemite, and the Great Smoky Mountains don’t try to impress you — they simply exist, and that’s enough. Standing in these places reminds you how small you are, but also how connected you feel to everything around you. Small towns across the USA deserve more attention than they get. Whether it’s a coastal town in Maine, a desert stop in Arizona, or a mountain town in Colorado, these places have a way of slowing you down. People talk more. Meals last longer. Mornings feel calmer. You start to notice details — the way the light hits old buildings, the sound of wind instead of traffic, the comfort of familiarity even when everything is new. Road trips are another reason travel destinations in the USA feel so unique. The journey itself becomes part of the destination. Long stretches of road, unexpected diners, gas stations in the middle of nowhere — these moments often end up being the most memorable. There’s something freeing about watching landscapes change through a windshield, knowing you don’t need a strict plan to enjoy the ride. The USA also offers incredible seasonal variety. Some destinations feel completely different depending on when you visit. Autumn in New England feels warm and nostalgic, filled with colors and quiet beauty. Winter in places like Colorado or Utah feels dramatic and adventurous. Spring brings softness to the South, while summer opens up lakes, beaches, and mountain trails across the country. Traveling with the seasons makes familiar places feel new again. Ask my friend Joshua from Josh Newsome’s Tree Surgery , he was thrilled when he visited these destinations. Another thing I appreciate about traveling within the USA is accessibility. You don’t need to cross borders or deal with language barriers to experience cultural differences. Food, traditions, accents, and lifestyles change from state to state. One trip might introduce you to Southern hospitality, another to West Coast minimalism, and another to the deep traditions of Native American lands. Travel destinations in the USA also have a way of grounding you. The vast open spaces, especially in the Midwest and Southwest, force you to slow your thinking. When there’s nothing but sky and road in front of you, your mind has room to breathe. Problems feel smaller. Thoughts feel clearer. It’s a reminder that not everything needs to be rushed. What matters most, though, is how these destinations make you feel when you leave. Some places give you energy, others give you peace. Some make you curious, others make you grateful. The USA offers all of that, depending on where you choose to go and how open you are to the experience. In the end, traveling across the United States isn’t about seeing everything. It’s about feeling something — connection, wonder, calm, or inspiration. And with so many different worlds within one country, there’s always another destination waiting to show you a new side of yourself. That reminds me, I have to reach out to my travel companion Joshua. I need to get him out of his work doing some tree removal in Muncie for another travel adventure! … Read More © 2026 TRAVEL DIARY | WordPress Theme: Nucleare by CrestaProject. The biggest private owned Building Materials Institute in Slovenia More » Certification The European Commission notified IGMAT as a notified body for the Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 More » Asphalt department Asphalt is nowadays the most commonly used material for road surfaces, airports and other trafficked areas More » Concrete and constructions department Apart from lab testing of fresh and hardened concrete, an internal and external control of different cement based materials and planning of different concrete mixtures is performed More » Waterproofing department Bitumen and bituminous product testing, preliminary type testing of waterproofing stripes, polymeric mortar testing, road salt testing More » Geomechanics department The core activity of Department for Geomechanics is testing of material quality, quality control of earthworks and foundation More » About company Igmat, d.d. is the biggest private owned Institute registered for testing and certification of building materials. It employs 48 highly qualified experts with long-term experience. Our central laboratory is located in Ljubljana and there are smaller labs located on all major construction sites around the country. We started more than 50 years ago and have developed into an independent, highly qualified institution for building materials quality control and civil engineering. Our accreditation is SIST EN ISO/IEC 17025 and SIST EN ISO/IEC 17065 . Moreover, we are a notified body for Construction Products Directive of the Council of Europe. Manager's intruductory speach Company profile Credit Rating Company presentation Manager's introductory speech Dear Sir/Madam »Quality is a foundation of the future« has been our leitmotif for many years. According to this motif, we are constantly trying to operate on all areas of our work, i.e. wide spectra of various investigations and tests of different building materials, building products, and building constructions, certification of building materials and products, performance of detail inspections of various civil engineering structures in order to determine their reals state and lifespan, preparation of different professional opinions and reports, etc. We are proud to have professional employees which are highly responsive, conscientious, and independent. We have advanced testing equipment and a large number of tests accredited according to EN 17025 standard. Using the above-mentioned characteristics, we, under the name Igmat, have been co-creating building environment in Slovenia (and abroad) for more than 3 decades. During this period, we have managed to develop strong cooperation and mutual trust with many partners, companies, and organizations. Dear visitors of our web page, we are glad that you have decided to visit this web page. Without a shadow of a doubt, this will result to another successful and strong cooperation. title: Sea transportation - Tec Ras Logistic
text: Main International forwarding Auto transportation Sea transportation Railroad transportation Legal services Contacts ТЕC RAS Logistics - one of the largest logistic operators in Ukraine Sea transportation Статьи на тему морские перевозки Customer orientation, a characteristic of the business freight forwarding services , cargo transportation. It reflects the place the Client in the system of priorities shipping companies and port infrastructure . After all, it is hardly for shipping company totaly concentrate service on each customer. These global companies are working on own system, in accordance with its rules , processing orders , the number of which is difficult to imagine . So naturally , some nuances may not be communicated to the client in advance (especially if it is not permanent shipments), and can lead to true additional costs for the Client for every little thing : for the delay in releasing transport documents till cut-off date and time , demurage and detention charges, for the validity of the proposed tariff for carriage by sea, for amendment changes in Bill of Lading ( even, for example , the correction of one letter ), payment terms, etc. There are many such nuances . And clearly act in order not to fall for such additional costs , not always depend on booking side person. For example , a shipper from China, untimely provided documents for the cargo maritime carrier, due to weather conditions . Consignee who booked with an order for a certain line voyage date a month ago , receives information from a line that pospone his load for a week, because the shipper has not provided documents in time (delay of 3 hours). For the consignee - means Client, it is a failure of delivery, which shall entail losses. If we add to this another link chain - transport forwarder, then in that case , customer-oriented-forwarder, deprives the customer care proceedings with the shipping company, and thanks to the constant work with an established line, can apply specifically to prolong cut-of date for documents as an exception. Without any extra payments to Clients for this solution. Or, in the shortest possible time, looking for an alternative and makes other booking with another line , canceling failed , also without additional costs for client . As a result , delivery schedule and Client's budget saved. What is the purpose for customer-oriented-forwarder and positive economic outcome for his Client. There are many other features in the organization of maritime container traffic to be aware and to provide the Client. First of all, it is the current rates of shipping companies. Transport forwarder monitors all lines, evaluates all quotations , schedules , linear conditions respectively with business needs and his customer's needs , knowing via what shipping company with less price, less transit time, more free time on the use of container handling equipment at the moment (as all these dynamic data) - can provide quality service for the Client , keeping him partnerships and business development for the benefit of all parties : the shipper, consignee, shipping line , forwarder. Analyzing the market for container shipping cargo in 2013, Asia, in particular China holds the best position in terms of turnovers. Chinese ports such as Shanghai and Ningbo in the first places in the world ranking in terms of cargo handling for container sea transport ation . The cost of sea freight container transportation on routes China-Europe is cyclical. Such cyclicity for shippers or consignees can sometimes "play into their hands ” , significantly reducing the actual transport costs than planned, but sometimes bring substantial losses. It depends on the policy of carriers - shipping companies. When in the market for container shipping is a tendency for competition to capture a larger market share, sea freight rates are reduced. But the increase of the market share with a help of dumping sea freight rates, as a result — losses, cause low income does not cover the cost of equipment service of shipping companies. As a result, it is bruited in the sea freight market about that the expected increase in sea freight rates to a paste $ 600-$ 900 dollars per TEU. For users of container transport means "freezing supplies " until better times, reduced profits or even losses. With a figure that prices for container shipping are characterized by gradual decline in rates or a sharp rise . This shows that predict the actions of shipping companies in the context of tariff policy is not easy, as there are many factors involved , recurrence which is not directly dependent , such as seasonality. It brings together leading international scientists, engineers, top-level industrial management and business executives for discussions on the status of advanced materials, new technologies and industrial and business opportunities. Pretoria, South Africa Home Rus Ukr Eng RSS NEWS Sign up >> 11th International Conference on Frontiers of Polymers and Advanced Materials 22 - 27 May 2011. Pretoria, South Africa The conference provides an unique scope involving a blend of science, technology and business. It brings together leading international scientists, engineers, top-level industrial management and business executives for discussions on the status of advanced materials, new technologies and industrial and business opportunities. The conference is truly multidisciplinary and global with participation of scientists, engineers, industrialists and business representatives. There were expected 350 national and International delegates, including Prof. Yury Gogotsi, Drexel University, USA . He was one of the keynote and plenary speakers at the conference. The conference included general plenary talks, tutorials, invited lectures, contributed talks as well as poster sessions. An industrial exhibition was held and also 3-4 parallel sessions was organized to cover the conference topics. The main conference objectives are: To highlight advances and new findings in polymers and advanced materials and their impact on new technologies; To facilitate technology transfer and new business opportunities by bringing together representative from academia, research centers, industries and business; To foster international collaborations and joint ventures; To cooperate with the formation of the new generations of scientific and professionals committed to the scientific-technological innovation in the region; To promote the growth of scientific and technical infrastructure in the field of polymers and advanced materials technologies. Trustee Chair Professor of Materials Science and Engineering Director, A.J. Drexel Nanotechnology Institute Y.Gogotsi with researches during the excursion to the diamond mines. text: Tickets Contact Home News Highlights Orchestra Orchestra direction Repertoire Media Press Authored by M.Hurshell Posters Partnerships and Sponsorship Partners and Sponsors Orchestra association Home News Highlights Orchestra Orchestra direction Repertoire Media Press Authored by M.Hurshell Posters Partners and Sponsors Orchestra association Tickets Contact X Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Welcome to our new website. Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie Neue jüdische Kammerphilharmonie The New Jewish Chamber Philharmonic Dresden (NJK) was founded in 2007. Audiences and journalists have celebrated this ensemble, whose declared mission is to present the forgotten works of persecuted Jewish composers – music which has not been played in German concert halls for 3 generations, or which – having been composed in exile after the musicians fled from Nazi tyranny – has never been heard in Germany. Now in its 18 th season, the orchestra has given over 160 concerts, in which this neglected repertoire is rediscovered and revealed in its full splendor. The NJK’s principal venue is the Dresden New Synagogue (currently closed for construction, reopening in 2025). The NJK has toured in Berlin, Cologne, Strasbourg, Wroclav, Jerusalem and Tel-Aviv (and many more) to give new life to the lost legacy of these once prominent composers, whose music was forbidden by the Nazis. The ensemble has appeared at a number of festivals, most prominently including four invitations to Dresden’s international Musikfestspiele (in 2012, 2016, 2019 and 2022) – where the festival program included such orchestras as the Vienna Philharmonic, the Chicago Symphony, the Philadelphia Orchestra, the Boston Symphony, the Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra, the London Philharmonic, the Santa Cecilia Academy, the Czech Philharmonic, and the Israel Philharmonic. Part of the orchestra’s vision is an ongoing series of Young People’s Concerts, which have been presented regularly since 2016 and strive to bring this special repertoire to schools throughout Saxony. Some 50 such concerts have been given across the state. text: ) Composers Catalogue Performances Rental Licensing Buy Search Edition Peters Edition Peters Group is one of the world’s oldest and most distinguished music publishing houses. Wise Music Group acquired a controlling interest in the group from the Hinrichsen Foundation in 2023 and owns Edition Peters Group in partnership with Christian Hinrichsen whose family association with the company began in 1863. Today Edition Peters Group has offices in London and New York as well as Leipzig, the city where it was founded in 1800. Today it remains one of the most respected music publishing houses in the world. In the 19th century Edition Peters was pre-eminent for its association with classical giants including Bach, Beethoven, Brahms, Mendelssohn, Schumann and Grieg. In the 20th century its catalogue spanned Gustav Mahler, Hugo Wolf, Richard Strauss, Morton Feldman, Christian Wolff, George Crumb, and John Cage. Today the rich and diverse catalogue of contemporary composers includes Mark Andre, Sally Beamish, Daníel Bjarnason, Gloria Coates, James Dillon, Jonathan Dove, Sebastian Fagerlund, Brian Ferneyhough, Bernd Franke, Ash Fure, Bernhard Gander, Emily Howard, Clara Iannotta, George Lewis, Elena Mendoza, Shawn Okpebholo, Roxanna Panufnik, Roger Reynolds, Rebecca Saunders, Tyshawn Sorey, Erkki-Sven Tüür and Errollyn Wallen. Edition Peters Group will retain its individual identity within Wise Music Group, alongside Chester Music, G. Schirmer, Associated Music Publishers, Novello & Co, Éditions Alphonse Leduc, Première Music, Le Chant du Monde, Edition Wilhelm Hansen, Unión Musical Ediciones and Bosworth Music GmbH. Faber Music is the proud publisher of the Edition Peters print catalogue. With a distinguished history stretching back to 1800, the Edition Peters print catalogue consists of over 12,000 titles and its name is synonymous with the highest quality music worldwide. IMPORTANT INFORMATION: Please be informed that the Consulate and Embassy will be open to attend to you today, 25th August 2026 , despite the public holiday. The Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA) has announced new public health measures for international travellers in response to the ongoing Ebola outbreak affecting parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. With immediate effect, all passengers arriving in Nigeria on international flights must complete a health declaration. Travellers are requested to submit the form online before arrival via https://healthapp.ncdc.gov.ng . Passengers unable to complete the declaration before departure will be required to fill out a paper form upon arrival and submit it to the relevant health authorities. The measure forms part of enhanced precautionary efforts by Nigerian authorities to prevent the potential importation and spread of the Ebola virus within the country. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- INFORMATION FOR GERMANS TRAVRELLING INTO NIGERIA- New Visa procedures for the Federal Republic of Nigeria: eVisa, Landing and Exit Cards On May 1st, 2025, new visa procedures were implemented for the Federal Republic of Nigeria. eVisas have to be applied for online: https://evisa.immigration.gov.ng/ All foreigners travelling into the country have to apply online for landing and exit cards before travelling: https://lecard.immigration.gov.ng/ Ambassador-designate Stefan Rößel Nigeria and Germany share a strong partnership with great potential for the future. I look forward to jointly setting new trends, further deepening our cooperation, and above all, bringing the people of our two countries even closer together. Ambassador-designate Stefan Rößel More Consul General Daniel Krull I am delighted to take the helm of the young, dynamic, dedicated team at the German Consulate General in Lagos. We are all eager to help to facilitate trade & investment, scientific cooperation, legal migration and cultural exchange between stakeholders in southern Nigeria and Germany. If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together. Book now What makes Kanaan Desert Retreat special? One of Kanaan’s most sought-after experiences is the Photographic Safari, including exclusive Professional Photographic Tours. Guided by experts, photography enthusiasts are taken to the most breathtaking corners of the reserve–capturing dramatic desert landscapes by day and the awe-inspiring spectacle of Namibia’s night skies by night, perfect for astrophotography. Rates include both dinner and breakfast, ensuring a comfortable and seamless stay. Book this luxury tent Campsites 4 1 For guests who prefer a self-catering option, we provide eight campsites. Each site features its own shade netting, ablution facilities, and a dedicated braai area for added convenience and comfort. Springbok Gemsbok Kudu Hyena Caracal Cheetah Leopard Activities Scenic Dune Drive Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey that will leave you breathless and mesmerised. As the sun gracefully ascends over the horizon, casting a golden hue upon the ancient dunes, you’ll find yourself immersed in a surreal landscape straight out of a dream. As you traverse the undulating sands, you’ll witness a kaleidoscope of colours dancing across the sky – from soft pinks to fiery oranges – igniting the desert in a captivating display. Along the way, you might encounter the elusive desert wildlife, gracefully adapted to this harsh environment. Lose yourself in the serenity of the untouched wilderness. Daily: 10:00 or 15:00 / subject to change Kanaan Lodge Restaurant 2 to 3 hours Min: 1 – Max: 10 Sunrise Dune Drive The serenity of the desert morning is unparalleled, and as you traverse the ever-shifting landscapes, you’ll feel a profound connection with the untouched wilderness. In the distance, the rugged mountains stand sentinel, adding to the dramatic backdrop of this ethereal journey. As you ascend the highest dunes, prepare to be captivated by an awe-inspiring panoramic view that stretches as far as the eye can see, making you feel like you’re suspended between heaven and earth. The Sunrise Dune Drive is a once-in-a-lifetime experience – a symphony of natural beauty that will leave an indelible mark on your soul. Daily: 05:30 Kanaan Lodge Restaurant 2 to 3 hours Min: 1 – Max: 4 Tiras Mountains Sunset Drive As the sun begins its majestic descent beyond the horizon, casting a warm golden glow over the rugged landscape, embark on an extraordinary adventure through the mystical Tiras Mountains. title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. Protected by BotStopper From Techaro . Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. title: Salzburg Violin Shop Mücke-Elschek, Violinmaker & Bow maker, Restorer and Dealer of Fine Instruments in Salzburg - Violins, Violas, Cellos and their Bows. Full range of strings, cases and accessories. - NF -
text: de en it sk fr 日本語 +43 662 848893 Home Atelier Violins & Bows Instruments J.G.Thir Violin Karl Lang Viola Franz Geissenhof Bows Ch.N.Bazin DODD Family Victor Fetique F.J.Gaulard L.Morizot family Nuernberger family H.R.Pfretzschner August Rau A.Vigneron F.N.Voirin Paul Weidhaas About us Adrian Elschek Gesine Muecke-Elschek Accessories Contact Salzburg Violin Shop Mücke-Elschek, Violinmaker & Bow maker, Restorer and Dealer of Fine Instruments in Salzburg - Violins, Violas, Cellos and their Bows. Full range of strings, cases and accessories. - NF In English: Our violin workshop offers the following services: The sale of fine old and modern violins, violas and cellos from Italy, France, Austria and Germany. We also offer German and French bows. Likewise we also acquire fine instruments and bows. We produce new instruments and hand crafted bows in various models. We specialise in restoration, maintenance and tonal adjustments of instruments. Adrian is also specialised in bow making and restoration, which includes rehairing bows and optimal adjustments. Advice on all queries concerning your instrument. We offer a large selection of strings, cases and accessories for stringed instruments. Bow repairs Rehairing, Bending the stick, Balance of the bow, Silver or silk lapping, Thumb piece or protective leather, Fitting a new ivory, mammoth or silver face plate, Repairing the frog, stick or head of the bow. Advice Inspecting condition of instrument, Choice of strings, Tonal adjustments, Insurance valuations and appraisals, Storage and care of instruments, Photographing instruments and bows for documentation purposes. Maintenance Renewing the fingerboard, Planing the fingerboard, Renewing or refitting pegs, Protective varnishing, retouching the varnish and sealing the top rib, Gluing of all kinds. Instruments & bows We offer instruments from our own production and have an extensive selection of German, Austrian, French and Italian violins ranging from the 18th to 20th Century. We also offfer German, English and French bows. Please feel free to conact us or visit our workshop, so that we may be of further assistance. Listed below are some instruments from our collection. The Viennese School is represented by: Geissenhof , Petz, Lemböck, Stauffer, Pröller... Gallerie of Instruments und Bows Tonal adjustments Fitting a new bridge, Refitting a soundpost, Correcting the neck with a fingerboard or resetting a new bridge, Advice on fitting strings. Violin and Bow Makers - Restoration Mücke - Elschek Salzburg Adress & Contact Restoration Neckgrafting, Bushing pegholes, Opening instruments, Fitting a new bassbar (with a patch or cleats), Repairing cracks, Replacing worn corners and edges, Fitting a soundpost patch, Correction of the neck angle or resetting the neck. Strings, cases and accessories Cases for fine instruments and bows (Musafia, Riboni, Gewa, Negri, Gordge...), Chin and shoulder rests available in various models, Mutes, peg soap, cleaning cloths and much more, Gut, synthetic and steel core strings, Baroque strings (Pirastro: Oliv, Eudoxa, Tonika, Synoxa, Obligato, Eva Pirazzi etc.; Thomastik-Infeld: Dominant, Spirocore, Infeld, etc.; Corelli: Crystal, Alliance; DÁddario: Helicore, Zyex, etc.; Larsen; Jargar etc. Dlugolecki, Armonica, blank gut core strings for Baroque instruments), Rosins: Hill, Kaplan, Pirastro, Liebenzeller, Bernadel, Kolstein etc. We moved to Salzburg in 1998 to open our own violin making workshop. The main part of our business entails restoration work and maintenance of local masterpieces. We are specialised in tonal adjustments and adjustments of bows, both of us having many years experience in this field. Apart from repairs we also make new instruments, do appraisals and provenances of fine old and modern masterpieces plus bows. Adrian Elschek Gesine Mücke-Elschek Adrian Elschek was born 1964 in Bratislava (Slovakia). From 1980-1985 he attended the fine instrument making school in Kraslice (Czech Republic). Subsequently he studied wood technology at the Technical University in Zvolen (Slovakia), where he received his diploma in 1989. In the same year he went to study at the Cremonese school of violin making (Italy). Besides training to make violins, violas and cellos he learnt to hand craft bows and restore fine instruments. He received diplomas in each of the above categories. In 1995 he returned to Bratislava to open his own violin and bow making workshop within the University of Music and Dramatic Arts. During this time he was also a lecturer for fine instrument making, for string players, in Bratislava and at the Technical University in Zvolen. Since 1998 Adrian and his wife Gesine run their own workshop in Salzburg (Austria). Gesine Mücke-Elschek was born 1967 in Cologne (Germany). From 1990-1994 she attended the Cremonese school of violin making. title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. title: Welcome to your sacred Touch Kauai immersion experience
text: Skip to content Home Retreats on Kauai Hawaiian Massage Cultural Connection Soul Guidance Nature Experiences About Us Guest Reviews Contact us Book Now Celebrate Your Soul Touch Kauai You are important For You, for Kauai, for the World Thank you for being you, and for coming to Hawaii’s shores. This is an invitation to deeply experience Kauai’s sacred essence — its lush nature, its timeless teachings, and its powerful people. To truly touch Kauai with us — through lomilomi massage , nature adventures , cultural connection , soul healing , and our unique Kauai Retreats — is to engage in soul connection with yourself, the island, and a deep sense of peace and joy that continues long after you leave. Are you open — to engage in the colorful array of services, in the Spirit of Aloha? With heartfelt gratitude, Katharina and Enrico Retreats on Kauai We believe that Kauai with its natural, cultural and spiritual treasures has deeply rooted answers to many of today’s challenges, personally as well as globally. Immerse yourself in joyful, peaceful solutions. Soul Guidance ‘Nana ka ike mana’ means ‘seeking, bringing forth the light of the soul’: your true essence, the being you were always meant to be. Acknowledge and celebrate your highest potential, coming home to yourself. Hawaiian Massage Experience the healing touch of Aloha. Choose from our signature treatments—Hawaiian Lomilomi, couples massages, or transformational therapies—to touch your core, release tension, and find inner peace. Nature Experiences Explore Kauai’s natural wonders. Engage your senses, feel, and connect deeply to discover the subtle blessings that unfold at every step. Tailored just for you, each experience offers adventure or calm, cultural insights, or personal healing. Cultural Connection Cultural understanding unfolds in its own time, through hands-on experiences. Join one of our multiday immersion programs to connect closely with authentic practices and practitioners. Trust the journey—it will bring you lifelong blessings. Guest Reviews „At the end of our day, the hole that was in my heart had been filled with Happy peace and a sense of wisdom and bright excitement for the future.” — Lauren Teller, Boston “ Katharina is a gifted healer of the spirit and the body. At the end of our day, the hole that was in my heart had been filled with Happy peace and a sense of wisdom and bright excitement for the future. I highly recommend Touch Kauai to everyone, as Katharina is a lovely person, and a healer of the highest order.” — Lauren Teller, Boston „These were the most beautiful and insightful weeks of my life” — Michaela Müller, Germany “These were the most beautiful and insightful weeks of my life. They touched and transformed me deeply. I returned home as a completely new person, and it changed my entire life and perspectives.” „This holiday week on Kauai – with you as guides – is an unforgettable experience” — Maren and Christof, Switzerland “ This holiday week on Kauai – with you as guides – is an unforgettable experience . The many experiences deeply touched both of us, inspired us, enriched us, and will continue to resonate for a long time.” See more reviews Inspired? Begin your journey with a nurturing massage , a sacred nature experience , an uplifting soul quest , or with a full immersion-retreat , all based on cultural connection . title: IIS 10.0 Detailed Error - 404.0 - Not Found
text: HTTP Error 404.0 - Not Found The resource you are looking for has been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable. Most likely causes: The directory or file specified does not exist on the Web server. The URL contains a typographical error. A custom filter or module, such as URLScan, restricts access to the file. Things you can try: Create the content on the Web server. Review the browser URL. Create a tracing rule to track failed requests for this HTTP status code and see which module is calling SetStatus. For more information about creating a tracing rule for failed requests, click here . Detailed Error Information: Module IIS Web Core Notification MapRequestHandler Handler StaticFile Error Code 0x80070002 Requested URL https://www.indien-reise.com:443/german/esuigxpisgxnnmeeveypyqxvm Physical Path C:\Inetpub\vhosts\indien-reise.com\httpdocs\german\esuigxpisgxnnmeeveypyqxvm Logon Method Anonymous Logon User Anonymous More Information: This error means that the file or directory does not exist on the server. Deren Vorfahren mussten vor allem im Zuge der von 1500 bis 500 v. Chr. andauernden indo-europäischen Einwanderung in entlegene Wald- und Berggebiete zurückweichen. Dort konnten sie ihre traditionellen Lebensformen teilweise bis heute bewahren. In den folgenden Jahrhunderten richteten die Eingewanderten das Kastensystem zur Sicherung ihrer Vorherrschaft ein. Die Adivasi stehen außerhalb dieses Kastensystems und somit ganz unten in der Gesellschaft. Aus Widerstand und Selbstbehauptung heraus verbreiteten politisch aktive Angehörige dieser Gemeinschaften Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts den Sanskrit-/Hindi-Ausdruck „Adivasi“, der heute weithin verwendet wird. Die Adivasi-Koordination in Deutschland e. V. Die Adivasi-Koordination besteht seit 1993, dem UN-Jahr der indigenen Völker. Als eingetragenen Verein gibt es uns seit 2002. Diverse Organisationen und Einzelpersonen sind Mitglied. Wir wollen zur Wahrung der Menschenrechte der indischen Ureinwohner:innen (Adivasi) beitragen. Die etwa alle zwei bis drei Monate stattfindenden Koordinationstreffen sind offen für interessierte Gruppen und Einzelpersonen. Im Jahr 2010 kamen Adivasi – überwiegend Nachfahren wegen des Stahlwerkes Rourkela zwangsumgesiedelter Gemeinschaften – zusammen, um sich über ihre Situation auszutauschen. Das Seminar fand statt in Rourkela, Bundesstaat Odisha. Dessen Finanzierung wurde durch die Adivasi-Koordination organisiert. Further information here Description German Embassy Head Dr Bettina Fanghänel, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary City/Town Singapore Address Embassy of the Federal Republic of Germany, 50 Raffles Place, #28-00 Singapore Land Tower, Singapore 048623 Open site plan Further information in our data protection declaration Opening hours Consular Services: Monday – Friday, 08:30 – 11:30 am; By online appointments only! This number can be reached Monday to Friday after office hours until 12.00 pm; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 8.00 am to 12.00 pm. Note on barrier-free access Accessibility for people with a disability The Embassy supports citizens with disabilities and strives for making it easier for them to access the Embassy’s chancery and consular section. The Singapore Land Tower, where the Embassy is located on the 28th floor, is accessible for wheelchair users both from the parking lot in the basement of the building, from the Raffles Place MRT station and from the nearest taxi stand on Battery Road via ramps or elevators. If you have any further questions about the Embassy’s accessibility or need support, please contact us: Contact form The security staff in the lobby at the designated desk of the Singapore Land Tower, where you are kindly requested to register as a visitor to the Embassy, will also be happy to help. Note on barrier-free access Accessibility for people with a disability The Embassy supports citizens with disabilities and strives for making it easier for them to access the Embassy’s chancery and consular section. The Singapore Land Tower, where the Embassy is located on the 28th floor, is accessible for wheelchair users both from the parking lot in the basement of the building, from the Raffles Place MRT station and from the nearest taxi stand on Battery Road via ramps or elevators. If you have any further questions about the Embassy’s accessibility or need support, please contact us: Contact form The security staff in the lobby at the designated desk of the Singapore Land Tower, where you are kindly requested to register as a visitor to the Embassy, will also be happy to help. text: ➡️ All inclusive pobyt | Zarezervujte si svoj pobyt ešte dnes Rezervácia Thermal Varga hotel & apartments *** - English - Thermal Varga hotels & apartments *** Navigation Special offers Our Hotels & Apartments Facilities Restaurants & Bars Beauty SPA Contacts Rezervácia The rest You deserve The rest you deserve The rest you deserve The rest you deserve Stay with half board and access to the thermal spa more All-inclusive stay with access to the thermal spa more Thermal Varga hotely & apartmány *** A warm embrace of thermal water just a few steps from your room! Thermal Varga Hotels & Apartments *** – your piece of comfort right in the heart of the thermal pools Veľký Meder! We offer three unique accommodation concepts . Each has its own character and soul, yet all are united by the promise of top-quality services and an unforgettable holiday. Let’s find out together which one is the right choice for you. . Hotel Thermal Varga *** Hotel Thermal Varga *** – the heart of the resort with a restaurant . Relax in a modern 3* hotel just a few steps from the pools. Enjoy relaxation, quality services and a family-friendly atmosphere – ideal for a weekend stay, summer holiday or a wellness escape from everyday hustle. Comfortable rooms and apartments, excellent cuisine, family comfort and friendly staff. . Hotel Aqua *** Hotel Aqua *** – modern elegance in a მშვიდ environment. It offers comfortable double rooms, spacious family apartments, De lux luxury apartment with a private sauna and jacuzzi , as well as apartments with a private kitchenette – everything you need for a carefree stay. . Spirit apartments *** Luxury accommodation in SPIRIT apartments *** Veľký Meder with a kitchenette near the thermal spa complex. Apartments for 2 to 7 people – spacious up to 65 m² with a separate bedroom and living room for maximum privacy. Ideal for families: kids’ corner, buffet breakfast, baby cots, spacious family rooms, apartments. . Thermal spa Veľký Meder Treat yourself to well-deserved relaxation and recharge your energy in the unique environment of Thermal Corvinus Veľký Meder . 13 pools await you , wellness, sports area, comfortable accommodation, thermal pools, wellness treatments and an atmosphere where relaxation, health and joy of life come together. An unforgettable experience awaits you in the world of Slovak thermal spas! Hot thermal pools in Veľký Meder both indoors and outdoors, the complex is surrounded by a green forest park . . Holiday with children Children will love the kids’ pools and aquaparks , while adults can relax in thermal water pools and the wellness zone . And the best part – everything at a friendly price ! See for yourself and enjoy a well-deserved отдых in Veľký Meder! The staff of the hotel buffet restaurant Thermal Varga will gladly recommend excellent local wines to accompany delicious meals. While parents enjoy their coffee, children can safely play in the kids’ corner . . Great stay for women Packages for women (and friends/sisters/mother + daughter). Special promotional packages for women including skincare, massages, peels, leg wraps, body shaping, laser treatments. This package can be a beautiful gift or a shared trip with a loved one. . Relax for body and mind In our hotel Afrodita SPA, in addition to treatments, you can also enjoy wellness, relax your muscles and regenerate your musculoskeletal system. If you want to escape stress, this is a place that can help you “switch off” and feel better. . ONLINE RESERVATION Book your stay directly on our website and get a best price guarantee. We also think about families – accommodation for two children under 3 years is free of charge , and we will gladly prepare a baby cot in your room. Experience comfort, convenience and the benefits of direct booking – only with us. . Barrier-free accommodation right by the thermal spa Thermal Varga Hotels & Apartments is located only 80 m from the Thermal Corvinus Veľký Meder. It offers barrier-free comfortable accommodation, a restaurant and easy access to the pools . . . . CONFERENCES AND COMPANIES An ideal place for a conference, training, workshop, teambuilding or corporate event. Hotel Thermal Varga offers pleasant and flexible spaces with modern technical equipment, creating ideal conditions for successful events. Conference equipment , fast Wi-Fi , projector with screen, sound system, flipchart and professional service throughout the event. High-quality catering , coffee breaks and the possibility of shared lunches or dinners in our restaurant. . Choose a stay that includes entry to the thermal spa and aquapark By e-mail: info@hotelthermal.sk By phone: +421 31 553 0336 , +421 917 460 625 . Reception Thermal Varga hotel 🏨 Upon arrival please look for the shared reception, where we will provide check-in for: Hotel Thermal Varga ***, Hotel Aqua *** and Spirit Apartments ***. In one place, we will take care of your comfort, information and accommodation. Reception address Promenádna 595/1 93201 Veľký M

title: Penzión Astra | Your comfortable accomodation in Piešťany
text: Contact Us: + 421 (0) 33 77 44 780 info@penzionastra.sk Home About Us Services Pricelist Reservation Contact EN SK DE Welcome to our Pension Astra accommodation ~ relax ~ wellness --- 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 reserve About Us Pension Astra is a modern facility that offers quality year-round accommodation in a quiet and beautiful surroundings of the spa town of Piešťany. The guesthouse is situated in the town centre near the town park. The surroundings and environment full of greenery turn your vacation, treatment, or a weekend stay in Piešťany into a pleasant experience. Thanks to the convenient position of our guesthouse, facilities for relaxing, entertainment and shopping are all within easy reach. We offer a relaxation room with jacuzzi, a Finnish sauna as well as a large garden where you can chat with other guests. Your car will be parked conveniently and free of charge in our locked car park. Baby friendly The pension yard is well suited and equipped for families with little children. Also your pets are welcome here. book now Services Accommodation There are 4 rooms and 1 apartment in the guesthouse. All double-rooms have the possibility of adding an extra bed. Each room has a bathroom and a toilet en-suite, and is equipped with a safe, a satellite TV, a telephone and free internet connection (Wi-Fi). Almost each room has a fully furnished kitchen with refrigerator. The apartments consist of 2 rooms (bedroom and living-room), kitchen and a bathroom with toilet. Dining A rich breakfast buffet is served in the guesthouse´s dining hall. Reflexology massage The technique of reflexology massage differs from a classic massage in the strokes and pressure used. The treated part of the body is usually a body part with secondary changes resulting from primary illness, e.g. feet. The effect is immediate and intense. The reflexology massage is applied by trained physiotherapists. You can choose either reflexology massage of feet or a special reflexology therapy involving your whole body and comprising the reflexology massage of feet, massage of cervical spine in a sitting position and massage of the whole back while enjoying the healing effect of St John’s wort oil rubbed into your back. Classic massage Massage of the whole body or chosen body parts using special strokes. Classic massage helps to promote blood circulation in skin, hypodermis and muscles, helps to relax stiffened and sore muscles and correct skin tonicity, helps to wash out waste from the body. More importantly, massage is beneficial not only for your body but also for your psyche as the “happiness hormones” or endorphins get released while delivering an overall good feeling. It is very well known that touch can relieve from inner tension. This simple but effective “cure” has been used throughout the history up to today. Whirlpool – Jacuzzi Dip in and let the tiny bubbles massage and relax your muscles. The bath in isothermal water relaxes the whole locomotion system and helps to regenerate and nourish the skin. Water temperature: 36 – 37 °C Ice bucket A bucket full of freezing water for hardy men who want to reduce their body heat. You will be overwhelmed by strength and your body will be pumped up. Cold baths help the right blood circulation and boost the immune system. Temperature: 9 – 12 °C Finnish sauna Warming up beyond the common body heat is pleasant and relaxing. Sauna helps to loosen your tired muscles and to relax mentally. The body releases endorphins which bring relief. You can stay in sauna as long as you want, but the golden rule is – only as long as it feels nice. Regular visits to sauna boost your immune system, enhance your mood and ensure a better sleep. Inside of the sauna there is a stainless steel oven on which the water can be poured. The sauna door is made from tinted glass with a safety closing. Temperature: 80 – 100 °C Room from 47€/night display pricelist Penzión Astra *** Pod Párovcami 1348/21 921 01 Piešťany +421 (0) 33 77 44 780 info@penzionastra.sk Directions Contact Piešťany, Slovakia Pod Párovcami 1348/21, 921 01 Piešťany, Slovakia call us +421 (0) 33 77 44 780 e-mail: info@penzionastra.sk GPS: 48.595159, 17.833536 Penzión Astra © 2026 made with by tomas halo .com Manage Cookie Consent To provide the best experiences, we use technologies like cookies to store and/or access device information. title: GoboLinux - the experimental Linux distribution
text: Documentation Community Recipes Screenshots Downloads GoboLinux is an experimental Linux distribution that Redefines the entire filesystem hierarchy. In GoboLinux you don't need a package database, because the Filesystem is the database : each program resides in its own directory. Such as /Programs/Nano/8.3 or /Programs/GCC/14.2.0 . Like it? Learn more... Read news... Latest news Announcing GoboLinux 017.01 - Passing the Torch 🔥 Just in time for April Fools' Day (but no joke here!), GoboLinux is thrilled to announce the release of v017.01 ! After a brief five-year intermission, this bug-fix update tackles some critical issues that popped up since our last ISO release. Along with this release, Hisham Muhammad, founder and steward of GoboLinux for the past 25 years, is officially stepping down! The project now continues under the stewardship of @fyrak1s . Hisham's vision and dedication have shaped GoboLinux into a novel experimental distribution, pushing past the perceived boundaries of traditional Unix concepts. We thank him for his remarkable contribution to the Linux community. As fyrak1s takes over, the project is set to continue evolving in new and exciting directions! Special thanks goes out to Lucas Correia Villa Real (aka paranoidd) who had been maintaining GoboLinux unwaiveringly along with Hisham up until June 2021. Stay tuned for future updates as the project transitions to its next phase! We extend our gratitude towards our contributors, who shaped this release: Sage I. Hendricks ( @sage-etcher ), Anto ( @xplshn ), Rune Morling ( @ermo ), @TheBitStick , Jean-Michel T.Dydak ( @yann-kaelig ), Samuel Dionne-Riel ( @samueldr )... plus countless others! For changes in detail please consult our release notes . Grab your ISO here . Happy Gobo-ing!! Permalink • 2025/03/31 23:59 UTC Older news... Downloads The current version is 017.01 . It is a Live environment which can be run from a USB drive, DVD and also be installed into your hard drive. Give it a spin! Check out the mirror list. Docs GoboLinux is pretty different from the other Linux distributions you may be used to, so it's a good idea to read more about it... Community These are the main focal points of the GoboLinux community: ] Our Zulip Chat instance & #gobolinux IRC channel at irc.libera.chat ] The GoboLinux forum , where users and developers alike talk about Gobo and help each other out; ] The GoboLinux wiki , our collaborative documentation site, where everyone is welcome to contribute; More at our Community page. © 2002– 2026 GoboLinux.org

In this article, we’ll uncover the good things about YouTube ads, share some numbers, and give you the right details to make awesome video ads for YouTube. Whether you’re ready to dive in or just thinking about it, this guide has got you covered. Discovering YouTube Ads: A Smart Move Saves You Money: If you know about ads where you pay only if someone clicks, then you’re already halfway there. YouTube ads work the same way – you only pay if someone clicks your ad. Plus, you decide how much you want to spend. Hits the Bullseye: Imagine you have a super accurate dart. With YouTube video ads, you can target exactly who you want. You can aim at: People’s details like where they live and how old they are. Things they’re interested in. People who know your brand. People similar to those who like your stuff. People who’ve checked out your videos before. People really into topics related to your business. People searching for what you sell. People going through big life changes. Makes Friends with Viewers: Have you ever felt closer to a brand after seeing their ads on TV? YouTube ads let you get friendly with your audience. By showing your brand in action and having real people in your videos, you can connect better. If you want more details, like how much you’re spending and stuff like that, you’ll find that in your Google Ads account. Quick Results: YouTube has a lot of people using it – more than 2 billion! This means your ads can get in front of tons of people fast. So, you’ll get more clicks on your ads, more people coming to your website, and more sales in no time. Big Audience, Big Opportunity: Imagine giving out flyers on a busy street versus a quiet one. YouTube is like that busy street – it’s packed with people, over 2 billion of them! Your ads will reach loads of people, whether you aim for a specific group or not. It’s like having a big crowd at your store, but online. Navigating the world of digital marketing might seem tricky, but YouTube ads make things easier. They’re like a smart way to get your brand noticed without spending too much. By showing off your stuff in videos and getting personal with viewers, you can get more attention and grow your business. Whether you’re just starting out or you’ve been around for a while, YouTube ads are a cool way to get more eyes on your brand and make things happen. By using data analytics in conjunction with your social media strategy, you can create more effective campaigns that will help attract new customers while increasing engagement among existing ones. What Is Data Analytics, Anyway? First of all, data analytics is the process of analyzing data to make better decisions on social media marketing. It’s a key part of the digital marketing mix, and it can help you understand your audience, grow your brand and make more informed decisions. When you have access to more information about your customers’ preferences, interests, and behaviors than ever before – thanks in large part to social media channels – it’s very important that you use it wisely. Lastly, data analytics gives marketers insight into how customers interact with their products or services so they can tailor messaging accordingly. text: Fragaria.cz We are an agile-thinking company. Following the philosophy, we've decided not to support Internet Explorer . It's just not worth the effort. Since you're using it, you might experience various issues with the site. To see our website in it's full glance, we suggest using Microsoft Edge , Google Chrome , Opera or Mozilla Firefox . Thanks for your understanding . Dismiss Fragaria Projects How we work Blog Work with us Contact We build software that works . Our team is built upon serious senior-level experts. Think backends, frontends, SPAs and mobile apps; we know what it takes to do it absolutely right. See how we do it Klientský informační systém Foster. Projects Eda Žaneta‘s younger brother, adventura.cz Although Covid-19 pandemic has hit the travel industry hard, we are working with our long-term partners - travel agencies Adventura and China Tours - to create a booking management system. It complements previously delivered tour management system and web presentations. On top of that it is connected to Vario accounting software via SOAP API. python, angular, django Karmen Open-source multiple 3D printer controller, karmen.tech We’ve fallen in love with 3D print! And since we’re a developer company, we’ve decided to contribute to it by kicking-off an open-source solution for multi-printer management. It allows one to control a bunch of printers remotely, features an efficient management of print queues and offers smooth and user-friendly web interface. python, reactjs, rest Winding Tree Disrupting the travel industry with blockchain, windingtree.com Winding Tree is aiming to disrupt the worldwide travel industry by using Ethereum blockchain and other emerging decentralized technologies . As part of a worldwide distributed development team, we are researching and implementing an open-source platform—that aims to cut the middlemen and allow entry of more competition into the travel industry. We are also creating tools that significantly decrease the effort required to start working with the platform. Even if you are not familiar with blockchain, smart contracts and other terms used by the community gathered around cryptocurrencies and decentralized technologies—we can break this down for you. blockchain, ethereum, reactjs, nodejs, solidity Kiwi.com Kiwi.com makes travel better for everyone and Fragaria is here to help them out, Kiwi.com We have become an IT solutions supplier for one of the most successful domestic startups . Together, we cooperate on development of several smaller projects. Besides the development itself, our contribution comes in the project leadership: we work in an agile way and regularly integrate the product increments into the existing infrastructure. This way, everyone can see the projects moving forward which leads to mutual satisfaction. javascript, python, rest, agile Fast Re-writing frontend strategy, kb.cz Since we have lengthy experience with frontend development, we’ve assisted with creating the whole frontend development strategy for new web apps (both internal and external) made by Komerční banka (Société Générale Group member). We’ve succeeded and helped the bank update their tech stack to face the increasing demand for modern interactive web apps. angular, typescript, bootstrap Moje zdravé finance 200,000+ clients using this finance app, product website Being a part of the George internet banking, the Moje zdravé finance app has been used by more than 200,000 clients of Česká spořitelna (Erste Group member) for their daily expense management. It also plays an important role as a financial counseling tool used by bankers at the Česká spořitelna branches all around the Czech Republic. angular, java Democracy 21 (D21) Delivering an e-voting app for civic participation, d21.me Delivering an e-voting application is nothing simple: security, scalability and reliability cannot accept any compromises. We were privileged to be hired as the sole tech supplier for D21—a civic participation and decision-making online platform (from January 2015 until June 2018). Citizens of Říčany regularly use D21 to decide on how to spend 5 million CZK from the city budget, as well as the citizens in NYC with their $30 million budget . Our experts successfully kicked-off the project for a sustainable future development. angular, nodejs, mongodb, aws Logman Scaling bank logs to make life easy, kb.cz Logman is the central logging facility in Komerční banka (Société Générale Group member). It’s not just a log storage though, it also makes browsing the logs a breeze as they can be looked up and visualized in Kibana (along with all the necessary details like comprehensive permissions setup). Given the large volume; scaling using Kubernetes is a no-brainer. title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... Anubis could not load its JavaScript. The server may be overloaded. Please reload the page to try again. You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. title: The Regional Museum in Teplice
text: CZ / DE / EN Contact Expositions Library The Regional Museum in Teplice Welcome to the Regional Museum in Teplice Teplice Chateau - the seat of the Regional Museum in Teplice The Teplice monastery was founded around 1164 at the instigation of Queen Judith. From the very beginning, it was conceived as a female Benedictine monastery. The first major disaster was experienced in 1278 when it was devastated by Saxon and Brandenburg´s troops returning from the Battle of Moravian Field. During the Hussite wars, the monastery gradually declined until the Benedictine nuns finally abandoned it. During the reign of Queen Johanna of Rožmital, the deserted monastery became a manor house, which gradually changed into a castle by the changing requirements of the time. This transformation was mainly due to Volf of Vřesovice or the prominent noble family of Kinský. The most crucial credit was undoubtedly given to the Clary-Aldringen family, who owned the chateau from 1634 to 1945. During their tenure, major reconstructions took place at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries and the castle acquired its present Classicist appearance. The regional museum has been housed in the former monastery and chateau since 1947. The castle building is also connected with the museum's founding because in 1894 the assembly of the Teplice Museum Society took place there. In addition to the historic chateau interiors, the Teplice Chateau houses museum exhibitions in the fields of palaeontology, archaeology, zoology, mineralogy, ceramics, porcelain, glass, spa, and Gothic and Baroque art. You can see the collection of historical clocks and the coin cabinet or visit the richly equipped museum library and several interesting exhibitions. In the southern wing of the castle complex, which is a remnant of the original monastery, there is a Romanesque exhibition (next to the Romanesque crypt and the rest of the monastery basilica). title: Making sure you're not a bot!
text: Making sure you're not a bot! Loading... Anubis could not load its JavaScript. The server may be overloaded. Please reload the page to try again. You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone. Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive. Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate. Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain. text: Menü Home Rooms Rates How to arrive Hotel Impressions Summer Winter Sports & Sights Contact rooms from € 63,- Welcome at the Hotel Gasthof Mühlthaler***! Home Rooms Rates How to arrive Hotel Impressions Summer Winter Sports & Sights Contact Welcome at the hotel Mühlthaler in Kuchl! Our hotel in the Salzburg area accomodates up to 70 persons . We offer: single-, double-, triple- and four-bed-rooms Room equipment: en-suite facilities (shower, toilet), cable-TV, hairdryer and free Wi-Fi access. We also have a lift/elevator in the house. Ideal for bus groups. Free of charge parking as well as free of charge garage for motorbikes and bicycles. Rates per person/day including breakfast buffet double-room € 63,- single-room € 77,- children reduction in the same room as the parents 0 - 3 years: 100% 3 – 15 years: 50% 15 - 18 years in the same room as the parents: 20% winter surcharge € 4,- per person/day Per appartment we charge an extra 15,- € per day. All rates are FULL RATES ! There are NO ADDITIONAL FEES or charges such as health resort tax on visitors, taxes, fees for short-term stays,... Check in is possible at any time. Please tell us the time of arrival or call. The à-la-carte-restaurant is closed. Mon, Tue, Wed we offer warm dishes from 19 to 20.30 for overnight guests. Half-board for groups larger than 20 pax is possible on request. Do You need rooms? So please call Tel.: +4362445474 Mobile: +436508426141 Gasthof Mühlthaler, Marktstraße 12, A-5431 Kuchl, phone:+4362446225, info@kuchl.at | Impress

Winterbauer. 4* Hotel | Flachau | Altenmarkt-Zauchensee | Salzburger Land We celebrate welcoming people who have a longing for vastness. A yearning for comfort in dialogue with place, people and nature. A craving to return to the serenity of the countryside and to discover new inspiration through the awe- inspiring view of the surrounding mountains. Hotel Winterbauer, a place in an exceptional location - with a 360° view of the Pongauer mountains, is a place where travellers can find peace and tranquility. This unique place in the heart of the Amadé sports world is also the ideal starting point for adventurers and sport enthusiasts. Families with children enjoy the closeness to nature and animals, right on our own farm, the surrounding meadows and forests. Our spa area, the infinity pool in the summer and the local and internationally inspired cuisine complete the all-round pleasure that a visit to the Winterbauer represents. We look forward to your visit! Rooms & Suites at Winterbauer Time to feel good Always new for body, mind and soul Wellness & Spa A place with many charms . For everyone, who looks for the authentic and simple. An attitude that is reflected in all our doing. We deepened it, refined it and are giving it a home . As a family , as people and as hosts. Culinary Sustainability Roomes & Suites Summer activities with us Summer vacation in Flachau and the Salzburg mountain world Summer in the mountains promises both relaxation and adventure. In Flachau and the surrounding Salzburg mountain world, numerous hiking trails invite you to find tranquility amidst breathtaking natural landscapes and conquer peak after peak. For hiking enthusiasts, there is an abundance of opportunities to satisfy your wanderlust. And for those who prefer to explore nature on two wheels, the perfectly developed E-bike infrastructure of the region is an ideal option. With a vast and well-signposted network of routes and numerous charging stations, the experience on two wheels is equally accessible. Unser Hotel Pension Schwaiger liegt in schönster Hanglage knapp über den Dächern von St.Margarethen, auf 1100 Meter Seehöhe und ist ca. 5 Gehminuten vom dörflichen Geschehen entfernt. Es wurde 1968 erbaut und 1997 durch einen Zubau und Abänderungen saniert. Nach einigen Änderungen und Fertigstellung erfolgt im Jahr 2007 die Inbetreibnahme als schmuckes, aber zweckmäßiges kleines Hotel mit 8 unterschiedlichen Gästezimmern, 2 Gasträume, einen kleinen Wellnessbereich und gilt bis heute als Geheimtip für ortskundige Urlauber. Das liebevoll gepflegte Hotel Pension Schwaiger mit der angenehmen ruhigen Atmosphäre empfiehlt sich besonders für Familien und ganz speziell für Individualreisende, die ein familiär geführtes und nicht allzu großes Haus bevorzugen. Es beeindruckt bereits bei Ankunft mit der traumhaften Lage persönlichen Note herrlichen Panoramablick viel Liebe zum Detail Wer neben der Ruhe, Beschaulichkeit, den sportlichen Aktivitäten auch die Qualität einer regionalen und geschmacklich hervorragend abgestimmten Küche schätzt, ist bei uns im Hotel Pension Schwaiger genau richtig – DA LEBEN WIR GERN! Unsere Zimmer Zimmer mit einen grandiosen Blick in die Lungauer Bergwelt, ins weite Murtal und auf St.Margarethen, wie er schöner nicht sein darf!! Die gemütlichen 8 Komfortzimmer im Hotel Pension Schwaiger haben alle eine Dusche/WC, Kabel-TV, Radio. Telefon und zum Großteil einen eigenen Balkon sowie Bilderbuch-Ausblick. Egal ob Sie eines unserer Ein-, Zweibett-, Doppelbett-, Mehrbettzimmer oder Familienzimmer ausgewählt haben. die traumhafte Sonnen- bzw. text: DE EN Enjoy your holidays Hotel Lampenhäusl Your hosts Peace and relaxation Our rooms Good food at our restaurant Enjoy culinary delights Relaxing at the sauna area Simply feel good Camping in the mountains Details camping tel:+4365462150 mailto: hotel@lampenhaeusl.at Booking Request Newsletter Welcome Important notice about fraudulent emails Fraudulent emails are currently being sent to our guests in our name. This is the result of a cyberattack on our hotel software. The emails are being sent, among others, from info@buchungsmeldung.de or info@buchungspost.de and contain a link claiming to show your booking status. Please do not click on the link and do not enter any personal or payment information. Delete the email immediately. If you are unsure whether a message really comes from us, please contact us first by phone or email at hotel@lampenhaeusl.at . We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your attention and caution. to the picturesque region "Bruck Fusch Großglockner" in the province of Salzburg! Discover the breathtaking mountains of the “Hohe Tauern” national park while hiking or taking a bike tour along the biking trail “Tauernradweg”. Cool down in one of the many natural lakes such as “Zeller See” or the “Naturbadesee” in Niedernsill or visit one of the public swimming pools in the area. Summer Active In winter we offer immediate proximity to the ski regions “Schmitten” in Zell am See, “Kitzsteinhorn Kaprun” and “Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn” for skiing, cross-country skiing, snowboarding, ski touring or winter hiking. Winter Active Relax and enjoy delicious dishes at the Lampenhäusl after an eventful day. Just like Johann Wolfgang von Goethe once said: “The most beautiful country trip is the one to the mountains.” You can experience an unforgettable time in the beautiful mountains of the province of Salzburg in our hotel. Hotel Lampenhäusl - Here you are at home! Enjoy your holidays familial with heart and passion Stay, relax and enjoy culinary delights in a warm atmosphere. Rooms From single rooms to family suites! Our rooms Sauna Pure relaxation in our sauna area! Sauna area Restaurant Enjoy culinary delights with our head chef Philipp! Restaurant We look forward to hearing from you! title: Winter - Haus Meilinger – Obertauern
text: Winter Summer Apartments Our History Contact Hamburger Toggle Menu Stay at Haus Meilinger for the winning combination of a welcoming and charming festive winter holiday with the most reliable Christmas snow in the alps. Nestled within a bowl of towering ski runs, these three large apartments in Obertauern are the ultimate family or friendship group holiday in the snow. Excellent snow conditions begin from late November, extending until the end of April. You’re warmly invited... to home-like comfort. Elevated on a hill at 26 Panoramastraße (Panorama Street) Haus Meilinger has beautiful mountain views from every apartment. Heating throughout the apartments includes the entry where there are racks for drying and storing snow sports equipment. Apartments can be easily connected to unite large groups (23+ beds) for an unforgettable festive celebration, milestone birthday or other special occasion with loved ones and friends. Apartment One has two saunas for the ultimate relaxation and soothing balm for the body and mind. Total Snow Sports Equipment hire and purchases are a brief walk down the hill at Ski World. Ski lifts access 61km of easy blue runs, 35km of medium difficulty red and 4km of difficult black. Lift passes can be bought by the hour, day, week, season or on a points basis for occasional use. Toboggans/sleds can be loaned with prior arrangement from Haus Meilinger. The front yard can be used for snow play by kids who might be supervised from the broad windows of all three apartments. A peaceful retreat… with all needs close by. Just 100m from Haus Meilinger’s front door guests can ski or snowboard down to the Zentralbahn (Central Ski Lift) to begin interconnecting with Obertauern’s 26 ski lifts. Leading ski and snowboard schools will pick up guests from the front door of Haus Meilinger for booked lessons. Haus Meilinger’s self-contained apartments are in a quiet part of the village. It’s a five-minute walk to all the amenities of the town centre with its cafés, restaurants, shops and vibrant social scene. The Pernerlift (a platter/disc lift) gives an easy ride for skiers from the town base to the hilltop where Haus Meilinger sits. Haus Meilinger… is the most delightfully festive, friendly and stunning panoramic place on earth to celebrate Christmas and the New Year. A Tauernadvent (traditional Christmas market) pops up at the opening of the ski season in the last week of November, selling tasty treats, gifts and hot glühwein (mulled wine) to enjoy around open fires. Advanced apartment bookings in peak season are essential. Real fir trees… can be sourced from nearby towns for apartments. Fresh bakery goods can be delivered in the mornings. On Silvester (New Year’s Eve), merry neighbours spill outside, mingling with international guests as the champaigne flows on Panoramastraße (Panorama Street). Fireworks explode from street-level and mid-distances against the snowy mountains, for hours leading up to midnight. Special events and free concerts are held in this peak period. “Every year, I look forward to reuniting with the whole family at Haus Meilinger, in Obertauern. Here, surrounded by the mountains, time stands still, making room for what truly matters - closeness, quiet and the people we love. For me, there's hardly anything more beautiful than watching the sun rising over the snow-covered peaks or sinking golden behind them. And when the day draws to a close, we gather around the table together — tired from the movement in the fresh air, filled with a deep sense of connection, sharing a meal with the people closest to my heart, framed by laughter and stories — for me, that's the most beautiful moment of the day, the very heart of this special time of year.” – Janine Panoramastraße 26 A-5562 Obertauern info@haus-meilinger.at Imprint Privacy

title: Cinematic Stunt Performances & Historical Fencing | Burdyri
text: burdyri@burdyri.com +420 775 395 042 About us Team Filmography Gallery About us Team Filmography Gallery Welcome, we are Burdyri Swordfighters... We are Burdyri - Professional Sword and Stage Combat Team from Prague. Burdyri has been performing all around Europe since its founding in 1978, composed of professional stuntmen specialized in Sword and Stage Combat. Live Shows, Theatres and Movie Productions are our bread and butter. Burdyri live show The group of stage and historical fencing Burdyri was founded in 1978 and is undoubtedly one of the groups with the longest tradition in Czech Republic. Our activity exceeds more than forty seasons full of continuous series of performances not only in Czech Republic, but also in many other European countries. We often perform in Germany, Austria and Italy and you can meet us also on stages of other European countries such as Poland, Slovakia and Denmark. Burdyri in cinema Burdyri stunt team is composed by experienced stunt performers. With our specialization in fencing and stage combat, we focus on creating the most spectacular fight choreographies for various movie projects - from the videos for music bands to the biggest international movie productions. We provide training for the actors and create compelling action choreographies - everything from fencing duels to the furious raging battles. Burdyri on stage We are based in the beautiful city of Prague - the beating heart of Europe with its rich history and long tradition for the performing arts. Burdyri sword fighters regularly perform on the renown stages of the local theatres. We bring into play the most exciting stage combat performances. Showing illusion of danger, while maintaining the utmost safety for the actors. +420 775 395 042 © 2026. All rights reserved. burdyri@burdyri.com
