Search for: Strategie AV21 News 07/23/ 2026 Newsletter 01-2026  Just released the new issue of the CzechGlobe Newsletter More  06/22/ 2026 Professor Pavel Kindlmann has passed away  It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of Prof. RNDr. Pavel Kindlmann, DrSc., a distinguished Czech ecologist, mathematician, and long-time collaborator of CzechGlobe. Professor Kindlmann headed the Department of Biodiversity at the Global Change Research Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences from 2001 to 2023. His research focused primarily on population biology and the application of mathematical approaches in ecology. He inspired and mentored generations of students at the University of South Bohemia in České Budějovice, the Faculty of Science of Charles University, and numerous universities abroad, where he held visiting appointments. Professor Kindlmann was devoted to nature not only through his scientific work but also through his deep personal commitment. He actively participated in public discussions on nature conservation, advocating for the protection of his beloved orchids and for the preservation of the unique natural values of Šumava National Park. His passing is a great loss to the Czech scientific community and to all who had the privilege of knowing and working with him. May he rest in peace. More  05/7/ 2026 The Clim4Cast website was unveiled at a press conference at EGU 2026  The Clim4Cast forecasting tool was presented at the EGU General Assembly 2026 in Vienna by Lukáš Dolák. The original contribution was also chosen to be presented at a press conference for journalists, along with 17 other contributions out of a total of 20,000. Within the Press conference ( https://www.egu.eu/gamedia/2026/press-conferences/#PC1 ), the most outstanding Clim4Cast outputs were introduced, including the forecasting tool. The attending journalists appreciated both the web platform and the tool. We honestly hope that this event contributed to spreading the word not only among journalists but also to the wider public and researchers. More  04/24/ 2026 Clim4Cast Receives Map of the Year 2025 Award  The expert jury of the Czech Cartographic Society has announced the results of the prestigious Map of the Year 2025 competition across six categories. The Clim4Cast project team, from the Global Change Research Institute CAS and Masaryk University, also participated. In the category Digital Cartographic Products and Online Applications , the team received an award among 14 competing entries for the Clim4Cast map portal – drought, heatwaves, wildfires . title: Genasis
text: GENASIS Home About GENASIS Global and national data Case studies Data sources Data structure Publications Scientific publications Applied outputs Reports Contact Markdown MD Page 1 MD Page 2 MD Template Data Visualizations Welcome to Genasis Global data on levels of contamintants in the environment and human tisues . Data Visualizations GENASIS information system was established at Masaryk University through cooperation between Research Centre for Toxic Compounds in the Environment (RECETOX) and the Institute of Biostatistics and Analysis (IBA MU). GENASIS provides a comprehensive information on contamination of the environment by chemicals. Features of GENASIS Enables unified presentation and interpretation of data produced in various monitoring programs from many partner institutions Provides support for harmonized validation and import of data Provides safe storage and backup of imported data and its visualization in cooperation with its producers and owners Contains an interactive online data browser which enables sorting, filtering, visualization, analysis and interpretation of data Jointly provides data for both environmental and health risk analyses which are relevant both for public and state administration and for the private and industrial sectors; processing of the outputs is fast and efficient Partners The most important partners who share data in the GENASIS database NILU Norwegian Institute for Air Research Core research areas of Nilu: atmospheric composition, climate change, air quality and environmental contaminants. Visit UNEP United Nations Environment Programme Visit WHO World Health Organization Visit EC Environment Canada The main goals of EC: atmospheric composition, climate change, air quality and environmental contaminants. text: Error 404--Not Found From RFC 2068 Hypertext Transfer Protocol -- HTTP/1.1 : 10.4.5 404 Not Found The server has not found anything matching the Request-URI. No indication is given of whether the condition is temporary or permanent. If the server does not wish to make this information available to the client, the status code 403 (Forbidden) can be used instead. The 410 (Gone) status code SHOULD be used if the server knows, through some internally configurable mechanism, that an old resource is permanently unavailable and has no forwarding address.

Definition and Characteristics First up, let's talk specifics. Niche financial products are specialised financial solutions tailored for unique needs. Unlike traditional financial instruments, these innovative options are uniquely suited to fill gaps traditional products may overlook. Bridging Loans for Startups Bridging loans , a type of short-term loan, are gaining traction among tech entrepreneurs in Melbourne, especially those based in accelerators at Southbank. So, what is a bridge loan ? It's essentially a financial tool that helps you transition from one phase to another, usually in property acquisition or during a cash flow shortage. Imagine you're waiting for the settlement of a property sale while needing funds to secure another property; that's when a bridging loan becomes invaluable. The application process for bridging loans may seem daunting at first. However, the flexibility it offers can align with entrepreneurial strategies and growth plans. Start by researching lenders who are familiar with the unique needs of startups. This includes understanding the terms, interest rates, and repayment schedules. Once you've pinpointed the right lender, gather necessary documentation such as financial statements and business plans before a formal application. In terms of real-world cases, consider tech startups in Carlton that have leveraged bridging loans to pivot quickly when opportunities arise. The rapid evolution and agility in these scenarios make bridging loans a strategic choice. Understanding the intricacies of such financial products can empower you to make informed business decisions, especially if you're looking to maintain momentum in fast-paced environments. By investing in a variety of asset types—residential, commercial, and industrial properties—you can mitigate potential losses. This diversity acts as a buffer, as different sectors react differently to market changes. Balance is key; consider both high-yield properties that maximize your cash flow and growth assets that appreciate over time. title: VRGraz - Graz info, hotels and local guide - sights and 360 degree tours
text: Skip to main content VRgraz Local Guide Hotelguide Panorama English Deutsch English Slovenščina Italiano Welcome to VRGraz "City of Design", Austria's second largest city, capital of pleasure and Unesco World Heritage Site - these are just a few of the advantages the Austrian city in the middle of the country has to offer. But before we go into culture, sights and insider tips, first a few important facts and figures about the city. Graz is the capital of the Styrian region and is situated on both sides of the river Mur. Main Content Graz is the capital of Styria and situated on both sides of the river Mur. With almost 300,000 inhabitants, Graz is comparable to well-known German cities such as Wiesbaden or Augsburg. The metropolitan region of Graz, on the other hand, has about 630,000 inhabitants, making it the third largest next to the metropolitan regions of Vienna and Linz. The city has also made a name for itself in Europe with two awards. Firstly, it was awarded the title of European Capital of Culture in 2003, and secondly, it was named the Capital of the Reformation in 2015. In addition, in addition to the 2011 Ausgezeichnetetn Award of the Unesco City of Design, it became a human rights state and winner of the Europe Prize. Since 2021, the city has Elke Kahr as its mayor. Around the first district, the Inner City, there are 16 other districts. World Heritage Site and Capital of Culture The city has experienced an enormous increase in population in recent decades, making it the fastest-growing city in Austria, with almost 80 percent of its inhabitants being Austrian citizens. It is not for nothing that the city has become World Heritage Site and Cultural Capital , the southern geographical location and the historical atmosphere of the city are very attractive for the tourism sector. But what are the reasons for tourists to travel to Austria’s second largest city? Art house Let’s start with the probably most attractive and worth seeing: the sights. The playfully labeled “ friendly alien ” is aesthetically an eye-catcher all along the line. Quite impressive and striking is the art house of modern art in the inner city of Graz’. It attracts not only art lovers but also culturally interested tourists from all over the world. For the ‘needle’ of the Kunsthaus, as the Austrians call it, allows the eyes of tourists and visitors to wander over the entire Old Town of Graz. The architectural masterpiece was opened in 2003 and was constructed by Peter Cook and Colin Fournier. Island in the Mur Graz kann zwar nicht wie die deutsche Hauptstadt mit einer Museumsinsel hervorstechen, dafür mit einer Insel auf dem die Stadt durchfließenden Fluss Mur. Die Murinsel wurde als schwimmende Plattform von einem New Yorker Künstler erschaffen und ist seit 2003 fester Bestandteil der Stadt. Die muschelförmige Insel ist von allen Seiten betretbar und bietet neben einem Cafe, ein Designshop und ein Amphitheater. Castle hill (Schloßberg) The Schloßberg of the city towers above everything and is with 123 meters the highest point of the city. Besides the brilliant view over the city, the Schloßberg is historically seen in any case also worth a trip. In the 12th century the castle, which is still preserved today, was built on this mountain. This “gradec” (small castle), as it was called by the Slovenes, gave the town its name. For foot patients or elderly people the mountain can be easily reached by a lift or the Schlossbergbahn , otherwise there are also 260 steps or several paths leading to the considerable viewpoint. Eggenberg Castle Another sight that should not be ignored when visiting the city is Eggenberg Castle. It is one of the most valuable sights for the country of Austria and is not least Unesco World Heritage Site . The baroque complex including the imposing castle is, besides the park, a very popular recreational destination for families, single travellers, locals and peacocks. The beautiful animals are, especially in the summer months, well-known inhabitants of the complex. Finally, an interesting fact about the castle itself: the number of room windows corresponds to the 365 days of a year. Overall, the city is also very well equipped in terms of infrastructure. Parking facilities as well as public transport connections are unproblematic. In addition, there is an old town tram in the city centre that is available free of charge for all passengers. Well, are you now curious to explore the city, climb the Schlossberg or simply stroll through the baroque alleys and buildings? Then let’s go, the citizens of Graz welcome you warmly. Food, culture and shopping in Graz Strolling through the old town of Graz, you will come across many a culinary insider tip. A great advantage of the southern location is that fruit, wine and other delicacies thrive wonderfully. Our restaurant A five-course choice menu is offered daily for our house guests. Skip navigation Rooms beautiful & spacious book now Search and book rooms Summer Offer Bike Offer Winter Offer Hotel Reitlwirt Your 4-star hotel in Brixen im Thale with inn tradition in the middle of the Wilder Kaiser Brixental mountain world The Reitlwirt was already mentioned in documents in the 15th century. The traditional inn skilfully combines old values with contemporary comfort. The cosy character of the house with its warm parlours lets you slip into the romantic times of the old inn tradition, while the spacious rooms , a wellness area , a winter and guest garden and much more offer all the amenities of the upscale 4-star hotel industry. Your hotel in Brixen im Thale Hotel Brixen im Thale Summer holiday Summer in Brixen im Thale: gentle grassy mountains, crystal clear streams, green meadows and a mountain experience to dream about. Brixen im Thale, a charming village (about 10 minutes by car from Kitzbühel) has given its name to the valley as the oldest village. Hiking holidaymakers appreciate the SkiWelt adventure hiking pass: the perfect all-round package for your mountain summer. With just one ticket you can use all 13 lifts and also have the opportunity to explore six exciting mountain adventure worlds for your family holiday. To the summer packages Mountain biking Find ideal conditions in Brixen im Thale - for example on the Brixner Sonnberg and on to the popular Filzalmsee. The best insider tips for the most beautiful mountain tours around your holiday resort Brixen im Thale are available at www.skiwelt.at. Over 20 themed, circular and high-altitude hiking trails offer variety every day. More information Golf Play on the most beautiful greens in Tyrol during your golf holiday in Brixen. Within a radius of a few kilometres, a variety of beautiful golf clubs with breathtaking panoramas await all golf enthusiasts: Among them are the golf clubs Wilder Kaiser Ellmau, Schwarzsee near Kitzbühel, Achensee, Westendorf, Walchsee and Kössen. We can especially recommend the Westendorf Golf Club (18 holes), which is only a few minutes' drive away from your holiday hotel. more information Hiking Holidays for young and old, whether sporty or leisurely, there is something for everyone! Experience and understand nature, learn by playing and relax at the same time - new concepts that appeal especially to families. Family experience on the mountain: Enchanting Filzamsee Hochbrixen, Alpinolino in Westendorf, Witch Water Hochsöll and much more awaits you ... More information Hotel Brixen im Thale Skiing holiday Winter in the Brixental valley near Kitzbühel: a deeply snow-covered landscape, glittering snow crystals as far as the eye can see and plenty of fresh air. Nothing stands in the way of your snow-sure winter holiday. The 4-star Hotel Reitlwirt in Brixen im Thale proves to be the ideal winter destination. Skiing holidaymakers will have their true joy in the Kitzbühel Alps holiday region and can make the most of every imaginable opportunity. TO THE WINTER PACKAGES Skiing The SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental is the most popular ski area in the Alps for all ski fans: over 280 kilometres of perfectly groomed pistes, 90 modern cable cars, 77 traditional family-run huts with sun terraces and service, panoramic views of over 70 3,000-metre mountains, the ALPENIGLU® village, 4 fun parks, illuminated toboggan runs, Austria's largest night ski area and many other experiences await you. See for yourself with the help of our live webcams. More information Cross-country skiing Cross-country ski trails are right outside the front door. The enchanting winter landscape of the Brixen Valley is an Eldorado for nature lovers. A network of perfectly groomed skating and classic cross-country trails leads you through the dreamlike landscape. More information Ski touring It is well known that the Brixental is one of the most interesting ski regions in the world. However, very few people know that the Kitzbühel Alps, and especially the Brixental, offer secluded valleys with wonderful ski tours. Good for those who come anyway and enjoy the magnificent panoramic view of the Hohe Tauern (including the Großglockner and Großvenediger), the Kitzbüheler Horn, the Wilder

title: Vacation Apartments Poschacherhof in Obergurgl Hochgurgl Ötztal
text: Poschacherhof Poschacherhof Apartments & Rates Apartment 1 Apartment 2 Apartment 3 Apartment 4 Inquiry Obergurgl & Active Obergurgl Winter Summer Service News Booking information Contact & Getting there A Hearty Welcome to Poschacherhof in Obergurgl in Ötztal In our comfortable house in a quiet, sunny situation we offer you a feeling of well being and homeliness in our friendly family atmosphere for the “best days of the year”. All 4 Apartments have a cosy living room with balcony, seating arrangement with double couch, two separate bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, a bath/shower with double wash basin, separate toilet and a hall with a cloakroom. Experience the ”Winter Fairy Tale” Obergurgl at close range. Our apartments are situated next to the ski bus stop for the free Gurgler-Skibus. Within 3 minutes you will be at the bottom of the ski lifts in the Gurgler – Ski Region. The ski bus comes every 10 minutes and enables you to have a stress free holiday. An approx. 7 km long, well prepared cross country trail and also walking trails go directly past our house. Comfortable atmosphere and friendliness are the foundations of our daily effort to ensure that your holiday will be an unforgettable experience. We have so much to tell you but it would be best if you came along yourself and enjoyed a holiday in our house. We look forward to welcoming you, The Gstrein family We offer our guests the following: Balcony with table and chairs Wireless-Internet free of charge Free parking (directly next to the building) All apartments are non-smoking Apartments APARTMENT 1: 4-5 people Description: Two separate bedrooms (one of them with additional double couch), bathroom with double wash basin, separate toilet, living room with balcony south facing, seating arrangement, couch, flat-tv, stove, oven, dishwasher, fridge. Details & Rates APARTMENT 2: 2-4 people Description: Two separate bedrooms, shower with double wash basin, separate toilet, living room with balcony south facing, seating arrangement, sofa-sleeper, flat-tv, stove, oven, dishwasher, fridge. Details & Rates APARTMENT 3: 2-4 people Description: Two separate bedrooms (one of them with variable beds), shower with double wash basin, separate toilet, living room with balcony south-west facing, seating arrangement, couch, flat-tv, stove, oven, dishwasher, fridge. Details & Rates APARTMENT 4: 4-5 people Description: Two separate bedrooms (one of them with additional couch), bathroom with double wash basin, separate toilet, living room with balcony south facing, seating arrangement, couch, flat-tv, stove, oven, dishwasher, fridge.
